reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach would be spectacular with a lot of maintenance. The playground is beat down and grim. The beach had trash and sea weed washed up (There may have been a crew cleaning up one day) but it was kinda ghetto.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach with not that many people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The great thing about this beach is the free hut. You can lay out there with a towel and won't have anyone harassing you for money because you are using the hut. Restrooms were also clean, but bring your own toilet paper!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach and awesome views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches in Cancun. Could see all the locals hang out here since it is a public beach. Lots of places to lounge and play. Lovely water. Very enjoyable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful turquoise beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was soooo pretty in turquoise color. The waves were also strong enough, made it so fun to play around. I didn't see any food stalls around, but it was fine. And on top of that,it's reachable by the public bus!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The amazing blue beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Is one of the best and beatiful publicado beach un Cancún, the diferents pantones of blue makes you feeling in a dream

reviewsWithKeywords.title: peacefull
reviewsWithKeywords.text: a beautiful and peacefull beach, very clean, very friendly people all around me. I will totally go again

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome
reviewsWithKeywords.text: they say its in the top 10 beaches of the world but we say the top 3 for sure ... if you like waves and body surfing !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Location of the Cancun sign!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Big beautiful beach! A bit farther down the hotel zone but it has the Cancun sign and a big beach. There was quite a bit of seaweed when we were there but I was more interested in the sunbathing. Quite a few people but didn't feel too busy. We waited in line for the Cancun sign pictures but it moved pretty fast. Lots of people selling snacks and drinks so you don't have to pack anything. Almost all the umbrellas were taken but were went there a bit later in the day so if you get there early you would have more luck. Flags showing where to swim and lifeguards were there to make it feel safe. Definitely a very nice beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were driving around and stopped here. Nice expansive beach but with the same problem as most beaches here, seaweed. It was interesting to watch this special truck sucking up seaweed and very hard working men forking it around another truck for transport. The beach has a cute sign on the boardwalk, but it is all pretty understated. Various bars and places that you can walk to but nothing on the beach. There are some little umbrella type structures but I would recommend bring own umbrella, towels, drinks etc, if planning a day at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is right in the middle of the hotel zone, right off the main highway,  with a small parking lot right across the street. Nice wide sandy beach with many Palapas bit no lounge chairs. In the middle of the day, when the sun is out,  the water just glows tourqoise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, quiet and family. We take many pictures and people are very friendly with tourists, I would have liked the palapas were closer to the sea because we were far away and the sun was terrible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More beautiful than I imagined!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When we got off the bus and crossed the road to this beach, it literally took my breath away.  The water was impossibly blue and the sand was a beautiful beige.  We headed to the bar area where I ordered a very inexpensive cocktail.  It was huge and delicious!  After chatting with fellow patrons, we headed to some beach lounge chairs to enjoy the view, sun, and music playing at the bar.    These chairs were plentiful and free.  People came by offering to sell us more drinks or an umbrella, but we never felt harrassed.  The big waves were fun to play in, but too strong to swim in safely.  The only downfall was that there was no restroom close to this part of the beach.  Otherwise, it was a perfect place to spend an afternoon!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great basic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand bar is very shallow and healthy. There are places to set up near the beach. Really enjoyed my time there even if it made my nose profusely bleed from the mix of climate change and salt water. The beach had quite a few federal officers with machine guns.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoyed the clear water that this beach has, all clean on the sand and the surfing ppl make it eveb better. It was a trully nice experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What's the fuss?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is wide with lots of sand but not in my top 10 at all.  The surf us commonly too rough to swim except for a roped off area with lifeguard.  Slope of beach is steep near water so not good for romantic walks.  There are much better beaches km6-9, behind the hard rock or up near the isla ferry docks.  Playa del Carmen is as good as Cancun and the beach 1000ft south of Telum tops them all !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place, clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went mid February and not a lot of people come to this place hence we have a lot of space to enjoy. The place is so accessible to public transport and has parking for private transport.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very safe, convient to get to by bus. A must see. Will come again, tomorrow! Mostly Spanish speaking people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful water - - navy blue and aqua colouring. Sand is white, but not smooth. One of the best beaches in Cancun area - - bring your own sun umbrella if possible. Vendors selling fruit in beach area and also trying to sell use of huts, but a sign did say they are free.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Delfines is such a beautiful beach. I LOVED that they had chairs, drink service,bath room and showers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with big waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a quiet place. There are public restrooms (however, bring your own paper), there are some palapas and you can also rent chairs and parasol. Access by local buses is simple and easy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent four days in Cancun this past week. One day at las perlas beach.very crowded, shallow, so great for kids. Guys selling you drinks or food from their coolers. Very small area. Kind of dirty.Took the R1 bus. K 2.5Also checked out langosta and Tortuga but the best was yet to come.Last day went to playa delfines, k17 same bus and Best beach on that strip. It was not busy on Sunday morning but was later on that day.We brought our own drinks and snacks,(most Mexicans do,) even   coolers and and bought lunch from a guy on the beach.Yes the waves were huge, but watching the surfers, fun, sand is white, clean, blue, blue water, people watching great and we had a papula for shade, lots of life guards. Stayed all day with just enough time to get a taxi to our evening flight home.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A free location to tour and stroll along
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful and clean waters. Our bad experience here was someone trying to steal our items thank goodness we saw them and ran after them to get our stuff back (it was one of the locals). theres not security so just keep an eye out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: popular public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Many people come here to take their photos standing by the large CANCUN sign. The beach is beautiful, sand is fine and white.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach palapas, lounge chairs, bar service
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach. Sit beneath a palapas or rent a chair and umbrella. Beach bar with swing seats. Relaxing. clean bathrooms.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was beautiful . it wasn't crowded. I got to see the Cancun sign ,relax on the beach and drink. Bus stops directly in front

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great public beach to spend the day! We stayed at a condo in Cancun and found it super easy to get to and from the beach on the public bus. No restaurants or bars close by aside from the small beach bar so bring cash with you (on the pricey side) or bring your own drinks and snacks. The beach is huge with tons of palapas for shade and umbrellas for rent. There are sunloungers available for free if you’re lucky enough to grab one. Just a heads that if you grab a lounger from the guys by the bar, they’ll say it costs 200 pesos each to rent. The beach is clean and well maintained with washrooms (bring a tip or your own toilet paper) and showers. The water is pretty rough so be careful when swimming! Overall an amazing resort quality beach that’s available for everyone!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: VISITED FOR THE ICONIC "SIGN"
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Came here during the day from our local hotel to get our picture taken next to the CANCUN sign but seeing the queues we went on the beach, nice and clean and has vendors available for food and drink.we returned in the evening for our photo and no queing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public beach to catch sunrise and sunset with iconic CANCUN sign!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Delfines-awesome public beach!  Long stretch of beautiful white sandy beach! Change/wash rooms are available but be cautious when you use them as they are not regularly maintained for cleaning.  Finding parking and palapas may be a little challenge but get there early to grab your spot.  Lounge chairs are also available for rent.  If you intend to stay in the beach for a while, bring your own provisions.  You cannot take Cancun with you when you return home but you can take souvenir photos of views of the sunrise and sunset with the iconic CANCUN sign.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificant beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Blue water, creamy sand, lots of sky and sunshine. Clean safe public beach. Plan to get there by 8 am and stay all day. Worth the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand.  Clean. Public bathrooms and showers. Lounge chair rentals for 200. PesosThe only draw back was no consessions or stores near by. Make sure to bring your own snacks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful public beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the most beautiful public beach in Cancun even with atraction bonus- Cancun sign.The only pity that the bathrooms are in very bad condition and they even dare to take money from people! How sad!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favorite beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: With 7 days in Cancun, we were more than happy and tanned afterward. This beach was perfect, as it was clean and nice for walking next to the ocean. A good place to relax and get the skin brown as chocolate.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large clean beach. Nice to walk long stretch of beautiful soft sand.Easy to get to on bus or parking available.Many restaurants close by on Kukultan blvdEnjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is just unique. I will return with time so i can fully enjoy the area. So many restaurants

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best public beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Been to many of the public beaches while in Cancun and Playa Delfines is definitely the best. Lots of locals. Beautiful turquiose water. There is a giant Cancun sign for photos, but prepare to wait approximately 30 minutes. Come early if you want one of the built in umbrellas. Only downside is that the bathrooms don't have toilet paper and you have to tip someone outside to have some. However, this can be avoided by just packing your own.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nicest Beach filled with Locals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very well kept beach filled with mostly Mexican locals and Mexican tourists. The bathrooms are clean but you need to pay for toilet paper. The beach is clean with lots of soft sand. There are nice waves to swim and body surf in. Go down the road from the Hotel Zone and experience the authentic Mexican culture at this beautiful beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning view from top
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Please make sure to go as early as 8 am if you don't want to wait for an hour to take a picture with the Cancun sign. The beach is beautiful, big waves on windy days, but still overall a great experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, awesome water. Must visit for a fun time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa delfines is one of the best beaches in and around Cancun. It's generally very buzzing with activity. The beach is awesome with clear blue water. The CANCUN sign at the entrance of the beach attracts a lot of tourists for getting a pic in front of the sign. I would definitely recommend a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favorite public beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is our 3 rd time at this beach in 5 years. We love it because it is huge, beautiful, pretty clean and has shade.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with a long lineup to take a picture with the cancun sign.Waves are bigger here since it's the open ocean. Not recommended on very windy day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely afternoon on Christmas day!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach where to spend an afteroon in paradise! the colour of the water is just amazing! the sea is quite rough though not easy to swim

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A real Cancun beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As its a public beach, it is alot less clean and there is alot more sales guys trying to sell you everything from, drinks to fake glasses. The current is alot stronger, and the beach is very packed. Also there always a huge line at the top of tourists waiting to take a picture with the CANCUN sign.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing views but patience is the key to taking pics here
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful turquoise water with white sand as the back ground for the huge, colourful Cancun signboard makes for a perfect family/couple picture.  Getting there by 8 AM is probably a shorter queue but can't guarantee. Taking buses R1/ R2 from hotel zone is the most convenient and economical way to get to Playa Delfines. Just request the driver to tell you when the stop arrives and you are all set to wait in the queue and take beautiful pics if you have patience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A seriously gorgeous public beach, very clean, cheap drinks and activities ,and the water is warm and turquoise - it looks like the front cover of every travel brochure ! Beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Little Taste Of Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Views are absolutely beautiful, cloudy or sunny the Vista is amazing. Shallow waters, white sands and several shades of turquoise sea.A nesting place for turtles, however not during January, not one in sight. Well worth a visit if you're in the area, just for the view.Bobbyscorp x

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We planned this beach for our last day and then the weather was awful but we went anyway!  It was a beautiful beach and would have been wonderful to spend an entire day there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Had great time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are two different part in here Free shade and chair and charged one They require ID for the free one  What a beautiful and nice beach which is affordable.It can’t be luxurious resort beach but I could enjoy half day tripFacility is not that great tho

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, but a little rough
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, as expected for Cancun, however it was a little rough for swimmers. I don't know if it was due to the windy weather, but the sea had a lot of waves and the flag was red all the week. There are some easier places were kids can play at the sea, but in general, it was a little dangerous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Birthday vaca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Did not waste our time visiting. Saw it while driving by several times. Always unbelievable crowded. Our beach area at Live Aqua was so much prettier. Plus there is also a sign down the beach near the Westin hotel that says Cancun and it wasn't crowded. The extra enjoyment was the mayan ruin we could actually climb nestled between the Westin and another hotel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, there is Cancun tourist sign, where you can take photos. But it was very busy and long lines of people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s a good place to visit!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my trip to Cancun I have the opportunity to visit this beautiful beach. There are many things to do there, but the most important is to rest and enjoy all you can. I high recommend this place!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Oh my, this experience was amazing! The trainer Nina was so nice and patient with my 6 yr old daughter who was nervous. I can not say enough positive this about this experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach!!! Rent a beach umbrella and a couple of tanning beds so you can spend all day long. Make sure to arrive no too late so you can get a good spot. You can have food taken to your spot.  The beach is great there is a spot were the water is very shallow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go for the Picture!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Delfines beach has the beautiful and iconic Cancun sculpture that everyone takes a picture next to. It's so colorful. Try and get there early morning to avoid the crowds who have the same idea. Don't be shy and try different family poses, as you will probably only get one opportunity to pose by this sign. We didn't really try the public beach, as our hotel offered more amenities by their part of the beach, so we only had one chance to take our picture here. I wish I had not been so shy about trying different  angles etc, since our two shots did not turn out great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach area . Went there by bus just to see a different part of Cancun to my family. Was fun but best beach area is at Krystal hotel

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue as the sky
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect beach The white sand,the perfect blue Water, is so beautiful!!!!It is a public beach so you only Need ask for transportation Overall a enjoyable place perfect for kids

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and water are beautiful but there were a lot of waves and an area with rip tides where you were not allowed to swim.  There are life guards on duty which was reassuring.  There are public restrooms but be prepared that you have to pay for toilet paper (or take your own).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is cancun’s most beautiful beach the view is perfect, the color of the sea let you speechless! perfect and romantic landscape We loved CANCUN

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Family enjoyed the visit to playa delfines. The beach was nice, the weather beautiful, the sand is fine to walk on. Overall an enjoyable day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful place, just make sure you barter with the local as the charge premium.......Stay clear away from the seminars in less you want to genuine buy something as they will just eat int your vacations and time. No is not a option when they get you there and they get so cold on you. When they hear the words NO THANK YOU!we stayed at the Dream sands and that was great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach but be Smart!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Got to the beach using the R1 or R2 local bus from the downtown area. The beach is absolutely beautiful but the red flags are there for a reason. The lifeguards tell you where it is safe to swim and where not to swim. Some adults decided to act smarter than the rest of us and go in where people were clearly told not to go swim. Soon enough they were not able to swim back to shore and needed to be rescued by the life guards. Listen to them because the rip tides and waves are truly strong. Furthermore, if you do decide to purchase beach chairs, ask for clear prices and make sure to ask them for some type of written recipe that you paid. Had some issues that the people who sold us the beach chairs wanted us to pay more after we already made a “deal” for four chairs. If you want the beach chairs make sure to come early because by around 11 am they are all taken up. The beach also does provide free WiFi for a few hours which is convenient. Overall, amazing beach with absolutely crystal clear water and is a lot of fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy but nice public beach across from the El Rey ruins
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We dropped by after visiting the El Rey ruins and found this beach popular and very nice.  A couple of friendly guys were taking photos of the tourists in front of a "Cancun" sign out on the beach and they offered reasonable deals.  There is a bigger "Cancun" sign up by the parking area, with a long line of people taking photos.  The waves were somewhat treacherous, and red flags were out.  Need to be a bit careful.  I would consider this beach well worth spending a couple of hours when one is in the neighborhood.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best combination of white sand, blue water and wind. You can lie in a shadow here. Entrance is for free. Toilet is for couple of pesos

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great public beach. If your hotel does not have private beach, go to playa delfines. It is very well maintained with a great view point deck. Also, this beach is famous for its cancun logo structure.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Delfines is located on the hotel zone. Visited this beach on a very hot day. The Cancun sign is a really good photo opportunity and there was a long line to do this. The water was a gorgeous turquoise colour and the sand was lovely too. Managed to collect some nice shells. It is easy to get to by car, taxi or bus. I got a taxi there and the bus back to resort. The beach was very clean with no litter.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best time ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful. Starting from the beautiful color to the sand and the sound of the waves. Just looking at the view makes it unbelievable had so much fun playing the with my kids. I think is the best beach out of cancun and the best view as well. It's my favorite.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my opinion this is the most famous beach in Cancun. There is everything for a comfortable rest: sun beds, umbrellas, showers, toilets. Nearby there is a bus stop. But it's a long way from the city center. The best place to meet the sunrise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So beautiful...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazingly beautiful and the area very serene. There were a lot of iguanas along the wall and upper part of the sand. They are interesting to watch and can move very quickly. It was not crowded at all on a Friday afternoon and there were many palapas available to sit under for shade. The water was warm and an unbelieable aqua marine turquoise colour, almost surreal. The sand is fine and soft. There were vendors walking along the beach selling cold drinks and fruit but we didn't see anyone selling the crafts like they do on other beahes in the hotel zone. Some food trucks were on the road closer to the Iberostar hotel. No other food is available and no restaurants. So bring a picnic if you plan on staying a while. But, go and visit and relax!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the water here was a bit rough and cold but the cancun signage is here where lots of tourist take photos

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful, clean and peaceful beach. Great for a picnic filled day. We look forward to many happy returns. Weekdays are not crowded at all. Not commercial, no food places on the beach, loud bands~just quiet, but fun and serene.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very busy...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very busy, especially with the locals. This seemed to be the case on most days.We did see the turtle egg conservation areas here though, which was lovely! Lots of eggs in the sand waiting to hatch & go in the ocean.Carole : )

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really enjoyable, 50 pesos will get you a lounge chair. 140 pesos for a large pina colada brought to your chair.Toilets are clean and are upkept by leaving a tip as well as some money for toilet paper.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love seeing this Cancun sign, but if it is not convenient for you to get here, there is the exact same one at the other end of the hotel zone, km 3.2, where our Catamaran boat tour was leaving from.  And like this one, you may have to stand in line to get a picture, as it got crowded with all the tourists getting ready to head out for the day.  But arriving back in port at the end of the day, no one was heading to the Cancun sign for a picture.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is one of the best  beaches to visit, I  spend a relax day, the water color is incredible. There aren’t restaurants but  some people sell water and food.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scenic public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful scenic public beach, very clean, located right in the hotel zone. Beautiful views and photo opportunities

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but not for swimming!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful but not for swimming! There were a few people swimming, but personally I didn’t my children either. It’s a relaxing place to walk and take pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An amazing Ocean veiw
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went here on my trip to can fun in the rental car nice clean beach. Excellent view with Lots of photo opportunities. Lots of vendors so as tourist just be aware that they will approach you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I didn't know that once you go down on the beach area there are some guys renting out beach beds for no more than 200 pesos, drinks are 1.5 litres of beer and not expensive at all. Great place for locals not to spend much.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun Sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was so so.Pros: Colorful Cancun sign for pics, cheap massages.Cons: Not so clean needed shoes to walk on sand, people hanging outside bathroom waiting for change, long lines for Cancun sign.Ur resort beach most likely will be nicer and cleaner.  I'd Only recommend to go see and take pics by the Cancun sign

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just perfect
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sheer perfection. It's a free beach, which is hard to find in Cancun but incredible. Beware, there are no shops around, so bring everything you need. Oh and try the Kibbis (I think) sold by a gentleman walking around, they are delish.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hard to swim lots of sea weed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not a very special beach. From a distance the view is very beautiful but on the beach self nothing special.The only special thing is that you can spot turtles if your lucky.The beach it self is not special lots of sea weed and a big part is for the surrounding hotels so you're not allowed to walk there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach is Life
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From our hotel in downtown cancun , we took a bus R1 to go there, bus driver is friendly he accept USD since we don't have Mex peso. Then he drop us in PLAYA DELFINES. It was 10am already, Im surprise a lot of people are on the line waiting to take picture of the famous BIG SIGN cancun..its not bad at all, well organize after we took few post and selfie, we went to the beach , while walking on the way to the beach side, we saw a couple of iguana. At first I'm scared , but later on, i just ignored it, we continue walk, then swim. The beach is very clean, waves are perfect. It was fun, really have fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Shells!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On the Atlantic side, so that ocean waves/currents are stronger.  Shells everywhere, but you are asked not to gather.  Still really interesting beach stuff if you like to take pictures.  Plenty of palapas (pictured), but you've got to get there early.  Vendors come to the beach selling coconut water, etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WHAT A PLACE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean, the water just amazing, great place to go with the family, no vendors at all so no one its going to bother you while enjoying your day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The famous and colorful Cancun sign is here!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, lots of vendors selling this years designers trinkets, just look out for the "Made in China" at the bottom. Got my hair braided with beads here by a little old lady, so sweet. They even have clean (clean in the am) public bathrooms, not bad till late in the afternoon. bring your own cowboy hats paper girls. Food vendors galore, it's like any other beach in the US. Except you get sand the color and texture of baby powder. You won't burn your feet from walking on it! And a warm, clear aqua color sea, so beautiful! You can rent boats, jetski's and anything else you can think of. Personal time with dolphins too. No fee, all beaches in Mexico are free, goverment (or the people of Mexico) owns them. Sorry boys, girls going topless will get arrested. Go get your picture taken with the Cancun sign!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came here on the local bus. The day was cloudy and wavy so no swimming. On a calm sunny day however the ocean is absolutely stunning and a beautiful unreal blue. A long beach for a lovely walk. If wavy the waves and pictures are amazing. Great photos on the beach and by the famous Cancun sign at the top of the beach. A must when in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful public beach in the Hotel Zone. No restaurants but plenty of people out selling drinks and food.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family Vacatiin
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Water is beautiful and dolphin ride is amazing. Great and safe place to vacation with family. Will defineately go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Went there for the Cancun sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went there only for the Cancun sign, but found a beautiful beach. Free (but very limited) parking. Also, a very long queue to take a picture of the Cancun sign

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach for public use.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: love the blue color of the ocean. beach is clean. It may not be an ideal place for swimming due to waves, but it is great for sun bath.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very withe sand and with a nice playground for children. The colorf CANCUN sign  is a few meters further, you must go very early in the morning if you don't want to make 40-60 minute line to get some nice pictures of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Enjoyed swimming here
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful shallow blue water, very calm and relaxing when we went, needs some shade like palm trees and a good clean up by the nearby resorts. We really enjoyed the view and swimming here! Famous Cancun mirador gets crowded as everyone wants a picture taken there... would love to go again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We just visited this beautiful beach and took our picture with the Cancun sign against a wonderful, unforgettable sight to remember during those cold winter nights back at home. There is a long waiting line to take your picture in high season of course, but it is worth the wait, believe it !  We even saw a nice, young newlyweds taking their picture here! We were glad to have visited it and hope to come back someday again here. Have fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A very beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely, the view of the Caribbean sea is amazing! This beach was very beautiful, our kid had a lot of fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach that you have to go and see when in Cancun!The day we went, the waves were a bit choppy, but it didn't faze us, we did swam in it!!!Tje only downside us that tgere is no shops ir restaurants around.  You do get people walking back and forth to ask if you would like a drink, a snack or fruits.They have palapas that you can use free of charge as the sun really hits you!We took the R1 bus which only cost us  about £3 for 2 adults and 2 kids.  It takes about 30 minutes to get to Playa Delfines. They have the Cancun sign if you want to take a picture  but be prepared to queue!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Strong waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pretty beach, really nice guy we rented the umbrella/chairs from. But we had to leave early as the waves were REALLY strong!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful a must see for sure just swing by its worth it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous stunning water. So beautiful it' s one of those beaches you have to go to just to enjoy the view. It's a public beach be warned it's still really safe though. There lots of police officers there it's a safe public beach. We got some awesome panorama shots of this place! also has a small kids park with swings! I enjoyed this beach its a must see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This neach has amazing blue colors, pictures do no justice.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is by far one of the best beaches there is, the different blue colors of the water is espectacular, the waves are not strong just right to get in and enjoy, water is not cold like the pacific just right. The 360 view of this beach will excite you, a must go visit place you will not regret!!.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but over rated. Police everywhere, got a feeling that it wasn't too safe to be on your own.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice calm beach with view of old pirate tourist ships
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are looking for a beach with minimal waves compared to other places, then this location is perfect. We stayed until sundown and really enjoyed watching the tourist boats. You can walk out quite a bit before it gets deep. Very relaxing for sure.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My Family went in July 2017 and this beach was simply breath taking - Ive never seen such an inviting area and the colours of the sea are unreal almost. Would come back here for sure and we highly recommend it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun sign - customary photo
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, with beautiful views though a little crowded.We took the cab here from our hotel but rode the bus back as there was one available every 3 minutes. If you wish to get a picture alongside the Cancun sign, be prepared to wait in line for 15-20 min during high season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking beach with full amenities!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was so nice to go somewhere in Cancun where there wasn't a cover charge, and even the parking attendant told us just to tip whatever we felt!  The prices for the sunbed and pina colada were much cheaper than compared to the rest of Cancun, and it will be my first port-o-call the next time I'm in Cancun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not sure if you need to be staying in a resort to access. This beach is beautiful. It's turquoise waters are inviting. Even though it was a bit crowded for my taste, it was high season and for that it isn't bad. Not too loud, just enough activities to have a go at jetskiing or parasailing but not so much it's overwhelming. Young kids love it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A stunning beach located in the main hotel district. Relaxing and a decent place for a quick swim during the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and safe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is an open beach in Hotel zone in Cancun which is really very clean and safe. unlike other beaches, there is a cover charge, here you just have to bring your own food and drinks and you can enjoy the beautiful Caribbean sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice public beach, Very clean. Full of tourists. No bar in the zone .Quite .If you are going early in the morning you cand find free fix beach umbrelas.bring your food and drinks with you.Clean water and save areas. There was a police patrol all day long.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Literally a 5 minute walk from our hotel (GR Solaris) and it was absolutely stunning! It is a free beach, so it can get crowded. Get there early to get an umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An early arrival is highly recommended
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were very fortunate to catch a redeye from Los Angeles to Cancun and we arrive in the early morning hours. We were very lucky to stumble on this beach when it was nearly isolated and enjoy stunning views. Luckily for us nearby was the con coon sign which had a line of two people ahead of us. As we enjoyed the entire trip and we drove up and down the main highway we would notice off at nine on these lines would be for people to take pictures. We got there early and it was definitely worth it I highly recommend the stop.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to this beach mostly because it's one of the only ones where you don't have to stay at one of the hotels on the hotel zone. Very clean beach and you can go for a lovely swim! There are a few parasols you can use for free but you have to be lucky to get one. Then you can lease two chairs and a parasol from one of the salesmen on the beach, but it cost 250 pesos (!!!!) which was way too much. We suspects it's more expensive for us because we are tourists (and it shows)...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: -Loved the Sign-
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach looked very busy compared to our resort beach.  The good thing was the Cancun sign and getting to see the lizards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous warm water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: By far my favorite beach! Luke warm water and white sand. Not overcrowded at all and the water is crystal clear. I cannot wait to come back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picture Perfect!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We didn't go to the beach but we did take a picture at the Cancun sign which was cool. We stayed at dream sands which was a bus ride away ($1 or 12 Pesos each way). It was definitely a good time passer and the pics came out great. There was a queue but it did go down quite quickly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over crowded... Or depends what aré you looking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To many people, that you cant enjoy the beach, the will charge you for every thing, there is no shade or chairs, beds, unless u birg yours blue turkish sea water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun .
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach and the famous cancun sign ...but expect  queues for a picture with it ..the beach is full of locals chilling in the sun and surf ..so it gets a bit crowded at times .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach day but very poor beach restaurants
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with an amazing pastel blue Colour of the sea. The beach restaurants have very poor quality of  food and really over priced. It is better to get your food with you or to plan your lunch somewhere else.Overall it is a very beautiful place to spend the day at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa delfines
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful just like any place in cancun i have been in different beaches in Mexico but cancun is my favorite i wish i can be the every year thank you people of cancun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Experiencing the local beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stop by the local beach to experience something different. Love the ambiance, Mexican are very friendly and very helpful as well.The water was clear, the sand is amazing, it was very calm when we visited it. Love the view, the Cancun sign for souvenir pictures. A most visit place while in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Say Cheese!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was pleasantly surprised that the beach wasn't overly crowded!  It wss very clean, had a small playground and I saw a few iguanas.  Most important, it is the beach with the colorful Cancun sign!  Great photo-op, but br prepared to wait in line a few minutes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful white sandy beach, turquoise waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sandy beach, turquoise waters, waters forever changing from so calm you can float and see your toes to very rough with a strong undertow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice turquoise waters and pretty good sand, behind the CANCUN sign, but be careful as the waves are strong, specially if you have kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautitful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach in Cancun, is at the hotel zone and its for free. The color of the sea is amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: awsome time at playa Delfines, kids has so much fun playing with the sand más swing, love that was close to cancun sign earlier in the morning its no line at all so we have the Pictures with no rush

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach but super crowded by locals on weekends
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you go to this beach during weekdays it is calmed and visited by tourists, if you go on weekends, you will have the tourists plus the locals, can get hectic on weekends, still pretty, safe and recommendable kids friendly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: perfect beach for family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Been there for few good hours. The water is beautiful and easy access to the beach. The packing is free, right above and watched. it's huge and not crowded so you can easily find a quiet place. I do recommended if you don't have a car to move around to much.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Photo Op
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to stop for a photo with the block CANCUN letters. Patrons form a line a patiently wait there turn. The public beach was nice and clean. The shower/bathroom area is not the best however, smelled of urine and the shower was more of a slow drip. Buses stop here frequently so travel to and from is fairly easy. Keep your eyes open you may see wildlife in the natural habitat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good waves and and overall nice looking beach. Lot of salesmen on the beach but that's to be expected. Beautiful beach though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFUL
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is beautifulIf you take kids be extremely vigilant, waves are very harsh.They have life guards on duty.Restrooms are free and so are the showers. Knocked off a star the showers drip the most minimal amount of water, hard to get clean. Great area to catch a bus It is very cleanCANCUN letter sign is there for selfies

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Colorful Cancun Sign & Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa delfines is a public beach with restrooms, lifeguard, and a great clean white sand beach. On this site is located the colorful Cancun sign in front of sea. We had to be in line to wait our turn to take pic, but went fast. Also you can see lots of iguanas! They offer limited parking space. Also across the street are located the El Rey Mayan ruins. Our hotel was a walking distance from this site, but can also take the bus (which it cost  around $1 dls pp). Playa delfines is a family activity and great spot for photos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My daughter caught sight of this beach as we were headed to our hotel from the airport. We barely stepped into our room and she wanted to headout to the beach.  So glad we did! We spent an amazing day at this beautiful spot playing in the waves and walking in the sand.  A must if you love the a day in the sun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Waves Blew Me Away!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Delfines is a very large beach that is easily accessible by the bus from the Hotel Zone. The beach is extremely spacious and is also monitored by a life guard. There are locals nearby that will fetch you a drink or a snack should the need arise.This is also the beach with the famous Cancun sign and many people like to take a photo of this. Personally I'm far more attracted to the waves and the sea but that's just me.I was very happy to be able to branch out and travel to this beach solo this trip and am looking forward to exploring more of this beach in the future.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best snorkelling  in cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is where the locals go and you can see why the sea is crystal clear and there are cheap places to eat and drink on the beach you can hire snorkelling kit form the beach or but your own from Wal-Mart as we did !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pretty good beach I liked it just wished there was less seaweed and more activities at the beach like jet skis, parasailing, and such. I mean this is suppose to be the best beach in Cancun. Overall water was great beach was clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can get here by the public bus or by taxi, also you can get a nice photo op with the Cancun sign.  The water here is beautiful and its a public beach so anyone can access the beach here.  All of the beaches of Cancun are lovely though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good photo op
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great place to play on the beach and take a great photo for the scrap book next to the CANCUN sign. Just a 10 peso buss ride away. you have this great public beach with nice white sand palm tree unbella shade and park toys for the kids.  the Elrey Ruins and across the roaD.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is endless and free to accessThere is free palapasBut some people will offer you chair/bed and umbrella for 200 pesos and they will offer drinks as wellThere is few things to eat to try for 20 to 30 pesos ( beach seller) And

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Calm clean and fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: weekend might busy, we liked it during the week, a lot of parking, we even liked the vendors that can bring whatever you like or need to your position

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is the best in Cancun and has a free parking, Cancun sign is there but the line is busy day and night to take a picture for your self there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was the first one we visited in Cancun.  When we got there by bus (very easy from downtown Cancun) we were greeted by a guy named Eric who asked us if we wanted to rent some chairs and if we wanted to buy some refreshing drinks. We said yes of course and planted ourselves there for 4 hours that day concluding with a meal of fresh fish and salad!  The beach was absolutely gorgeous and the colours were stunning.  The waves though were pretty strong and it got deep a little quickly but would definitely visit this beach again.  Every taxi driver we asked recommended this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've been to the Caribbean multiple times as well as Hawaii but nothing has compared to this beach! I'm used to crystal clear water but this beach isn't clear it's turquoise!!! And you can see different types of blues it's just a must if your in cancun or anywhere in Quinta Roo! Must better then playa de carmen

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Honestly I can't compare with another beaches because this was the only one we've visited there.Beach is very nice clean not much crowded, with showers which can use before you go back to Cancun.... Easily accessible by bus I think it's on 24th km of Kukulkan blvd.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most Beautiful Beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited this beach in April of 2017 while I stayed in Maya Riviera. It was the most beautiful swimmable beach. If you are in Cancun you cannot miss this one!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, safe, beautiful blue waters, only cost a dollar to get there by bus from the hotel zone. I walked back to my hotel and it was the most beautiful walk. So worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, golden sand and clear sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If visiting Cancun, this beach is definitely worth a visit. The sand is beautiful to relax on and there are a number of areas for beach football, volleyball etc and hundreds of loungers and umbrellas with no cost attached. Arrive early to get a photograph with the Cancun sign and bring food and drinks with you if you plan to stay for a while.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best public beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are visiting Cancun very fast, it worths stop here to enjoy the wonderful ocean view, also you can get a beach stretcher and a umbrella to fair cost in order to enjoy the white sand and crystalline water. There is a child playground but is out of service. It'd help if it's repaired soon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Public beach area not far from many Hotels in the zone. Km 19
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great Cancun sign, play area for kids. Elevated view of the Ocean. Popular with locals and tourist. Please help keep this area clean. there are areas of wildlife and flowers among the sand dunes. Has a parking area , or take the bus from your hotel. Great pic area!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Free beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Free parking places around the beach. You can take cover from the sand under straw umbrellas. Clean and tidy. Bad thing - sellers constantly patrolling the beach for tourists to sell fruits and drinks. Local folk doing some helping work in the region of the beach asking for tips

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Okay Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well first it's great compared to any other beach in the world, great color water wide sand and plenty of room. Compared to other Cancun beaches just okay to me. A little too rough to swim without danger here, and I like a smaller beach which Cancun has a plenty. They do have people selling things although at a high price, just was not my vibe for a 1/2 day with the family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Quite possibly among the top 5 most beautiful beaches I will ever see.   Even when the surf is rough, swimming is enjoyable.  The sand is white and very soft.  I walked a 4.5 mile stretch.  Most of the beach sits along private resorts.  The public part beach was beautiful but crowded.   It's probably not a great place to snorkel.  But the swimming was wonderful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took the bus from our hotel at the hotel zone to get a souvenir photo of the CANCUN signage.  A lot of tourists fall in line to take pictures but it moves fast and most tourists are helpful and would offer to take your group photo.  Breathtaking views! Don't be afraid to take pictures of iguanas if you see any. We only went here to take pictures and not swim so not sure about the facilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public Beach - Has CANCUN sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach located between hotels in the hotel zone.  It was located 1 hotel away from the Crown Paradise, where we stayed so we walked over on the beach. The CANCUN sign that everyone wants to take pictures with is located here.  (there was a line of people 25+ waiting to get pictures) There are little beach hut umbrellas that provide some shade.  There are beach bars set up on the one side of the beach, so if you need a drink or want to chill in a chair, you can. There is a small playground for kids, its kind of beat up but its good.  There are bathrooms and changing areas at the top, but you may have to pay to go in. There were a bunch of iguanas in the shrubs near the top, which my son was all about.  The beach was fairly clean, but I would try to walk in flip flops just in case there is glass or something.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sand and shade. Clear water too!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely large beach that has tons of room even when it's busy. The water itself is beautiful, but the waves are often quite intense so it's not the best if you want a leisurely swim. The R2 bus gets you there from downtown Cancun or anywhere in the hotel zone for really cheap. You can easily find a spot of shade under one of the umbrellas and there are bathrooms/showers available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It´s a big beach with really nice blue water. Recommend for good swimmers as there are strong waves. You can go parasailing; however, there is no food option.There are free huts/umbrellas to provide shade.It´s in the hotel zone; so, bus R1 and R2 run here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think it is the best public beach in this area. The water and sand are clean. Easy acess to bathrooms, options to rent beds and usually there is someone who sells water or snacks. Well, and the view...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is always busy with tourists alike trying to get a picture with the Cancun sign and having the background of the white sand torquiest water beach...it's all worth the 1 hour wait!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun in the Surf!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We travelled to this beach via ADO bus from our hotel in central Cancun. The beach was perfect - beautiful blue water,  soft, white sand, waves just the right size! Beach had many small palapas within which you could shelter from sun. Also, there were beach chairs to borrow for a small tip. There are no restaurants or food vendors, so bring snacks or a picnic if planning to stay a while.  There are beverage vendors (water, Coke, beer).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well worth the $2 bus ride to visit this beautiful beach, and get a picture with the Cancun sign!  (We were a little surprised at how long the line was to take a picture)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went here a few times, nice big beach with miles to walk down past all the hotels, lots of space and they have a roped off turtle nesting area to protect the turtle eggs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach that accessible to the public
reviewsWithKeywords.text: With the Hotel zone there are very few places to access the beach area.  This seems to be the largest and nicest public access point.  It has a great beach, very large and picturesque.  It has the classic Cancun sign that everyone wants to take their picture in front of.  It did seem to get busy but was never really packed, there was always lots of space on the beach.  Sure if you want to be near the road and access, with a beach umbrella then more people are there but you can walk a ways down and be with less people.  If you walk up the beach, just be warned that you have to return to the access point as the hotels won't let any non-guests exit out to the street unless they are staying there.  It might have just been the one we tried but they didn't let us go thru even though we didn't even look like we were coming from the beach.  There is bus stops right in front and easy to access.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach and the water is beautiful. Get there early as it can get busy for finding a place close to the entrance to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This is a gorgeous public beach, amazing sand and blue waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a well maintained clean public beach with good facilities, bathrooms, and showers.  Nice playgrounds for kids too. The beach is crowded with locals on the weekends. There is parking along the street but you might have to hike a ways from your car. It is very easy to just take the bus.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is the Classic Image of Cancun. The water with its different shades of blue are quite seductive, you can also appreciate often rainbows, when weather is auspicious. Be warned: if you are not a good swimmer, better enjoy in the beach, since currents and waves here can be treacherous. Not a place for Little Kids to swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Piece of paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited this area twice over 2 days. Large sandy beach with plenty of space. Lack of nearby shops, so be prepared and take food & drinks. There is a local consortium which will take you to the sun loungers and will offer drinks but be wary as they charge how they feel on the day. No showers to wash the sand off after you have been in the glorious sea! Sand gets everywhere. Well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was the longest beach I had ever seen, turquoise blue water,  soft clean white sand really inviting... Except for the waves and undertow. My husband an ex lifeguard didn't mind but I really didn't enjoy it as much. Wish I could have come on a less windy day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, Pay to Use Restroom
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are rocks on the beach that belong to the coral reef. Very neat.  The sand is not sand, it's broken seashells, so the sand does not get hot. The sand sticks to your body. I noticed a fire truck and a municipal police vehicle throughout the day. Made me feel safe! The waves are rough, and the flag hangs red. I am not sure if the flags are permanently red. I used the washroom. A man stopped me at the door and told me I had to pay for toilet paper if I wanted to use the washroom. He said he voluntarily mans the bathroom doors. Four squares is what I got for 5 pesos. Yes, he held the toilet hostage. Not cool. Lots of people take photos of the sign. I took it from the playground below. If you are lucky you can see an iguana too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach. There's always a long line to take  pictures at the Cancun colorful sign. Good view point to take awesome pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sand is perfect, you can ask for drinks & food on the beach. Sun beds are only a few, but is fine. Water has the perfect blue color that you've seen in the pictures. Totally need to go here. Also, while coming here, you can take some pictures with "Cancun" letter that can be found on the main street.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best bar - they make real cocktails !!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tried almost all beach bars in the hotel zone, most of them make light alcohol cocktails. Only on the Playa Delfines the bartenders do not spare the alcohol and make the real cocktails. Friendly waiters even run for the food to the other places. Excellent costumer service. Close to the CANCUN sign - where everybody stops for a picture.The beach is very open therefor very windy, the waves get really high, not safe for swimming even in the shallow water, make you stay on the sand and get burns :-(

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Km's of beach and blue-green water!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with pilapas, soft white sand and some local wildlife. Difficult to swim due to crashing waves better for the older stronger crowd.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful open beach with washroom and shower facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Huge beautiful public beach. Very well maintained. Location of the CANCUN sign. Heavy security around.  Chairs and umbrellas available. beautiful location to see both the Sunrise and Sunset!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wide Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very large, wide, public beach. It has a small parking lot and also a bus stop. Most tourists stop by to take a photo of the cancun sign, but the beach has easy access. All beaches are public in cancun, but hotels can limit the access to the beach from the street. This one is convenient.Also, there are plenty of vendors. They are not too aggressive. You can buy sun block, sun glasses, food, chairs, etc. Full service. The waives can be a little bit rough, but there are lifeguards.Also, watch out for your belongings when you go in the water, there are so many people and it is easy to "lose" your items.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Definitely the most beautiful beach in Cancún!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved this beach! The water is the most beautiful turquoise I have ever seen. You can rent an umbrella and chairs for 250 pesos for the entire day and they also offer drinks if you want to buy them. It is one of the most popular beaches so it can get busy, but it is absolutely stunning!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my favorites beaches. Do not miss a visit. The surf is strong throughout the year follows the recommendations of the lifeguards, children only on the shores. . The beach has beautiful views, it´s really clean and  very well maintained. The best public area of Cancun, easy to acces, with parking, lifeguards, palapas. showers and restrooms avaliable. Do not forget to bring your food and beverages becuase the vendors´prices are really high. The beach area is very extensive, the sea is not deep and has a swell that allows any recreational activities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very beautyful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Take the bus, coasts 10.5 pesos and the bus will take you directly to the beach. Very nice beach and clean beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach... good to visit, but don't wait on the sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach with a wonderful view and great for pictures too!  Well worth the visit, but I'd stay away from waiting for an hour or more to take a few snapshots at the sign.  There are plenty of other Cancun signs around and out of the hot blistering sun and that don't have 5,000 people waiting for you to finish.  We enjoyed very much stopping at the beach but opted not to do the photo for which we were so glad since we found signs down near market 28 that were very accomodating for us and even more festive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yellow sand for miles. Blue sea. Wow. Stunning! You really must come to see it. The sand is great and you get sun all day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very clean public beach for the family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited the Playa Delfines to get a nice picture w/ Cancun sign by the beach.  It can be easily accessed by taking the R1 bus that operates within the hotel zone.  We queued for about 30 minutes for a photo w/ Cancun sign and there are nice people willing to take your group photos. The beach is very beautiful, clean and I enjoyed the waves too.  There are kids playground, chairs and shade to relax.  Very nice beach scenery.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Public Beach at hotel zone!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just awesome! it's easy to get there by bus, it has free parking (sometimes can get full), Big CANCUN sign, but there is always people lining up for a picture (If you want to skip the line you need to go early in the morning or just go to Playa Langosta, there's barely a line to take a pic with the CANCUN sign)Beach is clean, BLUE water, smooth sand and you can keep walking most of the hotel zone from here. There is even some kind of observation deck at the entrance, where you can see the beach and take beautiful pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful centrally located beach. Long line to take photo by the iconic Cancun sign, but well worth it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this public beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Always make time when I am in Cancun to take the bus to thesouthern end of the Hotel Zone and spend time at this beautifulpublic beach. Has showers and amenities.Walk down to the  Club Med beach ( a very long walk though ), if you want to see  and swim in the best hotel beach in Cancun ( in my humble opinion. )

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself was lovely. The public toilets are manned (by a man!) who you have to tip if you want toilet roll. Luckily I already had some with me! 😂

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Glad we came here. Getting to Playa Delfines was easy and straight forward from downtown and hotel zona, just get R1 or R2 bus. The water was soooo blue and it was just picturesque. We got there early morning and it was much quieter if peaceful is what youre looking for. You'll see people trying to sell cocktails - we ordered some for about 140 pesos each thinking that was a bit too much until we saw how big the glasses were (there's a decent amount of alcohol in there all sitting at the bottom of the glass).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Delfines is one of the widest beaches I have ever been on, it is perfect for a group of people to go and play beach sports because there's a lot of space and it's not that crowded.The sea is quite aggressive here in comparison to the other beaches in Cancun but you can still go in it for sure.Only thing I disliked was all of the people asking you if you wanted a drink or food, I just wanted to relax but kept getting questioned but I guess that they're just doing their job..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breath taking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has the most amazing blue colored water, the view is incredible. The sand is white, there are umbrellas you can seat under. There is also the CANCUN sign that you can take pictures with the beach behind it. It's amazing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand! Good public beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good public beach. The surf can be very rough so watch your kids. A nice photo ops is there with the CANCUN sign.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I only spent a short time on the beach but this would be a wonderful place to spend the day relaxing under an umbrella. It was not busy when we were there in July and the crystal blue water was mesmerizing. This is definitely a great beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Delfines is a public beach. It's actually a nice breakaway from the crowded resort beaches if you need a break and a little more space. It's a $3 taxi ride from most places.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a bus from our hotel Riu peninsula and it was $3 for all of us. It's about 9 miles from the hotel and very easy to hop on a bus. It was wiry it! Gorgeous beach. Cute tiki umbrellas. Lots of iguanas. There was a nice line for the sign to take pictures of and some people were obnoxious taking a million pics in a million different poses but it's worth it. Overall I'm glad we stopped! Maybe next time we can hang out for a few hours on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view is amazing. The water is beautiful. And it's free. It's a local hang out with food venders. It's right on the bus route in the southern part of the hotel zone. You will pass it as you come to the hotel zone from the airport

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of my favourite beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've been to many different Caribbean islands, including Bahamas, Jamaica, D.R., etc, and I have to say that this has been my favourite beach to spend the whole day. I've stayed in a resort about 20 minutes by bus away, and found myself returning to this beach twice. After my first stay, I decided to even buy a cooler and some beers for my second visit. Absolutely worth it... It's not very touristy and there's such a nice vibe going on. Can't wait to return someday...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is less touristy and you can rent loungers for free. We were served monster sized margaritas too. Unfortunately, we could only go in up to our knees because the riptide was so strong. It was SO stunning though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing View!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great time with the family I love the fact of ceviche is made there also enjoy micheladas sooo good!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Caribbean sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Turquoise warm water and clean white sand. One of the best beaches around! Sunbeds are available for free until 3pm in exchange for a proof of ID but must be collected and returned from a hut. Guys walk up and down the beach offering a food and drink service as well as fresh fruit. Reasonably priced.Cancun sign beside the beach is a busy spot for tourists photo opportunities with queues likely all day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredible before noon.  After that LOTS of people!!  Average infrastructure, good idea to take with you food and beverage

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Has one of many 'CANCUN' signs for tourists. Get in line, though! Lots of people stop here to get their pictures taken.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place to visit, you have to see it in person, the pictures don't do it justice. You can spend the day there, taking pictures, hanging out with friends and family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Looks like a great, family beach spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our time share resort is a short walk from this public beach. We were very impressed to see the improvements to the beach when walking by there this year. The beach is on the south side of the hotel zone, with good wave action if that's your preference. If you want calmer waters head for the "top of the 7" shape of the hotel zone. There are great photo spots and picnic and playground areas on the top of the sandy hillside between Avenue Kukulkan and the water, including restrooms. A short walk down to the beach reveals a wide beach with palapas and crystal blue Caribbean waters that those in hotels nearby are paying top dollar to enjoy. A great option for enjoying the best of the Caribbean waves and beach if you are not interested in paying  top dollar for your hotel accommodations. Due to its beauty it is crowded on weekends and parking is limited to plan to visit during the week, arriving early on the weekend or taking the convenient public bus system to get there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Delfines visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On February 22nd, 2017, I visited the beach of Playa Delfines. The water is beautiful, the sand is so pretty and white, there was no congestion, the beach was very clean, easy access to and from the beach, public transportation readily available, hut type coverings if people desire to be out of the sun, lifeguards and security on duty. Excellent place to visit individually or with family and friends.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Best Beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The turquoise waves, fine sand and view of the unspoiled Caribbean sea make this the finest beach in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach, did not see sealife
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is pristine, but don't be disappointed if you don't happen to see the dolphins or turtles you hope for. They will not be around with so many people!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public Beach, Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After accessing other public beaches in Cancun, we finally arrived at Playa Delfines.  Very to go to by public bus, the drivers, even if they don't understand English, will tell you where to exit the bus.  There is shade provided by the Palapas, the sand is very soft and clean, the water beautiful and there are lifeguards!  A nice feature too is that there are public bathrooms on site.  Altogether a great experience!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: " Great place for sunrise"
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a bus from our hotel . Sunrise was amazing and I had never seen before. The ocean was beautiful blue color.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: one of the most beautiful beaches ever?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We live way around the corner and up the road, on the ocean...and we usually take visitors over to show them this beach.  Maybe just from the viewpoint, or maybe down for a walk-along.  Might be too wavy for swimming / wading but sure is pretty!It is a photo-op in itself.  It was my screensaver for a long time after my first visit here with my  then new partner years ago, and I especially, have had friends there several times over the past couple of months.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach but get there early
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach/water area is clean and very sandy. Get there early if you want to rent a palapa or chairs.  Parking is limited so another reason to get there early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: CLEAN BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the weather was good, it was a clean beach not to many people selling stuff, so it was to kick back and enjoyrestrooms were fairly nice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: super torist but still fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So we wanted to see the colorful Cancun sign they had on the beach area. We took a taxi there and played about for a bit. We didn't have a lot of time but it was strill fun to head down to the beach and walk in the sand and take some fun pictures. If you are looking for a beach to relax at and your hotel doesn't have one then this is the place to be.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: holliday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to go with the family, the weather is always great we loved the food and its always clean.  Lots of places and things to do with the entire family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Idyllic beach.... but being your own supplies
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful clean beach with golden sands and gentle waves.  Away from hectic 'hotel zone' but beware NO restaurants /bars here so bring your own supplies. R1 bus stops right outside. 'Cancun ' colourful beach sign also here... be prepared to queue for shot!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clear turquoise water with crashing waves.  Relaxing and safe atmosphere where you are not  harassed by locals trying to sell you stuff.  You can enjoy sun bathing, playing in the waves or walking the beach for miles....don't forget to take a memorable photo with the Cancun sign! Don't bother visiting the other public beaches, does not compare!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Lovely Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a hotel downtown which did not have a beach, so while driving around town we just stumbled upon Playa Delphines.  There is free parking which is made  easy because there is an attendant who will direct you to a spot.  The beach has some facilities like a place to wash the sand off, toilets, tables, etc.The beach itself is lovely and a great place to enjoy Cancun if you stay in a hotel that does not have beach access.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and chill
reviewsWithKeywords.text: During our stay in Cancun,  we visited Playa Delfines. It was a nice, chill place to relax, get wet, and walk around. Very beautiful and great for pictures!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ah-mazing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful shades of turquoise, aqua, and indigo as far as the eye can see! Extremely clean beach! Lots of pelicans diving for their food! Five stars!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took the bus (great value) from our hotel down to this beach. The beach at our hotel had very calm water, but Play Delfines had a lot of nice waves for body surfing. Besides, it's just a beautiful spot. We just took towels and sat on the beach, but you could rent chairs if you wanted to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed on the lagoon side and came here for a beach day. Very easy to get to via the public bus. Beautiful white sand beach with plenty of palapas, bathrooms and vendors selling food and drink( we loved the fresh fruit for 25 pesos). Free beach chairs available from the storeroom below the stairs, just leave an id for each chair you use. Great mix of tourists and locals all having fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This is where the Cancun Sign is
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Want to take a picture by the Cancun Sign... this is where you find it... you can also hang out on the beach which seems very local and touristy .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you wanna get beautiful pictures this is the perfect place. Here in Cancún is one of the best and favorite beaches  and it is you can have a good time with your friends and family. Recommendations. -Don't forget your sunscreen -the place is not the best one to go swimming- the beach has the blue flag certification (of you wanna carry your drinks don't take the ones in glass. Is not allowed) - it is very popular between tourist and local people so maybe you will stay with a lot of kids and adults- if you are going to swim take care of your sunglasses  (the waves usually are routh)-have a nice time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public Beach- Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a GREAT public beach, free parking and more gentle waves than other areas.  Snacks available but bring your own picnic and spend the day.  *****

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great uncrowded beach, appeared to be more locals than tourists. There are working bathrooms which we apprciated and many thatched umbrellas for respite from the hot sun. All the ingedients are there for a great day at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we went to this wonderful pubic beach, from our resort Great Parnussus.  We had our pictures taken on the CANCUN sign and a fantastic drone sky selfie done!  AMAZING.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and Free
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful public beach - make sure to snap a picture at the colorful CANCUN sign!  The sand is clean and the water is gorgeous!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice public beach
