reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is where the CANCUN sign is at on the southern part of the hotel zone. We were there for over an hour and there was a constant line to take pictures. But it's a nice, fairly clean public beach with good access and parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Biggest beach in Hotel zone with strong undercurrent. Nice white sand and good place for walk. Full of mostally mexican crowd.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach, although only for experienced swimmers.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice and clean beach, all free. Watch out for some deep holes and huge waves most of the time. Heed the warning flags when necessary. A real gem in the Hotel Zone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Underwhelming!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself is typical to all Mexican beaches; white sand, turquoise seas etc. The famous Cancun sign is located here, blocked by a half a kilometre line of tourists waiting to have their photo taken in front of it. I passed this site at different times of the day and it appears the best time to visit to get a clear photo without standing hours in a queue is at first light dawn and nighttime post sunset. There are informative signs regarding the wildlife and protection of the area, however it seems many have ignored the instructions relating to garbage disposal resulting in the lack of wildlife present in this area. Such a shame this site has been ruined by ignorant tourists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Came here for the view and to get our picture with the Cancun sign. You line up and have your picture taken with the sign. Worth a visit. There is limited free parking and there are police keeping us all safe. Be aware of tip collectors to keep an on your parked car for you even though there was enough police around.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to get a nice family picture of the cancun sign.  Made a quick visit for picture but the beach looked nice and had playground for kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach, and great fun too
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was clean and had bathrooms and showers, all free. The beach itself is fantastic and beautiful, and the waves although a bit tall and strong, provide great fun to be had while swimming. I loved every second of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand, views, & crowds
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sweeping views, a sandy, clean beach, and a colorful iconic sign mark this public beach.  On the upside bathrooms are available, but the area can be crowded, especially around the sign.  However, the price is right -- free.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must take a pic with the Cancun sign!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is really pristine! The Cancun sign is the main attraction here. The tourists are so organized, there is a line to take pictures with the Cancun sign and everyone is patient about all the groups taking their time to pose and click pictures. We went there on a sunday noon, took the R1 bus from our hotel- Omni Cancun, which was a short 5 minute ride. Once we got down, we went to the Cancun sign and waited around 20 minutes for our turn. While we waited, we sat on the benches at the curb side. There was also ample parking and cops keeping a watch at the people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach! It's wide enough so that you can do pretty much any activity you want. The only thing about this beach is that there are usually big waves, there's a strong current, which means there's a lot of undertow. I'd recommend perhaps not going alone, just to be safe. There are usually people there, but it's better to be safe than sorry. Of course, avoid going to deep into the ocean. Overall, it's one of my favorite beaches in the city.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Self explanatory. I went snorkeling  with turtles it was amazing. The water was amazing and my instructor was the best.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent public beach !!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: very nice place and its a must visit place while in cancun. Nice location to take pictures. The waves are high so you have to be carefull in water. There is CANCUN symbol where you will find long queue for taking pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The rough tumbling waves make a magnificent sight. Don't worry there are life guards around to warn you not to go any further. Moreover, they always put up flags (red for no swimming and yellow for swimming). The beach is clean and white ! No cheap food available here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach. Always a breeze. We had plenty of shaded places to sit and read during the day. If you're into just sun, there's plenty of that as well! The flags on the beach indicate whether swimming is advised and our hotel had a lifeguard on watch all the time. Lots of people walking on the beach, enjoying the surf. All ages from kids to grandparents were enjoying the sun and the water. The water is a beautiful blue and we couldn't get enough of the sound of the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have never seen a beach more beautiful. We were able to find a quiet-almost private area of the beach every day of the week. Local vendors serve huge, strong drinks for  ~$5-7USD each. Public chairs and umbrellas available - never had trouble finding any if you are willing to walk around. TIP: bring your own TP and sanitizer - public washrooms were clean but lacking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bring our own TP!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My family and I were staying a short walk from this beach  this past Novemember. We walked down to this portion of the beach one day and disovered a childrens playground, exercise equipment and a small public washroom.  My children , husband and I played around on it all for a bit. When one of my children needed to use the facilities, I took her up to the ladies washroom which was being attended to by a lady. It was clean and smelled clean BUT there was no toilet paper in the stalls. I tried in my broken Spanish to negotiate with the lady that I needed some TP for my child and she indicated $$ was required. It was that day that made me remember to always carry some wet wipes or TP with me whenever I venture away from the hotel. The beach is beautiful and the view is beautiful. There are palapas available, and new ones were being installed the day we were there. Some were even marked as handicapped. The lineups for the CANCUN sign were beyond ridiculous and so we did not go back to take our picture there.I

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach ..early is the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach in Cancún .. if you want to enjoy go early at 8am .. free parking area or whatever public bus bring you here for 1usd ... remember to take with you water beers and something for eat .. don't have shops close !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 100% must see when in Cancun, such a beautiful view and charming atmosphere with white sandy beaches and blue waves 🌊

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best view ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely view, nice ambiance, nice place to have a Cancun pic to remember the trip.Locals very friendly but needs to improve parking spaces.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing View.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the few beaches where is locals can visit. The hotels don't let locals have access to the beaches.The view is amazing. The water is a little dangerous to swim in due to currents. This beach is used mostly by locals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Strong waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was there in March and there were danger flags. You couldn't swim and lifeguards were all over whistling to those who were swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Picture perfect beach and sea, great place for walk/sunbath.Nice view of Cancuns hotels in background.It was quite breezy during our stay so sea was bit rough and no one was swimming. Couple of small car parks besides main road if you coming by car. To take picture with Cancun sign and avoid queues will need to come early before 10 am.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely gorgeous beach! Blue waters, blue skies, white sand & the water is warm it was a little windy but the view was all worth it. I can't get enough of this place, they have people walking around asking if you want to buy alcoholic beverages as well, here you can drink right on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best public beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely the best public in Cancun - nice beds and umbrellas that work with "tips" You don't pay a price - you leave your id and when you get back with the beach bed you pay "tips". Sanitary is very clean and you can by big drinks but no food or snack so bring your own.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a View
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great view from the road of the beach and ocean below. A bit of a walk to get on the beach but worth it. White sand and beautiful water. Be careful in the water, it can get very rough. Great beach to people watch. There is parking by the road but get there early. There are great sunrises here from the road or the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing View!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you go to Cancun, you need to visit this. The area have facilities, parking, and security.  Also they had rental chairs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beaches, beautiful place.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just gorgeous and picturesque beach, not sure about swimming as life guards would not let people beyond certain point.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Worth visiting , just for the view ! This is where people queue to get their photos taken with the famous cancun sign

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach !! Must visit for tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very beautiful, perfectly located in between the airport and hotel zone. Parking is available. You may have to walk a bit if you dont get a space at the nearby parking though. This place has a colorful CANCUN board which is pretty neat and a must for all the tourists :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Serene, with plenty of space
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a pretty beach with plenty of restrooms. It's also free, but has limited parking. The restrooms close at around dusk fyi. So if you're swimming past dusk and really need to go, a number 1 in the ocean would be your only option.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and public!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful public beach with free palapas (umbrellas) and beach chairs!! We were so excited to find a beach where they don't charge a fortune to use the beach chairs and umbrellas- in fact, they are free! Just bring an ID to leave with the chair people and you can use them until 3 pm! Get there early to get a spot under one of the permanent umbrellas and enjoy your day! The beach has lifeguards who are strict about where it is safe to swim (there can be some waves but not bad)- the water is perfect and crystal clear! There aren't any stores around so bring food and there are guys walking up and down the beach selling overpriced drinks. There is a public bathroom and showers. If you aren't staying in a hotel on the beach this is a great beach to spend the day at! And the buses pass by frequently all day long!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over your selfie or family picture here
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Go here to get your picture with the Cancun sign.  I'd recommend doing it at sunset for the best lighting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Shark
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach however the day we went there was a shark siting which later I was told is very unusual. We weren't allowed in the water after that.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Local beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice getaway from the beach at the resort. You are able to take the $1 bus to this location. Take a beautiful picture with the Cancun sign

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful blue beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a bus from the condo where we were staying (beside Barcelo hotel) to Playa Delfines in the afternoon. The ocean was such a fusion of many beautiful shades of blue. I never saw anything like that before and the best part is that it's a public beach and access is free. As we went later in the afternoon, the beach was very crowded we were unable to find an umbrella. We ended up renting an umbrella, a table and chairs from a group of men serving food and drinks for the rest of the afternoon. We noticed that some stretches of the beach were off limits as the water was deeper there and the currents were strong. It was fun playing in the water where there were a lot of other people as well. The beach had many lifeguards on duty and we saw them rescue quite a few people who got dragged into the ocean by the rip currents in the 3 hours we spent there. I would recommend visitors to follow the warnings and instructions of the life guards at all times while here. I would love to go back to this beach on our next visit to Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sunrise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The place is awesom,great beach, for the family and kids, bunch of seagulls. i do not know hat else to write.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: finding umbrellas can be a challenge. Always ask for the price before renting. There are people selling drinks on the beach, but they are not as strong as you would expect them to be for the price you pay. The waves can be treacherous at places, but there are a lot of life guards alerting people of such spots.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful fist stop!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: At this beach you will find the famous Cancun word to take the "has to" first picture at Cancun. It is a beautiful public beach, it is child friendly and the ruins "El Rey" are on a walking distance from the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked over there from KM 19'5 on a cloudy Day; The Beach looked nice ; there is a Playground for Kids; Restrooms - for Disabilities too- they were closed - but I think you must have a Key ; in the Front are 2 Guys and checking the entree Peoples. They have a little Bar on the Beach - but we didn;t enjoy it - it was starting raining .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clear water and sand. Had a lovely time here. Waves can be a bit strong, wouldn't bring kids to swim here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went to Playa Delfines on the bus, travelling on a bus is an experience !!  We told the bus driver where we wanted to go and he told us when we got there, good job as we were enjoying the views and would have missed our stop. We joined the queue to have our photos taken with the CANCUN sign and then went on the beach for a couple of hours before catching the bus back to our hotel.  The beach is gorgeous, very clean with white sand. The sea was quite rough but safe. Definitely recommend a trip here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clear water, public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful public beach in Hotel Zone. No boats to obstruct view of ocean. There were lifeguards on duty at certain points of beach and colored flags to indicate swimming safety. Beach also had shower stations and bathrooms.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another breathtaking beach in the Yucatan
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I would have never known of the Dolphin Beach or Playa del Delfines, had our guide not suggested we stop by on our way out of town.  We got to spend about 45 minutes here and it was perfect.  The sand is pure white, the waves are crashing (a red flag day!) and there was plenty of room to spread out.  I used the time to relax and listen to the sea coming in contact with the shore, then receding again.  We were told that Dolphin Beach is the prettiest one in all of Cancun, and I believe it!  If you are interested, it's just beyond the big, colorful Cancun sign.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Free lounge chairs!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach I've been to out of the 4 that I've already been to in Cancun. There are ample straw umbrellas to sit under. They offer free lounge chairs (we tipped the guy who worked there). There are also vendors walking around selling fresh fruit, food, and drinks of all kinds. We had the fresh fruit and later got a taco dinner plate (3 tacos w/ rice, salad and salsa). Everything was delicious. He beach was clean and we were able to lay out in our chairs without anyone bothering us. Plus the famous Cancun sign is located here. There is always a super long line though. So be prepared! Would definitely come back to this beach!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: its a decent beach and CANCUN symbol for photo
reviewsWithKeywords.text: its a decent beach and CANCUN symbol for photo. If you are at a hotel without beach, go here. But hotel beaches are kept more clean. SO we just went here to take CANCUN symbol photo. Long queue, so go probably early in morning. we should have just stayed happy with CANCUN symbol in hotel itself. combine with El-Rey trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Riu Cancun, which had very little beach in front of the hotel.  However, for 10.5 pesos, we took the bus a few miles to Playa Delfines.  It is a very wide beach with big waves.  This is a public beach location and so there were many locals enjoying the beach with us.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cool and enjoyable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What do I say about this beautiful place,.. When ever I see beach I just sway in cool vibe's direction and you know there every facility is available like sun bathing, dining or lunching and basketball court.. We enjoyed all and sunset can be seen here in a gorgeous way.. Beach lovers must see this also and have great time doing your activities...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice locals beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Family and local oriented. Free palapa covers and some seating. Great place to bring a picnic and enjoy the Caribbean water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Walk by the sea !!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place has the famous CANCUN colorful sign, where you need to wait in the line to click pictures !! It's free of cost and a nice memory. It's a open public beach. Nice to walk around and it's kids friendly too. Enjoyyyyy.. watch out for live Iguana's they are not wild nor harmful. Just there and living... So live and let live !!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Public Beach with Parasailing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand beach with facilities and easy access to parasailing at either end.   Recommend Skyrider Parasailing close to the Iberostar Hotel

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Some spots leading to the beach smelled like  urine. The beach itself has lots of little rocks so you can't barefoot it here. It seems more like a local beach. There are far better beaches in Cancun. Not worth the trip that we made to get here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Most incredible and beautiful beach ever seen!  The sand is almost white and the water is a turquoise blue water.  Beautiful for pictures.  Did not go in, did not have my suit on :(. Recommend

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach. I thought it would be calmer but the current was stronger than I thought it would be.I loved the little guys walking around offering beers - margaritas and food. Nice place for a day. A must visit if you are in cancun. I hated how in the hotel area you have no beach access unless u are staying at one of the big hotels it is hard to get to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach with plenty of things to watch and do
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach features many restaurants where you can use their loungers and umbrellas for the cost of a drink. Bathrooms are clean and free with a wristband from the restaurant. Many locals with children spending a Sunday afternoon at the beach along with us tourists. Small shops, a convenience store, ATM, close by. Live music played. We watched bungee jumping over the ocean from the pier nearby. Very nice outing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Public beach almost at the end of Cancun's hotel zone. You can find the CANCUN picture sign here if that's what you're after in your traveling. There's a couple of spots you're not allowed to go into the water, but the Lifeguards will let you know in case. There are a few palapas if you don't mind being far from the actual shore. It can get crowded, but the beach is quite long so it shouldn't be a problem.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun city sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: great place for pictures, nice walk from hotel along beach, this beach is not crowded and very large, locals selling excellent fruit cups in afternoon which is very refreshing, even when theres a line to take pictures it goes fast

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unlucky with the weather
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I only had one day in Zona Hotelera, and was told this was the best beach to visit. The water was very choppy, with a stronger-than-expected rip, probably due to the recent hurricane south of here. Therefore the total experience was disappointing. However, the white sand beach was nice, and not crowded in November.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very lovely, clean beach. Only problem it rained both times we were on it! Would love to go again once it's sunny!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So much fun!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach with many locals to interact with. The water was wavy but swim-able. The beach service was great and the litre beer was definitely worth the money. I'd for sure go back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice swimming place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Whitw sand and blue blue water.you can swimm and get a sun all day long.Very nice place but a lot of people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking Views!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped at Playas Delfines before making our way to our hotel. Our driver was right, is a must to stop there. The turquoise waters were to die for and the water magnificent. I would definitely recommend this beach to anyone visiting the Cancun area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best public access beach in the Hotel Zone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best public access beach on the Hotel Zone strip. Went there for a quick stop one a sunny afternoon to take pictures against the azul waters of the Caribbean. The colorful  CANCUN letter are a great spot for a picture. Overall nice for a picninc/ evening stroll.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a really beautiful beach but with very rough waters. Don't recommend this one if you have kids, we went there and didn't go in the water, it was very dangerous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful though popular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Many people come to this beach despite having beaches in front of their own hotel as it is nice.   Free changing rooms, bathroom, palm beach umbrellas.  Many people flock to have their picture taken in front of the Cancun sign which turns into a long slow moving line.  Recommend going early to get this picture to avoid the longer line.  Good beach but I would rather be on the hotel beach with the open bar.  Nothing else special here.  Can be wavy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MOST AMAZING VIEW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best view! And Beach! GORGEOUSThe cancun sign is here and it's only 30 pesos to catch the bus here. Take the R1 or R2.  Definitely worth the visit if your staying at a resort that's further down and lacks the best beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Weekend vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Relaxation at its best! Beautiful weather warm water and friendly people makes me want to visit cancún more often.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, but one thing to have in mind
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is breathtaking, although the sea is usually pretty wavy!However, have in mind there are no restaurants (only one, as I noticed, and VERY priceeey!), so make sure to bring what you need if you're staying for the whole day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very clean and scenic. The water was cool and refreshing. However, come early if you would like to take a photo in front of that CANCUN sign because people will stand in line taking turns to snap their pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited this beach as an alternative to the one that was at the hotel and I'm so glad I did.The sand was amazing, the water was nice and warm, if a little too rough to swim in. But I loved the fact that there were free parasols to use on the beach.I spent an enjoyable 4 hours here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really beautiful beach, deap blue and azure sea, well worth a visit.Jump on the bus from anywhere in the Hotel Zone, bargain at only $1 pp, and head for Playa Delfines (Dolphin beach). The beach is beautiful, loads of turtle nests and iguana's lying in the sun. Definately worth a visit it is lovely. (Kept clean by the hard working guys picking up litter, bottles and stray coconuts).Walked back along the main road to our hotel (about 2mikes), lots of wildlife spotting on either side. Tip - try to walk on the side so you face oncoming traffic, you will avoid beeps from the busses and taxis.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing azure waters and a white sand beach. The waves can be big and rough for swimming, but the view is astounding. Conveniently located along the main bus route in the Zona Hotelera and near the El Rey archeological site and Museo Maya, it is easily accessible and definitely worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: delightful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: happened upon this beach it was very nice spacious good waves changing rooms just a delightful day.i would recommend it to one and all

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for all , beautiful place for pictures , walk with your umbrella for the heat.Just hope on the bus and let it take you there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great relaxation and snorkeling. Highly recommended and nice beach. Can't wait to visit again and enjoy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Well kept beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is well kept. If you have a rental, heads up, parking is very limited. It is best if you take the bus to this place. There is a bus stop right in front. Also, this has a famous land mark. There is a large sign that says "Cancun". People line up to take their photo with this sign. Again, get their early. The lines can get fairly long. We saw a family having their photo taken with their nationality flag.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, big waves..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is amazing. Sun is shining, sand is white Some surfers around. People are chilling there. Nobody disturbs you. When i was there waves are big and there was red flad means forbidden to swim cuz dangerous. Unfortuanete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice free beach, with great sand. It is the most popular beach in Cancun. The sunsets are beautiful. Many stores and restaurants along it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful, clear, clean, FREE public beach I've seen
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a 15-minute, 12 peso bus ride from downtown Cancun. In stark contrast to the "upscale" tourist-trap hotels along the Hotel Strip, this is an oasis of simple beauty and enjoyment.Pack a cooler; there are no bars and restaurants on this pristine public beach, but there ARE police officers present for your security, washrooms and fresh water rinse-off stations, and perhaps a mile of unending white sand and crystal clear, swimming-safe water.It is very well-maintained by the state, and one of the highlights of Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice walking area.Nice planted, well paved walkways. You could actually walk quite a way on Kukulkan. There are also a number of views of the beach and many stores and eateries

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great spot even on a rainy day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Must spot is staying anywhere near the hotel area in Cancun, lots of restaurants and interest spots for tourists in close proximity, great public transport

reviewsWithKeywords.title: this view..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have never seen something what I saw on this beach.. Incredible view and this water, so hot. I'm in love and this is my number 1 of the views in the world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFUL PUBLIC BEACH WITH NO HOTEL!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach! They have added palapas for shade. Nobody selling you stuff for the most part. Guy comes around offering drinks, or fresh fruit. Peaceful, not so many tourists because it is at the end of the Hotel Zone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Had a nice walk along the beach.  Windy day, lots of room. Bathrooms were alright. Rusty gym equipment available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful picture location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Its always nice to come here and take picture with sign and they have bathrooms. Its a perfect meet up location for this staying in different locations. The water is just as beautiful as the resorts a bit down. Just a bit  more seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Picturesque beach with white, soft sand and turquoise waters! We had a beautiful day here, sunbathing and swimming in the sea! People are walking around selling drinks and some parasols are available, although not many! Definitely worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach in Cancun by far.  Its right on the bus route. Its very clean well maintained.  You gotta visit there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a gem!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I live this beach it does have everything to offer, clear, clean turquoise water, clean white sand beach and beautiful weather complements this all every day! You must visit this beach if you are in cancun! I am still dreaming of going back there one day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very very nice beach specially if you like pictures... it has the tradicional Cancun sign so it is really nice to take a picture for your memories!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Cancún
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are no many options without access restrictions from big Hotels so this is, in my opinion, the best and biggest free beach in Cancún. With white sand and clear turquoise water. There is also local vendors were you can get a nice Margarita.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beach... What a view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For sure,  the best beach in Cancun. And the view is stunning... So beautiful. Great photo opportunities.  Don't miss this if in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesome "CANCUN" sign there to take pictures with the backdrop of the beach. Gets crowded in the evening, especially on the weekend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Calmer Beach on Hotel Zone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach, that beach is way more calmer than most of the beaches in the main hotel zone,  while still being located in the vicinity and you being able to take the public transit to get there.   It's a public beach but it so much more awesome bc the waves are so much calmer that it almost appears like you were are in a different area of Cancun completely.   I would definitely recommend it after visiting Island of Mujeres if you have time as a chill day in between a mall day.... :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wanted to see what all the hype was about so took the local bus down. The beach is stunning and the sand lovely and soft. The beach is rough as it faces the open waters of the Carribean Sea. I didnt allow the family to swim in it however it would be great fun for older children who won't get bowled over. It is worth a visit as there are multiple photo opportunities as well as the must do tacky tourist picture with the colourful Cancun sign.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Endless looking paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing clean water, white beautiful sands. You can enjoy the silence and the beauty sunbathing, reading a book, and such. Just a little thing, the sea is a bit wavy so pay attention if you have kids with you and you might wanna bring some snacks and beverages cause there are not any place you can buy. Only every once in a while, some guys walking around selling water and other beverages.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great public beach on the Hotel Zone strip in Cancun. Lots of locals on the weekend. It's clean and safe and there are covered spots as well for shade. Change rooms and bus stop all right there.  Great for families and kids as there are life guards available too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day out of the Hotel.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Came here with my Partner as it was recommended to us by our Thomson holiday rep. Very big and not very busy. I was asleep and mmy partner was in the sea and noticed two men hanging around where we were sitting and from then they wouldnt leave and they kept looking at us. As we were out of the hotel and not many people were around at the time we didnt feel very safe so didnt stay for very long. The CANCUN sign is there though and good to get a quick picture with :) No dolphins were spotted :(

reviewsWithKeywords.title: photo spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful site for photo shots. Should have a guide on site for group photos and perhaps sharing historical information.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent a whole day here by taking bus from downtown Cancun and loved it. Lots of Palapa's for shade and showers an change rooms. We loved to play in the waves but were a little scared at first. They would throw you around and it was a lot of fun. Had a cooler with beer an sandwiches an water. Great way to spend the day and this beach is great. Watch the kids if you have them as the waves are big. Highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved it. White sand and blue water. Nice place to go and take a few pictures. Take drinks with you since stuff sold around is very expensive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Got a boat tour to see the coral reef!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was clean and the sand was soft. Got to ride on a boat and snorkel in the 2nd largest coral reef in the world. The staff was very helpful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a free public beach with restrooms, a little outdoor gym area, and palapas.  You do have to bring your own chairs.  It's right next to the Iberostar hotel and the best part is the Cancun sign is right in front of it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue flag beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean beach which is great for tourists and locals alike the multi coloured Cancun sign is a tourist trap and people queue day and night to have their picture taken here,no hassle and friendly faced locals take your own drink food and make the day of it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever been. Cristal clear water, wonderful white sand, good facilities, parking and location.Great for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Delfines to explore is worth a short look
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is beautiful but Swimming is not allowed most of the time, not sure why but I guess is because they are sharks around. The beach is beautiful and has character. Ist a public beach and accessible to the public. There is a watch Tower with a guy in it. He speaks only spanish so if you only speak english like us just say hi and smile! The waves are quite choppy and there is not much shelter from the blistering heat. So the few thatch umbrellas are mostly occupied or under repair. We just went down there out of curiosity but didn't stay very Long. It is worth a short visit to check it out and take a Picture with the Cancun rainbow sign.We didn't do it because People by the bus load stop by just to take a photo there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Cancun, but don't waste your time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've been here twice in different months and both times were meh. The beaches south of PdC are much better. This beach us easy to get to on the bus (bus R1) and it has showers- that's great. But the water is sticky and cloudy. The sand is too deep and hard to walk on. The boulders are difficult to navigate on. I didn't have a problem finding a shady umbrella both times, but it would have been nice if there were a drink vendor nearby- it's too crowded to be a relaxing beach, so a little more fun or music or anything would do it well. Just go to Akumal, Xpu Ha, or Tulum instead. You will never waste another day in Cancun once you do.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome public beach with a view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While you're in Cancun, make sure that you visit Playa Delfines beach. Take a photo of the colorful Cancun sign, and enjoy the awesome view and clear blue waters. It's a clean public beach, and you are allowed to bring drinks (beer...etc) with you.TIP : take the public bus, it's only 10 pesos, and they will drop you off right there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing. Its the classic "Caribbean" beach. Super blue oceans, nice waves, swimmable water. Everything about this beach is amazing. The sand is perfect. I brought some home too for my collection. If you are in Cancun you need to come here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise found!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our first beach we came to in our 2 week Mexico holiday and we were stoked!!It's a bummer you have to travel so far down the hotel zone to get to it, this is what makes me not like Cancun so much, but once you get there all is forgotten. It's such a nice beach, plenty of space on the sand for chilling out and we managed to get under one of the permanent grass umbrellas which was awesome. We took some food and beers as we were told there are no food places around and this made it a really enjoyable day, as we didn't have to move from our spot - maximum relaxation!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are staying on Zona Hotelera, you must go, beautiful beach with nice sand, and the water is just perfect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet but strong waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived in the afternoon at it was quiet, it wasn't crowded and you can enjoy a free 'palapa' or the umbrellas (if available). There are facilities close to the main road, here is where the sign CANCUN is located and there is always a line up of people taking pictures... be patient.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach. Lots of seaweed. There is a bar and fresh water showers and clean restrooms. Beautiful scenery.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach Location for the Large Cancun Sign!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Be prepared to wait in line if there is a big tour bus stopping by... or just stop off on the bus.  It's just south of the Westin hotel.  Nice rest room facilities for a public beach, but not much public parking.  If you are just stopping for a glamour shot with the Cancun sign, then the parking monitors will watch your vehicle!  Unblocked photo of the beautiful beach from atop the signage area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This  public beach has beautiful view and clean white sands and people swimming as well as surfing. You can find brids even bodyguard around too. This is the place where the colorful CANCUN sign is located too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH! Very clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clear water, Very clean, Cancun sign is right at the beach,  but parking is limited. People even go at night to walk on the shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful sunny days...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great day, good view, you can take pictures with Cancun big letters, this is near from most of hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great public beach right off the bus route. Beautiful view and clean white sands.  If you to Cancun you MUST STOP HERE.  This is the place where the colorful CACUN  sign is located. You have to have a picture taken here. There are showers and restrooms. And lots of security .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with beautiful white sand.  Waves keep you from swimming, but perfect location for boogie/knee boarding.  Nice place to just lay back and enjoy the scenery.  Also, Iguana's are abundant in this area.  As soon as you arrive at this beach you realise why it is the most popular beach in Cancun and the best one! The view on the Caribbean is outstanding, not to mention the vast territory of the beach which allows you to enjoy the silence and the sounds of the waves at any time of the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach, but the sand is mainly shells. It isn't very soft to walk on. If you want to ake a picture in front of the "Cancun" sign, get there super early because there will be a line.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach for almost everything
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The main beach in Cancun, This beach is absolutely beautiful, pristine and clean. The Waves are particularly very strong so one can go must inside the water but everything else - cleaniness, water sports, lifegaurds, tourquise water etc make it lifeline of Cancun. Best part is it is accessible by public although most of the remaining strip has all the resorts attached to it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful beach. open to the public. very clean. nice cancun sign for pictures that also lights up at night

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: - The beach was very clean, didn't reallly see any trash- The sand is a bit more coarse than our hotels- They have umbrellas(?) that are first come first serve- The line for the Cancun sign is always long- Wish they had more shower areas- There are people walking around selling refreshments and fruits- The waves are very very constant and big (lol.. for a lack of better description). This was the total opposite of our hotel beach where the water was calm

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, very powerful waves, Cancun sign lights up at night here.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very clean and very beautiful, the sands are golden and the water is turquoise. There are signs warning about sharks,jellyfish and rays but we went a few times and we saw none. The water is very rough so I would say be very careful its easy to get swept away with such powerful waves. The beach is not suitable for swimming but you can jump along with the waves on swim under them. There are little huts dotted around on the beach so its nice to get some shade from the sun on these and most are usually free. There is a small children's park and an exercise park next to the beach. This beach is where the Cancun sign resides but there is a long queue all most always! the only time I saw it without a queue was 7am in the morning. We decided to go at night and the sign lights up and we waited for 30 minutes for a picture.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The classic beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a nice and clean beach in Cancún. The waves are higher than in other areas.  It's fun to play with them. Beach was clean and we did not experienced vendors. We arrived relatively late at 5pm and enjoyed two hours with the kids. Parking can be done up front. There is someone helping you to park out since it is the main Avenue.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 5star Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is considered of the best and propably the best playa in Cancun and it lives up to its name. Enjoy your time there walking on the cool sand, swiming in the clear waters, chatting with the friendly locals who want to help have a Mojito or bring you fruits.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and exciting beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and exciting beach, few people in the beach..  it's a great place to relax and play, enjoy in couple, friends or family

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superrrrr!!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was with my friend Miguel walking just on the side of sea los delfines!!! Blue sea and clean sand. I went inside the sea for few minutes.the water were so hot😀😀😀😀😀!!! Too much woman taked sun in bikini

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing touristy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cancun definetely has spectacular beaches! The sea is unique... BUT (and a BIG BUT) it is supeeeeer oferrated! Everything is expensive : food, party, hotels... I was staying close to the bus station and it was pretty far from the beach (there are just "super luxurious" hotels by the beach).Delfines is the best public beach that I visited in Cancun (the only one that u have free shadow).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredible water, surprisingly not overcrowded and very clean. You can easily take an R1 or R2 local bus to this destination.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Colorful horizons & smooth breeze; be sure to bring sunscreen and sunglasses. This is all you need to spend one of the most peaceful mornings in your life!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach day!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful blue seas and picture perfect. We took a drive to explore Cancun and heard many good things about Playa Delfines, definitely worth a visit. Tip, they have public wash area just make sure you have change to tip the ladies for toilet paper.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is clean, the water is so blue and is a good place for relax, I would go there again......

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We read ahead of time that parking was bad. We were prepared so we took a Taxi from Secrets The Vine and that was so easy! The beach is amazing and well worth the visit even if only for pictures!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: GORGEOUS!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a spot worth seeing, even if only for the incredible colors of the water. Parking can be a little tight.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with easy public access
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at our hotel was awesome, we loved it. However we decided to take an early morning walk from our hotel and was able to walk to this beach. Loved that its easily accessible by the public so if you are not staying at hotel on the strip that's on the beach, with the bus you can easily come here. Its a gorgeous beach and having the "famous" Cancun sign there is a plus.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really enjoyable day out
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We booked this trip through our Thomson rep and it was brilliant. We were taken by catamaran to swim with dolphins and then feed and touch manatees.  We had food and drink there and then we got on a bigger catamaran to go to Isla Mujeres where we went on zip wires, snorkeling and kayaking we also had a beautiful buffet there and all the drink you needed was included, plus the setting is absolutely beautiful. Would highly recommend this trip

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Most amazing beach i have ever seen. Water is crystal clear and bright blue! Only thing about this beach was the waves were very strong other than that amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the 14  excellent restaurants at moon palace resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All the restaurants at moon place are excellent. The waiters are excellent. This is near the pool in the sunrise section. We usually go there for lunch. Although we have been there for dinner also. I haven't been there since Nov 2014 but I've been to moon place 14 times. All there restaurants are excellant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All day excursion  had a fantastic day amazing experience definitely a must do food was included  again not the best we didn't go to eat x

reviewsWithKeywords.title: You need to know how to swim
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful but the waves are aggressive at times, is very important to know how to swim and keep the eye on the little ones .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was very nice and it had the famous Cancun sign where many people stopped to take a picture. My 7 year old daughter was not able to enjoy the beach because the waves were too strong and there was a huge dip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic view, great Cancun Sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We also spent half a day at this very nice public beach. Its clean, with lifeguards and a very nice Cancun sign where you can take pictures. I really recommend it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is at the end of the hotel zone.  The No 1 and 2 buses take you there.  There are free sun loungers (until 3pm) but tip the workers.  Lots of food and drinks brought to you on the beach with reasonable prices.  Great waves. Public toilets available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was there with my teenage. We had a great time the sand is perfect and the water is just amazing. I love the view. While we were there two weddings took place it was fun to watch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is good to visit and it is public !! You have safe guards, clean beach... Public access. Free use of bathrooms. Free parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful colors!   This spot is a great photo op and center of attention place.  Here you will find the "mirador" or Lookout balcony for that perfect picture.  There's also a platform with the letters CANCUN where you can take some pics.  There's also free parking and changing stations.The only reason I don't give it a 5 star rating is because the water is very choppy and the waves present somewhat of a danger especially for children.  So make sure the lifeguard is around and don't venture too far into the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for pics and sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach to look at and watch the sunset.  Water and sand no different from your hotel beach if you stay on the lower/mid part of the 7.  Great photo opt to get a pic with the famous Cancun sign.  There's usually a line for the sign.  Still makes for a great memory.  And its free!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked to this beach from our resort crown paradise to take the pictures with the iconic 'CANCUN' sign. It is a very beautiful beach. We spotted many iguanas too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely beautiful! Great for a day out in the beach. I would recommend coming early to get a shaded are for free or make sure to bring a beach umbrella. They have several people out selling mixed drinks/food/fresh fruit all for a very reasonable price. Only down side is that the showers were not working when we were ready to leave. They only had a bucket with water lol..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at Playa Delfines
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great local beach. Friendly and clean. A "must visit" while in Cancun. Busses run frequently and are inexpensive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: wow what a beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went to this beach from my hotel on the bus, which cost 10.50pesos, this is a beach you have to visit and the Cancun sign for the great pictures. I went in June and the beach wasn't crowded at all.. white soft sand clear blue sea, amazing you have to visit this place at least once while in Mexico :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and not crowded in June
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I took the bus from the hotel zone to check this beach out.  Gorgeous beach with lots of spots to relax in the shade. Not crowded at all on a Saturday in June. Entertaining to watch bridal pictures being taken and to people watch in general.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect to spend the day, and tan! The ocean is beautiful and really refreshing, there are palapas for the people to have some shadow. It's beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nicest beach I've ever been on but beware of rip tides
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of lifeguards but if you're not a really strong swimmer stay close to shore in shallow water. Lots of palapas on a week day for shadeGreat sand, a lot of it will leave with you. Beautiful water and very warm. No obtrusive vendors but drink waiters abound. Great spot for a day at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Strong Surf.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Strongest surf I experienced in my whole life. It was wild but fun and different.Dangerous for young children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and relaxing 🙌🏼
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went there with my friends because it's a public beach and we were not staying in a hotel with a private one. It's breathtaking, beautiful beach, crystalline water, calm waves and some fishes dancing around. Looked like a gathering point for locals (of course I might be wrong). The coastguard was really friendly and helpful about an incident we had with an older guy who was taking pictures of us... We were redirected with an officer and the problem was solved, pictures erased, etc. Although we were freaked out by the whole situation we really enjoyed de beach. So we went back there some days after. Do visit Playa Delfines, you won't regret it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Average
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, in the zona hotelera.  Very crowded. There are signs alerting tourist about possibly contaminated water with E.coli.  Public restrooms available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: June vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with blue waters and white sand.  Great tourist sign saying CANCUN for a picture.  Small line to stand in front of sign for that picture.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Delfines
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great open to the public beach. Has the Cancun spot sign to take great selfies. Has slides and swings for kids. Clean atmosphere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Welcome to Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As we approach The hotel zone from the airport this is first view of the ocean and it takes our breath away. In 30 years of coming to Cancun this is our stop. I am amazed of the crowds standing in line to capture the perfect photo. Oh yes, the beach is indeed beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Iconic Cancun sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stop by Playa Delphines for a picture with the iconic Cancun letters. Great photo spot. Beautiful backdrop and a nice clean beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely Delicious restaurant at Moon Palace
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Moon Palace has many great restaurants.  However, this beach front grill in the Nizuc area is really outstanding and quite unexpected. This is the area that has tables beach side and also serves food under your palapa right on the beach.  Their quesadillas are probably the best I've ever had.  The Special Nachos are also excellent as well as their tacos.  It is a very clean, non-greasy approach to Mexican food.  You've got to try it.  You won't be disappointed!  I didn't write down our waiter's name, but think it was Xavier.....he left no stone un-turned to provide a perfect meal.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is gorgeous!  The condo we rented was along the quieter part of the beach, which was toward the southern end of the hotel zone.  The waves are definitely bigger than other beaches, but we thought it was fine.  Go for the turquoise blue water!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for the Cancun Picture!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited this beach just for the picture in front of the CANCUN sign. Other than that if you are staying in the hotel zone it is just the same beach. If you are staying outside the hotel zone than this is the place you want to go to see that turquoise water we see in the pictures of Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, clean, pristine beach.  Beware of big waves and heat - not many places to get shade and no where to buy drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, limited parking if not there early it's tough. We were there around 10.30 am and parking  was fine, beach huts/shades were full by 10.45 so would suggest to be there early and the under current was really strong by 11.30.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The waves here are large compared to those at playa tortugas and other beaches a little more inlet. The water is crystal blue and there is a lot of space to lay out on the sand and free hits to sit under on super sunny days. The beach is more of a locals beach so it's rather empty during the week. There are public restrooms and showers at the top by the side walk for rinsing off before returning to your day. There is a,so a large Cancun sign great for taking photos in front of but beware there tends to be a line for it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must check this out!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A Must see when visiting Cancun! Pictures will be Epic. Had a great time! Very Cool. There is a playground for kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped by this famous playa during our stay in Cancun. Nice waves, the water is very clear. Walked on the beach with my love, loved it! A must-do when you visit Cancun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great public beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: View is outstanding. Good waves for body/boogie/board surfing. (Watch the flags). Showers and rest rooms. Bring your cooler. ( no services)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach was beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had fun at the beach plenty of beach for everyone to enjoy, close to other activities. Different food. Places and museum,  and big mall with very many stores ,food venues

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach that has red flags
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, worth visiting when staying in Cancun BUT, like most of the beaches on the hotel strip it was red flagged when I visited i.e. dangerous to swim. It is such a pity that these beautiful Cancun beaches are so often too dangerous to swim in. You might swim out against a red flag but I won't. Under one of the few yellow (caution flags) I found the sea entry was sharply shelving, difficult to get in and out of unless you are quite young and very fit. Delfines is beautiful, has plenty of shade cover and facilities, but like much of Cancun, not a good safe place to swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Delfines
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at Playa Delfines was about an easy 15 minute walk from our hotel.  It is an absolutely beautiful beach and is a good place to take pictures to capture the color of the Caribbean.  We also had fun taking pictures with the Cancun sighn.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet clean public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you just want to enjoy a sound of waves (not loud music blasting all day long) and clean white sandy beach with minimum facility, this is your place. I would recommend to bring your own drinks and snacks since there are no restaurants or shops near by. Waves and currents are very strong here so this is not a swimming beach. There are dedicated lifeguards on duty and keep their eyes on people who go too far out from the shore. I am a strong swimmer but I did not even try to swim here. Very refreshing to have a beach like this in Cancun. I hope this public beach stays public for long time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful public beach at the edge of hotel zone. Free public parking. No rocks . Nice vendors... Bus stops right in front. Great bathrooms with showers. Also has best photo op in Cancun with the GIANT CANCUN sign that over looks the beach. But be advised on a busy day it will take you some time (20-30 mins.) to get that photo op.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of umbrellas and chairs along the beach, people coming by with drinks and food if you get hungry/thirsty.  You can even rent surf boards!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picturesque beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just on the edge of the hotel zone, Playa Delphines is a gorgeous public beach. Caught a bus from the Riu Cancun, takes around ten minutes and costs 10.5 pesos. Free chairs and thatched umbrellas, and vendors come round with drinks which are more than reasonably priced! Warm water, no rocks (unlike the beach by our hotel). Also home to the Cancun sign - don't forget to stop and take a picture! :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful Public Beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Most of the beach in Hotel Zone is taken over by resorts.This beach is available to public! And it is fabulous! Beautiful views and a lot of space! There are bathrooms, showers, palapas for shade and play structures for kids of different ages...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful. it offers free parking. you can tip the parking attendant if you would like. We stumbled upon this beach driving through hotel zone. it is a short walk from el ray ruins. the beach is very clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Such a beautiful landscape!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of my favourites beaches I've ever visited!!!! Everything is beautiful, the different colours on the beach combine with the sky and the sun is a dreamy view! I've gone 4 times and each time I feel very happy being there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big waves!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love Playa Delfines. It's such a beautiful beach. My jaw literally dropped at the first glimpse of of the gorgeous Caribbean turquoise. The waves are not too big and they are a lot of fun to jump in, for people young and old. Highly recommended!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach to spend the day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach, with free chairs (between 9am and 3pm), some shadow, and a sea with impressive color. With places to shower, bathroom, and people selling great and unexpensive margaritas and piña coladas. Strongly recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: That view!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach called the mirador, has gorgeous views of the caribbean sea, is worth a visit, is the biggest public beach in Cancún, has bathrooms, and "palapas", is also certified by the blue flag.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Public beach in Cancun Hotel zone. Very  breathtakingly beautiful! The Cancun sign is located there too so make sure to snap a picture 😃

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, tidy and just beautifulWe came to visit the Cancun sign as this is our favourite destination in the world that we have visited. Highly worth going.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Post card looking beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We got here by taxi from Royalton hotelA slight queue for a picture with Cancun sign but not too long and happy to see police presence The beach is straight off a Caribbean beach post card and makes great photos, however there were red flags flying on the beach and the sea did look as though that section had currents so didn't swim, but a beautiful area to visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach to expend the entire day. The color of the water is something amazing, crystal clear....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not much shade, can be rough with waves. Overall nice Beach. Parking available. Drinks are also available by roaming "waiters". They did have some small huts for some shade, but located higher up the beach  has some rocks that can be a pain.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning blue sea and soft sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is just breathtaking stunning and an absolute must when visiting Cancun and the pic by the Cancun sign is perfect for the fiery pic in your holiday album We saw a very chilled pelican and fish swimming around your feet This place is picture perfect I've never ever been in a sea with water was warm as this

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So beautiful...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is unbelievable beautiful! The shades of blue will leave you speechless. They offer chairs and there is a public restroom both for a very small fee. Also, in this beach you will find the "Cancun" sign - which is quite small that I thought and usually is pretty crowded. We didn't want to wait in a line just to take a picture, so we just went by the side of the sign and took a bunch while people were taking their ones... It turned out just fine! I definitely recommend this place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very clean beach with white soft sand.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rested in November 2014. Very clean beach with white soft sand. The water even in cloudy weather and a bright turquoise color. The sea off the coast is not deep, it's nice to lie in the water and jump on the waves. Constantly blowing wind on the mare always wave height of 1 meter. After the storm, in the morning there is a lot of seaweed. But they were immediately removed to 8 o'clock in the morning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 7th wonder of the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the most beautiful stunning beach I've ever seen it's absolutely gorgeousclear water beautiful soft whit sand..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Doesn't Get Much Better
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Simply gorgeous beach, although often crowded at peak times. White sand & azure tones will lull you into a state of bliss.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just an amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You must go and see this beach truly awesome. Surfers paradise,wildlife plenty.no shops bars restaurants in this area so if you go take water  food towel

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: so peaceful and calm. easy to get to. free palapas. clean bathrooms. a vendor sells excellent margaritas and other drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Public beach that active blocks cell phones
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is wifi here that they charge for, and all cellphone service is blocked. you walk a 100 meters to the north or south on the beach and there is 5 bars of LTE service.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited playa defines in April, oh what a lovely beach, very beautiful, big waves perfect for surfers!! Not much there, but definitely worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing view!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach had an amazing view, breathtaking! Any city bus could drop you off at this location, so you can take beautiful pictures and refresh your eyes with such a beautiful picturesque view! Truly some sight to see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice public beach in the middle of the hotel zone. The view is beautiful, and the sea is calm enough.It's a bit difficult to park the rental car.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful public beach in the center of the hotel area of Cancun. Very clean and spacious. Excellent to enjoy the beautiful colorful Caribbean beaches, has an area of showers and bathrooms very practical and clean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Caribbean Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I absolutely love Playa Delfines which translates into Dolphin Beach in English. It is rated as a Blue Flag Beach, which means it is extremely clean and safe and has very low e-coli bacteria counts which are monitored regularly. There is a very steep incline up from the beach, which results in a strong current and big waves crashing into the scoreline, much to the delight of swimmers of all ages, who can be seen frolicking in the waves. There are lots of seashells to be found in the sand along the high tide line. It is located approximately 30 minutes from downtown Cancun and is easily accessed the local buses which charge a nominal 10 pesos or $1 for a one way trip. The Caribbean turquoise blue is absolutely stunning, breathtaking and jaw dropping! This is by far one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited. An absolutely must see!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, although the waves were rough. We were staying outside the royal resorts, so the sand was nice and clean! And the beautiful palapa was a big plus! You can get massage on the beach,although its a bit expensive. The occean was of course LOVELY!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Isla Mujeres Gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If visiting Isla Mujeres you must visit this beach!  White powder sand and beautiful crystal clear water....wide beaches with plenty of chair rentals and refreshments.  This is a MUST do when on Isla Mujeres.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love the beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The first few days of our trip the wind and wave action was pretty rough; Red flags for rough waves and rip tide possibility. That didn't deter my enjoyment of the Playa Defines. The beach sand is not as fine or white as Florida's gulf coast but is is not that course but just as beautiful. Is easy to walk on without any pain to the feet. At our resort the sand was raked and cleaned up every morning by the resort staff and all the loungers were carefully rearranged. The water is so beautiful and changes shades from an aquamarine to deeper royal blues. The pictures taken do not do justice (even with a high end digital camera). The resort staff would bring drinks and food if requested. Every day "vendors" would walk up and down the beach selling their wares. It was typically guys selling Oakley knockoffs, cuban cigars, beach bags, jewelry, lady's beach covers and dresses. If you decide to buy NEGOTIATE, just as you should down at the market. NEVER pay full price and don't be afraid to walk away. They will come back to you and try again. HOLD YOUR GROUND, but realize these people make their living doing this so leave a little meat on it for them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This beach is so close to everything and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is beach to accessible for everyone and really prestine. The sand so soft that you cannot believe it. It is really like a paradise. The waves are high here compared with other beaches around Cancun. Don't forget to pose in front CANCUN landmark at the beach entrance near car parking/BusStop.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice Beach,love the cancun sign and fresh fruit vendors. Also nice to see some fish come in with the waves and the pelicans catch them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good view of the sea - the water is very blue. Sand is a bit coarse but seaweed is minimal. Visited Saturday in the AM. Not crowded at all!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Huge beach with facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved this beach, it has a lot free umbrellas , play ground for kids, shower , toilets, there are a lot of option to buy soft drinks and beer from the beach sellers .The water sport activities are available 300 m away, they are next to to the hotel area.There is a beautiful panorama plato, from where you can take an amazing picture.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach and ocean view. The undertow here can be dangerous and red flags were flying continuously the times we visited. Busy with locals and tourists alike.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for picture...not much else
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want to take a picture with the Cancun sign,  stop quickly and head back to your resort. The beach isn't great, tons of rock and sharp objects and the playgrounds aren't safe enough to let your kids play on them. Lots of locals hanging around drinking....but they aren't a bother. Safety is a real concern if you have little ones.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed in playa del carmen this past week. The beaches were just not that fun. After reading reviews we took the collectivo from Playa to Cancun and hopped on the bus R1 and took us directly to Playa Delfines.  The sand was soo white and the water was the most amazing I have every seen.  We wanted to go were the waves were good.  This place was perfect.  After reading reviews, I knew there was no food or drink provided. We bought a small cooler and brought some beer and sandwiches. However there were staffers that worked with the hotel on the right not sure which one blue one and they took our orders and brought us back huge margaritas and food right to us. We did not even have to move!  We speak spanish so we asked as they were passing by maybe that is why customers think there is no food possibly?   There was also locals selling fruit , water and soda.  Next time we are skipping playa and heading straight to this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Such a beautiful public beach.  Slept like a baby
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cool water, great waves, lots of huts to sleep under.I liked that it was secure, you could go for a swim and leave your towel behind and no one would take it.  Great place to take pictures.  Bathrooms right there to change and shower.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach was good but no amenities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was quite beautiful, although far away. The problem was that there was no way you can buy food or drinks. I mean we were dying in thirst. No water nothing. We tried to go to the hotel nearby to buy an access to restaurant but they did not let us.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy place!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My daughter and I stayed at the great Parnassus resort, and walked down to see the beautiful "Cancun" sign. There were many others visiting also. We felt safe, and walked the beach back. Worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rough Surf
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very Rough surf at this beach when we were in Cancun the last week of March.  Young kids could easily get knocked over by the waves even if only in knee deep.  You can get a nice photo by the Cancun sign in front of the beach.  Go to the El Ray ruins across the street for only $4 US dollars a person.  Takes about 30 minutes to walk through.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing White Sand Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: most incredible water!  Warm, gentle waves, great sun, volleyball on the beach and easy access from the hotel!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful. Absolutely beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Secluded from the resorts with a restroom on site and busses running very often. It's interesting to see the three layers of water colour. The sand is amazing. Just wonderful.Also has the famous Cancun sign to take pictures with. If you want to chill out at a beach without being bothered by the frat boys, this is the place to go

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very good beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The waves were high that day, but still great fun. Public access with showers and public outdoor gym overlooking the beach. Only thing missing is lack of shade, there are few umbrellas but not enough for this large beach. Also, I didn't see any food stores around (luckily I wasn't hungry). Still... color of the water and sand neglect all those minor minuses. Overall great place to be.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great to get away from the tourists! Awesome local beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice public beach , watch for parking spots to open up . On the south end of the strip but a short ride from anywhere. Good thing is no big hotels on this section and lots of nice locals!  The view deck from the street is awesome for photos!  must see views CANCUN sign near too for photos. Surf can be rough..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BREATH-TAKING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From the "CANCUN" lettering - to the color of the water.  Just BREATH TAKING.A definite place to go with the family.  If you don't pack up the food and snacks - you will have to go back and get them.  Here there is not one selling food (as least from what we seen).A MUST on the TO DO list for beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach accessible by car or bus. Bus was 6 or 11 pessos from Downtown Cancún but we could not figure out why it was cheaper or more expensive. The beach was quite clean with enough places to hide from sun. Toilets and shower are there but no drinking water (at least we did not find it). Locals offering fruits and refreshments.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Conveniently located in the middle of the hotel zone.  It's a huge, beautiful beach with an iconic CANCUN sign by the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dolphins Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this beach is the biggest public beach in town..if your looking for and experience where you want to run into local people this might be your spot.. as well if you looking for a beach with waves you get the most in this beach good for buggy boarding and or surfing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picturesque
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a public beach.  Lovely area of beach with lovely, soft, clean sand.  Large waves and just so picturesque.  The R1 or R2 bus pass there all the time.  As our Resort was pretty close to the Playa Defines, we did not actually get off of the bus and visit the beach itself.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must. Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are in the area yoi have to visit. Nearby is the sculpture with the word CANCUN so you can take pictures

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful beach of Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's the most beautiful beach of Cancun and has a public entrance, in other parts of the beach you just got the beaches trough the hotels. We really enjoyed playa delfines.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MUST SEE THIS BEACH
