reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very easy to get to. Any r1 or r2 bus will drop you off or pick you up at the beach. It has sowers and wash rooms. View from up top lookouts  are amazing. Very clean public beach for locals and travellers alike. Very safe. Great sand. Nice natural umbrellas to escape the sun when needed. As it is a little further down the strip it does see more wind. Waves can be larger. Watch the parasailers floating around.  All round great beach for the day or just a few hous. You do have to walk down a ways to the beach and coming up is a little steep   Quite a few stairs to the top.  May not be the greatest in the heat for those with mobility issues or health concerns. No impossible but would want to take your time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you go to cancun and want to see white beaches and blue water, this is the place, this place is astonish, and the best thing is that is free (public) and has very clean and safe bathrooms to change your clothes and get into the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Public beach. . Great to stroll down the beach , snap pictures , saying Hola to the locals and families,  lots going on all the time and yes there are lifeguards that are on duty . Just becareful as the Ocean is a powerful thing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful touristy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I thought it was beautiful being able to see the beach and ocean from up above. It was filled with people enjoying the public beach. I confess I like the beach front in front of my villa better because it was further from the crowds and the spring breakers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Was a Must See
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While visiting Cancun for the first time, we took the family by bus from our hotel to see the CANCUN sign.  It's bright colors and quiet location made for a lovely visit and photo opportunities with the kids.On another tour on the way back to the hotel it was already dark outside and the CANCUN sign was all lit up with floodlights glowing on the colored letters.  Very pretty, either daylight or dark.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great public beach in the hotel area!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful public beach with a long stretch of sand and of course the beautiful ocean! Sand is quite clean. We walked for 2hours!It has swings and a playground for children. Make sure to go when it's sunny!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is magical, full of culture and a wonderful view.. Here is pretty much your first stop when you arrive to Cancun, a must!! We enjoyed this location to the fullest, lots of people and you just want to get lost in the view!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Private beach with a long stretch to choose from
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Private beach with a long stretch to choose from.It has swings for kids and a playground and loungers to rent. Worth a visit as the sand is pretty white here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rent a condo on the beach yet we often walk to this park, it is so lovely there and family friendly, nice to see all the local families who come on weekends. We also like the outdoor gym eqipment available for everyone to use. There are lineups to take pictures with the colourful CANCUN sign, I'm sure there are pictures of it around the world - come and enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach with lots of parking!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A good choice if you have a car and are staying in central Cancun.  Get there kinda early and bring food - nothing for sale.  Beach loungers are available on a tip basis.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean beach. Swings for kids to play. Don't forget to get a picture by the cancun sign. Nice beach to just relax. Sometimes it gets crowded

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The place is very clean and well kept. Every minute there are food vendors available.nice place to reat and be with friends or family!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesome public beach with lots of playground equipment for kids.  Immaculately kept with wonderful modern amenities.  Get there early if you want to spend some time there.  Parking and sitting spots fill up.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have visited this beach many times...it is gorgeous.  However very strong waves so not good for swimming.  We stay in downtown Cancun but always make several trips down here by taking an R 1 bus which costs 10.5 pesos. The beach is clean and has several palapas......the famous colored  CANCUN  sign is here also for photos.  I highly recommend seeing this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exquisite Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning white sand large Public beach with beautiful warm turquoise water to frolic in! Lounge chairs free in exchange for ID. Nice palm umbrellas. $1 R1 bus ride. Located in the very high $$$$$$ end of Cancun. Stay in a reasonable $$ hotel in downtown Cancun. Take the pleasant public bus. Bring your drinks (no glass) and lunch for the perfect relaxing day! It's heavenly at Playa Delfines!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the nicest beaches in CUN
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not the beach for you if you are looking for tranquil waters. I would not recommend this beach for families with small children.  Big waves, undercurrent and not much swimming... ( red flag is up most of the time at this particular beach) However: Great view. Not overcrowded. Free palapas. Peaceful , beautiful and amazing. This is exactly the beach you imagine when you think of the Mexican Caribbean- turqouise waters, white sands, and a great view of Cancun beach length extending some 25 kilometers...I recommend it for friends ( bring a cooler and some snacks, some beach games and make it a day)  , for couples, families with young adults, for solo travellers ..  Just breathe and soak it all in. Enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wonderful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of several Blue Flag beaches in Cancún, Playa Defines is a great public beach with very good facilities. Safe swimming under the watchful eyes of the life guards and the Tourist Police.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Free Beach - where the locals hang out
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Free Playa not associated with any hotel - where the locals hang out.  A lot of the time there are red flags & no swimming allowed due to surf and an undertow from the beach but there is often an area with a yellow flag if you want to play around a bit in the surf - the life guards are serious about their job and very competent and will whistle people to keep them in safe bounds outside of any undertow.  The sand is lovely and you can grab a palapa for free if you are there before noon or even rent a beach chaise lounge for inexpensive price from the little kiosk just under the viewing deck by the tourist police booth.  Lots of young local guys will come around to take your orders for drinks and snacks and bring them to you.  Also some fresh fruit vendors and a couple craft vendors and trained massage therapists are on hand close by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On the weekends, it's packed with locals, but on the weekdays you can have the place to yourself.  Soft white sands with a few  palupa-roofed tables/umbrellas available.Lifeguard(s) on duty.  Bathrooms (but you have to pay for toilet paper!)  No nearby bars/restaurants, but locals will come by selling water and drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took the bus for $1 to this beach, and were so glad we did. The view is absolutely beautiful, we got there around 830am and had the entire beach to ourselves until about 11 when people started rolling in. The water is an incredible shade of blue-green and the sand is white as can be. We spent an hour just collecting a pile of the tiniest, most perfect little shells and then just sat and watched the waves crash on the shore and felt the wind on our faces. It was a really wonderful day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A BEAUTIFUL PUBLIC BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the public beaches on the Hotel Zone, at around 11 KM. If you are staying On the Zone, the beach will be right in front of your hotel or condo so there is no need to visit this beach as the entire Hotel Zone is one long, beautiful beach. However, if you are not staying on the Zone, this is way to enjoy the beach. There are the palm shade 'umbrellas' if you get there early, washrooms and vendors for snacks although I would suggest packing a lunch and drinks. The busses stop in front and just steps from the beach. If you get bored the Reyes ruins are just across the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach , white sand , lovely view of the caribbean sea for  there, ,batrooms are not the best , but they have it , take your food with you if you are planning to be there long  , or else you will have to eat mangos only.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Popular Cancun sign
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can't pass up a photo op with this sign with playa delfines in the background to make people back home hate you with jealousy. The wind was whipping that day so waves looked crazy dangerous, but beautiful from the high vantage point and the flying sand and pebbles were stinging our skin. Keep an eye on your flip flops otherwise you might see them again at the flea market as we found out the hard way, lol! Although it was not fun having to carry my barefoot daughter onto the bus back to the hotel just to fetch her other shoes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Afternoon Enjoyed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice short getaway from the hotel beach, lots of locals so great to meet and chat with them. Food and drink available, great photo opportunities, especially the Cancun sign, lit up in evening and even if crowded if you wait and assist someone with their photo, they most likely will return the favor.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No hotel party
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is one of the beaches in cancun with no hotel controlling and it is real safe and good to stay there. Bein one of the most popular beaches in Cancun, has also the Name of Cancun in the parking lot and with the beach ocean view for taking pics.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: top Beach in the area / surt spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you like to surf this is the spot or if you like to spend a day at the beach this will be the right place is a quiet and large beach, good for jogging too ! ;)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice area for kids to play.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with bathrooms.  Lots of playground equipment for the kids and some workout equipment there also.  There is a nice Cancun sign for picture taking as well by the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went just to see and click the pictures of CANCUN sign, and it is just beautiful. I saw some kids activities over there, it is a good place if you have kids too. if you are staying in hotel zone just take the R1 bus from your hotel and visit this picture perfect place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Cancun -- free
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with amazing clear green/blue water. Windy day and some waves made the temperature bearable. Worth a visit. Take bus R1 from the center and pay only 10,5 pesos one way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place to spend some time.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you go there early in the morning, you will find the great Cancun sign area empty and have great photo opportunity. Why not take the advantage of swimming in the blue waters of Gulf of Mexico in quiet morning environment? The sands here are white and small. There are beach cots to hire along with umbrella, changing room, restaurants etc. Great to spent two or three hours time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach; great location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The iconic CANCUN sign is up near the road, and there is a huge area for anyone to enjoy this beach.  White sand, life guards, restrooms

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I loved the beach but it was way too cowded, depending on the weather. I prefer chac mool, although this one is beautiful as well. You must go if you want the picture with the "cancun" sign... you might have to queue for a few minutes though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not a pretty beach at all.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There was nothing attractive about this Cancun Beach, when I saw it  this past May 2015. Tired and dirty!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun Hotel Zone public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Situated near the end of the Hotel Zone, Playa Delphinas is a popular spot for locals. The expansive beach is easily reached by the R-1 or R-2 bus, with the stop right at the beach. There are no vendors or restaurants, so bring your own snacks and water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful sea and beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The caribbean sea is one of the most beautiful and precious places for sun and sea lovers ! This is really an amazing beach...very long and large shore and soft sand ! It's also free of charge ! The water has amazing colours and is very clear ! Surf beginners may find their place to start ! Next time i'll be in Mexico for sure it will be on my schedule :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.  Not crowded when we visited end of January.  Highly recommended if your resort does not have a good beech.  You can take the bus to get there.  Fare is 10.5 Pesos, about 60 Cents or one US Dollar.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach that's easy to get to. It's right on the bus route. It's very clean and HUGE! The only negative was you had to pay to use the restroom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is really an amazing beach, very clean. I really had a nice day there!!Definitely, I will go to it again

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best public beaches in Cancun. You can get there using a public bus, no entry fee. There are rest rooms available, umbrellas to rent and drinks/snacks to buy from the local vendors. Wonderful place to relax!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An Amazing Beach - Totally Free!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Delfines is an excellent way to spend a half day while staying in Cancun.  This public beach is very well maintained with clean sand, lots of room and a great surf to swim in.  Getting there is easy by taking any R-1 or R-2 bus for $10 MXN.  You don't need to waste your money on a taxi.FACILITIESWhether you are going from a resort or from the downtown district of Cancun, the only thing you need are regular beach items (towel, sunscreen, small cooler, etc).  There are free lounge chairs and umbrellas to borrow from the supply hut as you enter the beach.  The very friendly staff there will even deliver them to the front of the beach for free!  Saying that, a small tip will be appreciated.  There are clean washrooms and open showers to rinse-off after you have had a great swim.  While relaxing, it is not uncommon to be approached by people selling beer and other bar items.  When I was there a beer cost $45 MXN.  While it is a little pricey for a can of beer, the poor fellow fetching it from the bar has quite a hike to fill your order and return.  Payment is cash but not due until the delivery is complete.SECURITYLike any other public beach, you should keep an eye on your things, but there are many other tourists with their own things on their chairs as well.  The local police patrol the beach often as well.The undertow can be strong.  The condition red flag was up when we where there, but this did not prevent many from swimming.  Just be careful with smaller children and weaker swimmers.  Common sense needs to prevail like any other beach anywhere else.I recommend this beach as a great activity while in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So, this beach is very close to where we stayed which was crown paradise.  I would recommend a visit here if you are at a hotel with a sucky beach.  This public beach is well maintained, has shady palapas, a kids playground, washrooms and very clean.  They have a huge cancun sign for photo ops too!  Easy to get to by bus.  The part of the ocean that you can enjoy the waves, body surf, it's all good.  Lots of weddings come here for just the pictures, it's beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went to almost all the beaches, one is nicer than the other. I simply loved Cancun. The beaches are clean, it is safe to go there and leave your things even whne you are in the water fir longer periods of time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see and free
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It should be on ur to do list if you go to Cancun!! The best part is that it's free and a beautiful beach. The day we went the waves were a lil bit out of control but we had fun. Too bad we went there on our last day in Cancun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a nice and quiet public beach.  However, there are no bars or restaurants along this stretch of beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Soft, beautiful sand and water - everywhere is picture perfect.  Loved the colors of the water and simply walking along the beach through the water was fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best public beach in all of Central America!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Though I haven't been to EVERY public beach in Central America, I now feel like I don't have try any others now - Playa Delfines amazed our group!  We traveled as two couples, rented a car in Cancun and navigated easily to this beach.  There was ample parking, attendants to assist with parking (and presumably watch for petty theft - tip them a couple bucks!)  The public toilets were clean enough, showers worked well, play area for kids looked fun (we had none with us but at that moment, wish we did!)  There were also many anchored umbrellas free to use, and the sand quality was PERFECT.  Parking to water's edge was not hard to walk, and when we walked down the beach to a hotel-owned portion of land, we found Playa Delfines to be much better!  Will definitely be back, and send my picky family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of room and sun shades.  It is kept very clean and patrolled by security.  Easy to get to by taxi or bus.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, Not Crowded, Safe, and Free!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My girlfriend and I recently traveled to Cancun and we saw that Playa Delfines was the top rated beach on TripAdvisor so we knew we had to check it out! Our experience at Playa Delfines completely impressed us! We read that it was a free public beach, so we were concerned that it would be crowded and dirty. This was not the case at all! Also, we visited in January and it was 87 degrees with a heat index of 91! It was such a joy to be able to experience that sunshine when back home in the US it was in the 30s.We visited the beach on a Saturday morning from 11:00 am - 4:00 pm and it was completely clean and not crowded at all! They have a bunch of little palm tree umbrellas for shade and when we arrived at 11:00 am, over half were empty so we claimed on of the shady spots and laid out our towel. By 2:00 all the umbrellas had been claimed, but the beach was still not very crowded at all. Plenty of privacy to be able to enjoy the sand and the water without invading anyone else's personal space.I've been to several beaches in Florida and South Carolina and Playa Delfines puts those beaches to shame when it comes to cleanliness and crowds.Another thing we loved about the beach was that it was just a 15 minute taxi ride to the airport and their are always taxis driving by so that you get get a ride anywhere in the city. Also, this area has lots of tourists, so we felt safe because we felt like we weren't outsiders. Another thing we liked was that there are vendors walkign around the beach selling drinks and snack to tourists. We ordered a couple Coca-Colas and fruit cups for about $1 USD each. Great deal. Gotta love that exchange rate. Fortunately my girlfriend speaks Spanish, but I wouldn't worry about the language barrier too much. All the taxi drivers and food vendors know enough to get you what you need.All in all, it was a great trip and I can't wait to come back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent free beach you must visit!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is an excellent free public beach with great amenities. I was so impressed after my first visit I rearranged my plans in order to come back the following day. The R-1 and R-2 buses in the Hotel Zone stop here, right by the famous CANCUN sign where people line up for a photo op. This beach has free rest rooms and outdoor showers and a variety of free-to-use stationary umbrellas (palapas).  There are also a few benches and handicapped-reserved lounges beneath palapas. It's a clean beach surrounded by the turquoise waters of the Caribbean. Perhaps because it is the southern-most free beach on the hotel zone peninsula it wasn't too crowded (except for the photo op line at the CANCUN sign).  I suspect the other free beaches which are in the thick of the hotel zone might be more crowded. If you only have a short time in Cancun I'd suggest that you put Playa Delfines on your must see list!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice and quiet place in Cancun . Big waves in the sea . Sea without animals . You can buy small refreshment on the beach. Changing rooms , showers and toilets are near the beach . Entrance and parking are free .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Decent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The two big draws to the this beach: photo by the "Cancun" sign and that it is free of cost. It was very easy to get to by the hotel zone bus. Although it was a little busy, that is expected for a public beach. It is very very clean and had basic amenities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good to be a public beach, but not good enough
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are other beaches that offer better views and service than this one. It is worth to pay a couple of pesos and get a nice clean beach with beds and umbrellas. We also had bad luck because of the weather, but it was ok to stay for 10 minutes (lol).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Space to lay out with all the perks of the hotel one beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a fun beach!! First, the beach offers showers and bathrooms right at the entrance. Second, descend a few steps and see the playground or the workout area for the members in your party that aren't excited about laying out all day long.. There are palapas all around, but you have to get there early in the day to claim one. The water is gorgeous and refreshing. Don't worry about going hungry, the locals walk the beach offering you food and drinks for a couple pesos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Make sure you stop for a photo!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not only is this an amazingly beautiful beach, it's got a super big "Cancun" sign that's the perfect backdrop for a touristy photo. It was our first glimpse of the ocean front after arriving at the airport. We didn't walk the beach or swim there but it looked awesome.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach, but not any better than hotel beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I guess this beach is good if you don't have access to a beach through your hotel, but nothing about this beach was any better than what we had access to at the Emporio Hotel.  Has some showers, bathrooms, etc.  Also a small playground for kids, and a "Cancun" sign that had a huge line waiting for a photo op.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and breath taking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: He hopped a bus to this place and it was worth it ! The waves are of course too strong for little ones, but it's a must see in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach,  the famous Cancun sign.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went here because of the reviews I read on TripAdvisor.  We took the bus here from our hotel and got our picture taken by the sign.  We didn't swim here but it was a gorgeous beach.  There were lots of cool iguanas on the grounds nearby.  It was a nice little stop on our public bus adventure along the Blvd. Kukulkan.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, awesome waves!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches in zona hotelera! Showers, restrooms available. Also some sun shadows free of charge. When you already plan to go there, then visit also El Rey ruins that is in 2-minute walking distance. The ruins are nothing special, but lots of cool iguanas there for sure!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: BEAUTIFUL clean beach with gorgeous water! Conveniently located next to the famous "CANCUN" sign! lots of tourists in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa delfines - free beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our hostel recommended this beach since we were not staying in the hotel zone this was a lovely alternative. We just got the bus R1 which you can get straight from AV. TULUM to playa delfines. The single fare is 10.5 pesos. It's a lovely beach and it was never too crowded. Bring your own drinks and snacks though as there are no shops within walkable distance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean white sands and stunning turquoise sea, perfect for children.  Shower facilities and park area as well

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Para fugir  das prais particulares ,otima praia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are staying in a all inclusive hotel try to walk there and join and enjoy the Mexicans. It's a beautiful beach.The Mexicans are very open and nice with the tourists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MUST for Tourists and locals!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a must for those visiting Cancun. This is where the colorful CANCUN letters are for pictures. This beach is great for the day. I recommend arriving early (9-10) since it gets very busy by noon and it's harder to find parking spots...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Free Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I asked in the hosted where I could go for a free beach. Since I wasn't staying in the Zona Hotelera and I didn't have access to a beach and I didn't want to spend money. I took a bus from Cancun to the Zona Hotelera. The beach is beautiful with white sand and free places for shade and free showers to clean after the day at the beach. Prepare to be in the company of some big lizards. At the end of your stay you can take a picture with the famous Cancun sign

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breath Taking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If your going to a beach jump on the R1 or R2 I am sure.. and head to the "Dolphin Beach" the place is beautiful picture perfect sand and sea.  The beach is even nicer by moonlight.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my opinion, this is the best beach in Cancun, is a little far away from the other beaches but is so quiet and have more space.This beach have showers and bathrooms too and have the famous letters of "CANCUN"

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach hands down in Cancun! The ONLY "must see" here. Bring water and snacks. But free shade and showers can't believe that. Super safe with life guards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach had nice clean sand, it was windy and cloudy when I went skin not many vendors were out. The massage places here can be brought down in prices, my girlfriend and I received a 30 minutes massage for $15 each. Bathrooms are at the end of the beach as well, small but will work.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice public beach with public parking, and facilities.  The white sand and blue ocean is simply breathtaking.  If you are staying in the hotel zone,  your hotel probably has easier beach access.  If not you can definitely come here for swim or sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good beach for in Cancun. Look south for less wavey beaches if you like that. Water was fun with the waves. Not a place For snorkeling but you could try to surf! Beginner surfing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach for relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There were not many tourists mostly locals. There were lots of palaps that you can sit under and the beach is great. Water is not shallow so not best beach for kids to swim. Has restrooms and playarea for kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been coming to cancun since the early 90s and love the turquoise water! This beach is safe and perfect for a day picnic - they have recently added bath rooms and pavilions. Its easily accessible from any public bus system. and ITS FREE!!!! Take your camera and enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was a very nice place! Due to the clear water and sand! Very recomendable to visit it when you go to Cancun !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I liked playa Tortuga better water was more calmer not so many high waves or seaweed they also have the ferry to go to isla mujeres And And The bungee jumping

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean n nice place. We took a picture on a cancun sign. Worth to visit, the water is clear n the public restroom also clean. Recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach - great place for pictures!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a famous beach in Cancun and worth a visit. It's beautiful, an easy walk down to the water, with beautiful sand and blue water. You can take the bus there (or drive, there is parking). Public bathrooms are available if you need them. A must-visit while in Cancun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great amenities, pretty beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach and great grounds! I loved how they had a free playground for kids to play on. As I recall, anyone can use the palapas. There is also the option of getting drinks delivered to you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: very nice beach just inside the hotel zone. if i am not wrong this is the only public beach in the hotel zone.it also have a clean restroom

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pictures do not represent the beauty of this beach! It is GORGEOUS! This is where the infamous Cancun sign is located. Therefore, if you plan on taking pictures, be ready for a line.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach equipped with straw umbrellas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous turquoise colored water. There's limited free parking. We got a spot without any problem. There's a play ground for kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and not crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went there 2 times and found it nice. White sand, moderate waves, free spaces under shades.  At the entrance there are toilets and showers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Hands down the most beautiful beach in Cancun. The view from the street level is absolutely amazing, wide, long, white sandy beach. You can gaze for a long time at it, simply stunning. Careful if you want to take a picture with the " Cancun " sign on the street level, there is a line-up at all times and you have to hassle with people (we did) to be able to take pics.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is amazing, but unfortunately the rain didn't help us. It should be unbelievable in a sunny day, for the place is beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The softest sand!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is spectacular with white soft sand and crystal clear waters. The service here is great & you will soak up some amazing sun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A nice stretch of beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying at the north end of the hotel zone and took the bus down to this beach to check it out.  It's a nice stretch of beach but pretty packed out with all the resorts facing it.  It goes pretty steeply down into lots of waves.  Fun for a walk and to see what was going on at the party resorts, but we liked the peaceful beach at the InterContinental better, the beach was flatter and the water was calm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Great Public Beach Access
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is near the south end of the Hotel Zone, next to the Hilton hotel. It has a spectacular vista of the big beach, wide white shell sand that is always cool to the touch and lots of parking access. Worth a visit and see the El Rey ruins right next door, well worth it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue flag beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful wide sandy beach with palapas for shade, clean bathrooms and showers. Blue flag meaning one of the best beaches in Mexico, in all there are 6 blue flag beaches in Cancun! Just one problem, there are very strong rip tides on this beach so watch yourself and the kids when swimming out!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Pretty Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Where the "Cancun" sign is located.  Easily accessible by bus.  Very pretty beach, but I understand the waves can be very strong.  We didn't go in, just took pictures :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful public beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful public beach at the south end of Hotel Zone. Wide beach area with very fine sand. Beachside kids activities are available. There is also a big colorful CANCUN sign for your photos!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not sure what else you could want
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I liked that the beach had a parking assistant help direct to park our car without sticking around for a tip.  He was there to help backing out onto the main drag.  There are thatched shelters available and we got there late and still got one no problem.  Free shower.  Restrooms available,  There were people walking the beach offering beverages but they were not intrusive.  If we did not come prepared it would be nice to have that.  I am surprised that someone saw a van get broken into because there are so many people around a thief would have to be very bold.  Cost me nothing, the sand went out far and the water was cleaner than nearer Playa del Carmen.  There were few parking spots available but we parked twice there but maybe on a busier day it will be difficult to get a spot.  Although far from Cancun proper and many of the hotels, it is one of the first beaches coming from the south (eg, Playa del Carmen).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a Sunday morning, beautiful beach! Turquoise waters and white sand.  We didn't get to go in the water because we were flying out that noon so we had to head back to the airport.  I wish we had gone there earlier in the week.  We will be back, definitely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Great facilities. This seems to be a locals favorite spot. This is where they have that famous multi color "Cancun" sculpture.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cancun signboard, crowded beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach mainly because of the Cancun signboard. There is always a crowd and many people dont have any etiquette. So you may be humble and stand in line for minutes while others just barge in take pics and go!!! gReat pic of the ocean behindd you!. The beach also has iguanas so look out for them! The beach has small shacks that look great in pictures. We didnt spend much time here as it was crowded! El Rey is just opposite so you can visit it as well. Buses stop here frequently.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Peaceful paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have visited several beaches in Cancun, but Playa Delfines is definitely the one that stood out. We had to ride the bus for 15 minutes to get here (while other beaches were a 5 minute walk), and it was worth it.The beach was very quite when we were there, and it is the perfect place to relax. The pollution is also less than with other beaches. If you don't want to go here every day, then combine it with a visit to the El Rey ruins that are very close.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach- a bit rough for kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is an absolutely gorgeous beach, clean and with looots of sand space for the kids to play and a nice playground. However the waves are a bit rough for the kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Inviting white sands of the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our hotel (Iberostar Cancun) was situated on Playa Delfines and the beach stretches far and wide (but it changes name/ shape as you from North to South).The beach was white and fairly even, easily accessible and hosted the hotel sun beds, wooden umbrellas and beach games. There was a tractor to remove excess seaweed and keep the sand clear.The locals use it to sell souvenirs to tourists but they don't hassle you. The beach is safe, clean and most hotels have lifeguards. The sea was fairly unsettled post hurricane Patricia but clearly marked by flags. We were able to paddle even though they had red flags flying. On other days we jumped waves and enjoyed the the warm, green and inviting waters.There were two weddings and  a low key fashion shoot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: THE BEACH TO GO WHEN IN CANCUN
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have tried a few beaches and unfortunately most of them are full of "herbs" in the water. This one was the best we found. The sand is pure white and the water has a great color. You can take pictures near the beach in front of the letters CANCUN

reviewsWithKeywords.title: what a great beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is beautiful and perfect for families and couples. white sand and blue water ... awesome breezes and dolphins too ..that's why its called Dolphin Beach..Its a great spot for playing or even getting married!!!! Recommended by the Mayor of Cancun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Do not miss this little gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Safe to swim, beach clean and the restroom facilities very good. Very popular with locals soit must be good. Right next to the Cancun sign for photographs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: sweet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach. You can find locals relaxing here. The Cancun sign is beautiful so prepare to take awesome pics.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Oh So Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach, although the water is not safe to swim in.  It is also where the Cancun sign is making it great for photo ops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and Clean!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach for locals and tourists alike! Amidst all the overly glamourized tourist hotels that exist up and down the zona hotelera, is this gem of a beach. Free to the public, with spotless restrooms and outdoor shower area, this is a great place to hang out and swim for a few hours. Tipping is appreciated by the wait staff at the restrooms, but not necessary.The beach is cleaned daily, and the water is that Caribbean blue everyone loves. It is really the best and only reason to venture into this overly priced neighborhood!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Where You Should Go In Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Once in Cancun and you want to take a photo with that beautiful and colorful CANCUN signage, you should come here. The locals call this place by "El MIrador", located along Zona Hotelera.Views here are amazing for taking your pics, there are also bathrooms/change rooms you can use -  there were no water though when we were there. The place is located at the end of the hotels strip so there are fewer people here than at the middle of the hotel zone. I'm not even talking about how beautiful the color of the water as Cancun is well-known of it's Turquoise water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely stunning. The water is so clear, the sand clean. Loved our time there. Busy yes, but not unbearable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful beach, large waves, very clean ,but watch out for birds l stealing your snacks!! lol xxxxxx

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This is a paradise you have to see to believe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is clean with public access, workout station, palapas, and life guards on duty.  The colors of the ocean from the top of the beach are some that you truly have to see to believe.  Public restrooms are available and this is a great spot for tourist to take their perfect Cancun vacation picture in front of the giant "Cancun" sign.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is gorgeous.  Beautiful white sand and clear blue waters for swimming.  Has clean bathroom facilities, outdoor showers, shaded areas, a playground, and an outdoor gym free of charge.  Also a great photo op at the light up Cancun sign.  Great place to spend the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful public beach...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a public beach with a few areas to lounge in the sun. There are restrooms and showers near the famous Cancun sign that everyone takes pictures at. This is on Kukulkan street a few blocks north of the Crown Paradise resort. I would recommend visiting this beach after you see the Mayan museum just north of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there on a sunny day. The water was calm. There are nice playgrounds. This is a beautiful place and a must see in Cancun.  Gorgeous!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Linda playa!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice public beach. Public toilet and showers. Not busy at all. Water colour is amazing. Check for "zargaso" some sort of algee which can sometimes be found floating on the shore and can be a bit of a pain.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quick stop,  beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice,  clean beach.  The Cancun sign is there to take pictures.  It is a nice place by the El Rey ruins are close by

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hermosa la playa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place, changing rooms, sanitarios,  attendant. Great white sand, azure la mar, no beach attendant or vendors, good or bad is a point of view!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great view with white sand and blue water!!! Spend a few hours here before returning back home just to enjoy our last moments

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful public beach with white grains of sand and clear turquoise water, picture perfect. The gentle waves here make swimming in the sea a pleasant experience and there is parking available just off the road. Don't forget to take a photo of the famous multi coloured Cancun sign while you are there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach a definite must see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was the nicest beach I've been to there was clear water with lots of waves , I wish I had thought to bring a board ! Had a great day jumping in waves and overall I would recommend this to every traveler its can be very hot but there are shelters there and there are washrooms and showers available a definite plus , make sure you bring lots to drink and as with most places no glass containers ,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonder
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful,this is a dreamplace for me..Color of the water is amazing.I would like to go back,piece and quiet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great walking beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is at the far end of the hotel zone. Lots of Mexican families enjoy this beach. You can walk for miles on this beach. Buses stop here and there are washrooms. There are no restaurants so bring your own food and beverages.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best white sand beach in Cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice white sand beaches. you can spend a pleasant day at the beach by renting one of the chairs with umbrellas. Absolutely no disturbance. you can see all the parasailing activities and water sport activities performed in this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Azure seas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What blue, azure seas!  White sandy beaches and a cool wind makes for a great day to sit outside and enjoy God's creation!  We felt so relaxed and did not want the day to end!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely, clean beach, which was within walking distance of our hotel (Sun Palace).  The views were amazing, and the beach is quite wide compared to some parts of Cancun.  The Cancun sign is here as well, so you can have your picture taken, however there are quite big queues to do this.  We got there early in the morning, so there wasn't a big queue.  We got the bus back as it was so hot. The bus stops right outside the beach, and goes to all hotels along the strip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, great photo opportunities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was clean.  I saw workers cleaning up the seaweed at the shore.  There are Coke bottle statues for great picture opportunities,  Also, there lies the famous Cancun sign right outside the beach.  Get there early otherwise you will be waiting forever to pose for pictures in front of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clear water with soft white sand. Visit at around 9 in the morning and you will have the beach to yourself. No seaweeds here. Maybe because of the large number of the hotels I suspect they clean them regularly. Iconic CANCUN sign for your memories too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ta Chido
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Public beach with clean white sand and clear waters. Iguanas can be found in the wild and there are sometimes people walking up and down the beach selling food and drinks. It has everything you need to enjoy a sunny day in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Faboulos sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great turqoise water, nice large beach with white sand. If your hotel is not near(ours was 20 min by car) take a cab. If you order it from the concierge, the price will be double. We paid 350 pesos with the cab the hotel ordered (The Courtyard Marriot) and on the way back we paid 200 pesos. We just stoped a cab near the beach, as it is very safe (the police station is right there) and the driver was very very nice and he also did a little guiding information. We called him again the next morning, at 5 am he was there and he took us to see the sunrise. FABULOUS!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great picture location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous Beach. We didn't spend much time here, just passing through but definitely worth the stop. Lots of a great picture opportunities and clean bathrooms (nice for being pubic).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Where the Cancun sign stands...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing photo op. This beach is family,  friend,  couple oriented beach is beautiful a must see and visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very Nice beach , i think is one of the best of cancun ,there is a panoramic area , ( you can make good pics of the blue ocean) ,restrooms ( not very clean)   , good place to hang out for a while

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best public beach in the Hotel Zone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best public beach in Cancun. There are palapas available for shade (if you get there early enough) or you can take your own umbrella. Its clean and big enough to not feel packed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The kids and I had a fabulous time at Playa Delfines! There was still a lot of seaweeds on the shore but it cleared out after a couple of days. The kids stay by the sands as they were scared of the waves but we all had fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Got the local bus up to go get a photo by the world famous cancun sign. Go early as its very very popular and I had to queue. It's very very hot so be prepared to wait and be patient. Beautiful place worth visiting

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clean beach you can access if you don't have one with your hotel. This is where the CANCUN sign is located! Great photo opportunity!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach within Cancun´s hotel zone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the nicest beaches we found in Cancún.  Either bus route 1 or 2 can take you there within the hotel area.  The beach is clean and there were waves but even for non-swimmers, it was calm enough to enjoy.  Cancun has had a surge of weed, so people who are prone to allergies should just be careful not to touch the "sargazo" weed in the beaches

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely place ,crystal waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: lovely place ,crystal waters and white sand, ,only be aware of the sea current , could be a little bit dangerous for kids , with strong winds

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sign that's well lit-up at night.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited at night because I wanted a picture of the very beautiful Cancun sign - it's two years old.  This was my fourth time flying into  Cancun and I never saw it.  It does look like  it gets really crowded during the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another beautiful beach in the Riviera Maya
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Any of the shores from Cancun to Playa del Carmen, to the islands of Isla Mujeres or Cozumel, have incredibly white sand and beautiful blue tonalities in the water, which is one of the main reasons our family enjoys vacationing in the Riviera Maya. Playa Delfines is one of these spots in the paradise that is Cancun, easy to access by public transportation and in a more secluded area away from the crowded hotel zone. This summer there was more seaweed in all beaches than any other time we have visited, which takes away from the pristine look we are used to, but it was still an enjoyable time. If visiting Cancun, don't miss it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: free/big
reviewsWithKeywords.text: take the bus to playa dolphin////if you  get there at day break there are dolphins in this area///nothing like seeing them in clear blue water ,,,it located by the crown paradise club / across from  el-reye  ruins

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place to visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took the bus there on Friday, 8/7/15. Very limited parking in front of the beach. Not sure if there were other parking areas so make sure you research that beforehand if you plan on driving there yourself. The beach was clean and the sand was fine with very few rocks. The slope of the sand underwater was gradual allowing you to walk out quite a ways. The water temperature was on the warm side but cool enough to get relief from the blazing sun. They had red flags out that day which meant "no swimming", however, most did not seem to pay any attention to them. Having been to many beaches, the waves and the undertow didn't seem to warrant the flags on that day. This was the perfect beach for sunbathing and bodysurfing. My only complaint was the 30 minute wait to take a picture with the famous "Cancun" sign. I think many wouldn't mind if they made a duplicate sign.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach at sundown
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Granted, we don't get the sunset over the ocean in Cancun but the water temperature, breeze and views are stunning. It was a bit crowded as you can expect in a public beach on a Sunday afternoon but it was very clean and pleasant. Having free shade, and miles of beach you can find a good spot. The atmosphere was friendly with lots of families and children and overall was a great experience. We left a little late which probably explains that the showers were closed so we had a bit of extra sand on our feet when we got into our rented car. No snorkelling but the ocean was simply perfect.

reviews.title: I don't get the hype
reviews.text: We read great things about Playa Delfine so we were excited to go there. We grabbed an Uber, arrived, and... were disappointed AGAIN. This is becoming a pattern on our Mexico trip. The beach has white sand and blue sea, there are restrooms and parasols. But that's the only positive thing I can say about it and that'swhy it gets 2 stars from me. But it's God ugly. The view is atrocious. If you look to the left, there are monstrous hotels. If you look to the right... there are monstrous hotels. It even beats the Belgian coast in ugliness, and the coast from my home country is notorious for having ugly buildings. This was worse, which I didn't even think was possible. But it apparently it is. I refer to the pictures I took from this beach. We were appalled. We did a long beach walk, hoping we would find better parts of the beach, but it only got worse when we reached the hotels. I honestly don't get why on earth people would want to spend their vacation in Cancún when this world has so many alternatives that are so much more beautiful while being so much cheaper. It's not like the atrocious monster hotels that ruin the views are cheap. If they were, I could understand. But they really aren't. On top of that, there was stinking sea weed everywhere. Mass tourism gone wrong in any possible way.This place made me sad.

reviews.text: Among the beaches that have waves, because there are also those without waves, it seemed to me to have the best infrastructure. It has public umbrellas, bathrooms, an exceptional viewpoint, it is well preserved and clean.

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, super clean, with free bathing and sometimes it uses public WIFI. The only bad thing is that there is no bar to buy alcohol so I recommend bringing it before going.

reviews.title: Best beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Best beach, if you come early you can still get an umbrella. White sand, great sea and you can usually see pelicans. We got there easily and cheaply by public bus. And no loud music :)

reviews.title: I love
reviews.text: I love it, although it is not a beach for family swimming because the waves are very strong. However, the palapitas, the bathrooms, the showers, everything makes it special. The view is beautiful because you can see the sea with all its colors

reviews.title: A good hotel in Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed 10 days at the Windham Hotel in Cancun located on the beach in the hotel zone. Great location with bus stop outside the hotel.15 km beach.Large rooms and good maintenance. Meals with 3 excellent restaurants. Don't miss the one on the beach. Very pleasant lunch and dinner.Very attentive staff. Very good stay.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful! Breathtaking colors.There are benches and some types of fixed and free “umbrellas” on the edge of the beach.Free access, except for parking which is paid for by tipping the employee who takes care of it.Bathrooms paid separately.No restaurants.More choppy water, not so good for those with small children. But drop dead gorgeous!And it makes for excellent photos of the waterfront with the buildings in the background.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Very nice beach! There are umbrellas, and there are bathrooms where you can wash off the sand... I suggest arriving early because it gets crowded

reviews.title: cancun
reviews.text: beautiful... very beautiful... very friendly people and very good weather... the beach is clean and without sargassum... impeccable crystal clear waters

reviews.title: It's worth going to see it, even if it's just to stay for a few hours.
reviews.text: Clean beach, few waves, easy to get to by bus as it is on the hotel avenue. It is on this beach where you can find the famous Cancun letters for photography. It has public bathrooms but no place to eat. If you're going to spend the day, it's a good idea to bring food and drinks. It has some shady places, but depending on the time of day they will be busy.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: My husband and I had a photo session on this beach and it looked like a pool, it was so calm, no waves and no sargassum! It's a shame that some people go to drink alcoholic beverages there and leave trash, it's a shame, other than that it's a great place to go for a walk admiring the sunset or sunrise.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, no sunbeds
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. No sunbeds.There is showers and toilets. The toilets were filthy. And no toilet papir. Unless you ask a person outside for it.

reviews.title: Picturesque
reviews.text: An absolutely gorgeous beach, with crystal blue waters and gentle rolling waves. We were there for seven hours. They have public restrooms, free umbrellas to sit underneath, and some vendors selling snacks and drinks on the beach later in the day. If you plan on getting an umbrella/shade be sure to get there earlier in the day (before 11). It is also a hopping spot for photos, we saw two quinceañera photoshoots happening while we were there. Parking is a crazy situation, so walk if you can or get there earlier so you can get a spot relatively close.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! Lots of spots to stay in the shade or soak in the sun. The showers and bathrooms on site are well maintained.

reviews.title: public beach
reviews.text: Public beach in excellent condition, very maintained and in this place there are the letters of Cancun and the sea is beautiful

reviews.title: Beautiful sea but with very high waves, you must know how to swim, it is a public beach, you cannot smoke or drink alcoholic beverages, little s
reviews.text: Very nice beach, there are umbrellas that are free but it gets crowded, and you stay in the sun's rays, there is no rental of lounge chairs

reviews.title: A charming beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, powdery sand, turquoise sea and various blue colors, the waves are incredible, they have free palapas for shade and the atmosphere is calm.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: In this place we ventured to go beyond the sea shore and we don't know how to swim but it was a wonderful experience from the view of the beach and the turquoise blue water. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Lovely Beach for Pictures🌊🌞🌿
reviews.text: Pittoresk Beach with Azur water, water ist chopy. If calm, would be perfect for sunbathing and staying all day. Visited April 22.

reviews.title: n/a
reviews.text: Hello everyone.I am about to travel to Cancun and I have a question for Colombians who have traveled to Cancun and who had to fill out their immigration pre-registration.Is the Multiple Digital Immigration Form (FMMD) downloaded before the trip after pre-registration or during the trip?I made my Pre-registration but the FMMD was not generated nor did I receive it in my email.Thanks for your help.

reviews.title: Great if you're not driving there.
reviews.text: Lovely place to visit. Free umbrellas everywhere if you're lucky enough to get one. Good life guards. Only problem is you have to pay the scammers for the free parking lots or they'll key your car. We gave a guy 20 pesos when we arrived he complained it wasn't enough. Told him we'd pay when we left. Left him hanging as he couldn't run as fast as I can drive 🤣🤣🤣

reviews.title: Nice free beach.
reviews.text: It is a public beach, in very good condition. White sand and crystal clear beaches. There is fresh water for bathing before and after swimming in the sea. There is free parking. Umbrellas to protect yourself from the sun. Very little sargassum. It has the CANCUN sign which is a mandatory photo if you visited the city.

reviews.title: The best public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: The best and cleanest public beach in Cancun. The beach has public sun shelters but there are also the biggest waves in Cancun.You can reach it by buses R1 or R2. There are El Rey Mayan ruins in the other side of the road

reviews.title: pretty as a postcard, but brutal waves, unpleasant smells
reviews.text: Pretty but not worth it. Waves are SO rough, you'll get pummeled, like bathing suit ripped off, claw clip gone forever kind of pummeled. The beach is really beautiful from a distance but there are so many other nicer areas. No shade and crowded. Parking is free but attendants make you feel like you have to tip them. Parking lot smells like pee. Steep sloped descent to beach is hard to walk up when you're hot and sandy. Skip entering the water on this one and go straight to Playa Caracol or Playa Langosta. Water is soooo much calmer and clearer. P.S. for Playa Caracol, walk down towards the Riu Palace for the perfect less crowded clear water area and good snorkeling off the beach.

reviews.title: I would return many more times, I highly recommend them.
reviews.text: Its crystal clear waters and beautiful turquoise blue, it is a true Paradise!!SUPER CLEAN BEACH, A WONDERFUL EXPERIENCE,

reviews.title: Excellent and super equipped public beach with turquoise sea.
reviews.text: We went to this beach looking for turquoise waters and white sand and it was exactly what we found. Although there was a little sargassum, there were cleaning crews that removed what was left in the sand and kept the beach super clean.This beach has Palapas and some wooden chairs (we arrived at 9:30 am and they were almost all free).We left the car in the parking lot, went down to the beach and enjoyed an incredible day at the beach. There are showers and bathrooms in perfect condition and hygiene to use.From time to time, late in the afternoon, street vendors sell food and drink. We didn't buy anything since we had taken it with us so I can't comment on the prices.Near the parador, in the area of the stones, one could enjoy seeing the iguanas.We were able to enjoy an incredible day at the beach with friends and family.

reviews.title: Playa Los Delfines So Cute
reviews.text: The beach is very nice. To spend a delicious morning. There are some chairs and umbrellas. There are bathrooms to change and you can line up with your drinks and snacks. We visited July 9, 2023 a group of 15 people

reviews.title: Normal
reviews.text: The fact that someone waits up to 1 hour for a photo with some letters seems stupid to me.Pro: free bathrooms and showers although with a minimal amount of water.Pro: the viewpoint.

reviews.title: Not for little children
reviews.text: SUPER choppy and strong waters, not great if you have kids under 10 years old. We stayed for 5 minutes before packing up and moving to a different beach.

reviews.title: They close the bathroom/showers at 5pm!
reviews.text: I was told that this was the only public beach in Cancun. It was nice and clean and we found a palapa. However, they closed the bathrooms and turned off the shower water exactly at 5pm, which was really unfortunate. I went end of April on a Monday.

reviews.title: The beach is not for the families with kids.
reviews.text: The place is beatufil but not to enjoy the swiming in the sea with kids. The steep descent into the water. For adults it might be fine. But for the families with kids there are otger places much more suitable.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: It really is a very beautiful beach, fun and very clean, they have showers and public bathrooms to change and rinse, I have yet to visit more but this was very good.

reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.text: Nice beach with easy parking access, local bus system will also drop you off at the main entrance. There are restaurants nearby therefore bring your own amenities. Depending on the currents, wind and waves  the water may not be swimmable, there are only 2 lifeguard stations on the public beach stretch. Amazing views just look at the submitted pictures and plenty of wanna be instagramers/influencers thinking this is their personnel beach

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever seen. You'll think the pictures are photoshopped until you see it with your own eyes. It is really that beautiful! Water was nice, warm and incredibly blue!

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: A very nice beach, quiet and clean, I liked it very much to be here, everything is very nice and serene, I hope to visit more beaches on this vacation.

reviews.title: good place
reviews.text: My trip to CANCUN was spectacular, the colour of the sea there is unforgettable, the sun is just right, but as always you have to be lucky for everything.

reviews.title: Overrated and crowded
reviews.text: I don't have any awesome experience to share. It was crowded and somewhat dirty. Beach at my resort has similar or better views with clean beach.

reviews.title: Cool place
reviews.text: Relaxing days enjoying beach and party. A very nice place for vacations  A good service and beautiful accommodation. I will be back.

reviews.title: Nice view of the ocean
reviews.text: Visited the beach at about 6 in the morning, just in time to watch the sunrise. There was nobody there so the whole place was very quiet and peaceful. The scenery here was just stunning.I know that a lot of people in the comment section complained about the seaweed problem, but compared to where I stayed at (Royalton Riviera) which is further south from the beach, there was a lot less seaweed at the beach the day I was there so I don't think it is a huge problem.Definitely recommend you to go just for the view.

reviews.title: Publically accessible beach
reviews.text: This is one of the few publically accessible beaches in Cancun.We reached it via taxi from our hotel at a significant cost. The beach itself was nice but unfortunately like a lot of Cancun beaches at the moment it was covered in seaweed so not nice to swim in. We decided to walk up the beach from this entry point and this was a big mistake. I didnt think it was possible to do but they have actually developed resorts in such a way along the beach that you are unable to exit the beach back to the main road. We walked for about 2km before we were able to find a resort in which we could traverse back to the main road (Where we got a bus outwards). Most resorts have heavy security so it is not easy to do.Overall this beach was OK but not worth the significant effort of getting to.

reviews.title: Good beach
reviews.text: The beach is very nice, they have public restrooms, and rest area nearby with cost but it's ok, I really liked that the water is clear.

reviews.title: Worth to visit
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, with the Cancun sign to take amazing photos. There are always lines to take pictures, but it’s worth it. There are public restrooms and showers.

reviews.title: Nice Scenery But Not Much Else
reviews.text: Arriving in our taxi, this beach looked gorgeous. Rows of shady palapas free to use and decently kept bathrooms open to all. (In Cancun, nothing is free.)Once we ventured down to the sand, however, it was not very impressive. There were zero services for food or drink. Not even a vendor walking around selling cold drinks from a cooler or anything. Zip.I asked the bathroom attendant where one could get snacks or a beer, and she said go back up to the street level and walk down the street to a convenience store.The seaweed was so thick and the riptide so strong, you can’t really swim either - you just wade in and stand there.  Mountains of seaweed as far down the beach as you can see. I realize there’s not much anyone can do about the seaweed, but nevertheless it does detract from the experience. And like I said, no one was challenging the riptide that I could see, so everyone is packed within about 10 meters of the beach itself.Please note also that certain sections of the bathroom facilities etc. are roped off due to ongoing construction and there is rubble and debris in those areas.There is also one of those ubiquitous photo opp signs in big colorful letters: CANCUN, that everyone takes a photo next to for instagram. It does not matter when you go there, day or night, there is a line of 25 to 50 people waiting to take a photograph next to these letters. I do not understand the allure of this, but anytime we ever drove past this point there was a line down the sidewalk in the hot sun to take a photo next to these letters.Ultimately, we paid $20 for the cab ride to the beach. We each wait it out and got wet in the waves and then sat under the Palapa and dried off. In total we were there less than a half an hour and pretty much got our fill. Then we paid another $20 to go back to our hotel to use the rooftop pool. Pretty scenery but nothing else going for this place.

reviews.title: Overhyped
reviews.text: The beach was crowded and Covered in seaweed. So much seaweed it was unpleasant to swim in. It has some limited shade and they don’t offer any chairs or towels to rent like other beaches.

reviews.title: The encounter with the dolphins
reviews.text: This place is for lovers of calm, it has a tropical climate where you can enjoy it, it has excellent services. You can relax in the shade of one of the many parasols. When you arrive at Playa de los Delfines you can see that its services are free, there is even a beach for children, I recommend this place because it is amazing how the dolphins are well trained and very beautiful. What makes it really look like an unforgettable experience is its surroundings, since it has a spectacular country ideal for resting.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH
reviews.text: It is a very beautiful beach from the outside that you must visit when you go to Cancun with your family or friends, the color of the sea is incredible contrasting with the white sand, it is a very crowded beach since the Cancun sign is found and everyone comes to drink a beautiful photo. This beach is public and has parking and surveillance, as well as bathroom services and tables to sit and enjoy the view, as well as being quite safe and it is located 20 minutes from downtown Cancun or 10 minutes from the hotel zone. It is a good beach to visit on vacation

reviews.title: gorgeous ocean view
reviews.text: Five minutes walk from our resort, we went there early in the morning. This beach has a gorgeous ocean view.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful and within walking distance or a quick taxi ride from most hotels. It is very touristy, but still gorgeous with the soft sand, clear water and blue skies. Visit this beach and relax if you can.

reviews.title: Way too much seaweed
reviews.text: The view is nice, but however, there is way too much seaweed. People clearly are not trying hard enough to remove the seaweed from the beach. However, they have umbrellas to sit in the shade. Don’t go here during seaweed season, there are many other beaches that are better than this.

reviews.title: Ok beach to spend an hour or two
reviews.text: We were told this beach was the best in Cancun, but it's an ok beach, not a great one.People could spend a bit of time here quite happily, but it's definitely not a paradise beachThe beach is ok and the water can be a bit choppy.For far better beaches, head to Mujeres Island, 20mins away by ferry and costing pennies to reach.

reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: The mexican Caribbean sea at it's best! Went on a Sunday morning. Lot of waves, clean sand. The water is a bit cold in January. Easy access with R1 bus.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach I have ever seen, but not for swim
reviews.text: This is by far one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. It is easy to get get there as any bus in Cancun will take you there. It is located in one of the ends of the Kukulkan Blvd. where the access for the beach is located. There are bathrooms available and canopies to give you some shade. Not lots of trees, if any at all to hide from the burning sun. The beach is below under a cliff (access was built - like stairs, however I am not sure if it's modified with wheelchair ramps).Here is the catch: There are a natural reef wall in the shallow part of the beach, right in the area where the wave crashes. It makes it impossible to swim, as the reef wall  natural stone can cut your skin. Also right behind the reef wall the ocean is deep and rough. There are Red flags up along this beach area and coast near by. If you decide to walk along the shore, be aware that the next exit, called Playa Publica (Public Beach) is next to 4 kms walking at the Balenas beach as most of the coast is occupied by private hotel/resorts.  I saw around 3 swimmable spots and it was crowded with people.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach to not swim
reviews.text: Go early to enjoy the beach w/ very little people. Beautiful scenery but not calm to swim. You can park there or take the bus.

reviews.title: Best beach of cancun
reviews.text: Cancun's best beach for sure. One of the few beaches where parking is not a pain and some excellent restaurants nearby.

reviews.title: INteresting. Local and Tourist Beach Hangout! 150 people out in the water?
reviews.text: Probably Cancun's best beach, I imagine. Though I have not visited alot. Large sand area, lots of swimming, police and security presence around to keep watch, and people! Obviously the popular local and mayeb touristy beach spot. If you are looking to swim a little, this is the place.

reviews.text: Hermos lugar, since I been there I had nice time, the people, the food was great also the place what we visited, this is the best place to forget about your problem in life.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Acces to the beach easy by bus or car. The beach was beautiful but quite crowded for a Friday morning. The waves were quite fierce today ,red flags, no swimming today for me. No restaurants around sobe sure to bring your own stuff.  There are some vendors around that sell some food and drinks. The food is homemade stuff so you are not sure what you are getting. The drinks (beer, margaritas, etc...)usually watered down and cost around 7 dollars. Way too much.Also of note, bathrooms close at 5 pm,  so make sure you go before then

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach. We had a lot of fun. The sand and the sea is beautiful, free outdoor showers are perfect. I love the Cancun sign.

reviews.title: Cancun Sign
reviews.text: This is the best Cancun sign to take a picture for your memories in Cancun. There are other locations to photograph the Cancun sign but this is the perfect one! Don't miss this one.

reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.text: A place to remember! We had an amazing experience, weather was awesome and people so kind. Will be back with my friends next year.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful here
reviews.text: Beautiful sight see… and nice place to just chill on the white sand, under the beach stationary umbrellas. The ocean surf is a bit too strong for a swim (my taste), but water is crystal clear. It’s unspoiled by hotels and businesses - very natural feel.

reviews.title: Pretty beach
reviews.text: Very pretty public beach. A little crowded by not rowdy. Very pleasant and no seaweed. Definitely somewhere I'll visit again.

reviews.title: Beach playground
reviews.text: The kids playground and area near to it was littered with discarded paraphernalia of injecting sort used recreationally and by addicts. That is not good enough. The saving grace is that the water color is appealing to your eyes. Bring in your sunglasses.

reviews.title: Almost excellent but...
reviews.text: I would love to give it a 5 because it is truly breathtaking and beautiful. The pictures do not do it justice as far as the turquoise and different shades of blue in the water. The parking is free, which is always good and appreciated, the two biggest issues were the violent surf which makes going in entertaining for a short period of time but not really fun. We could go out maybe 15 yards and that was it before the undertow carried you out to sea. Along with that, the sand, really very very small pebbles, gets in your trunks and embeds itself in your skin, which is very difficult to remove.

reviews.title: Great beach south of Zona Hoteliera
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is a long and wide stretch of beautiful white powder sand just south from the hotel zone.You won't need to come here if you're staying at one of the hotels by the beach north, as this is the same beach stretching for miles.However, even then I'd recommend doing that to mix up with locals who gather here as this is the public beach and a favorite local spot. On the other hand, for those staying at city ho(s)tels I'd strongly recommend it. You can choose your spot anywhere for free or hire sunbeds and umbrellas for a reasonable fee.

reviews.title: Sandy beach
reviews.text: Public beach at the Zona Hotelera. Easy to rent equipment to make yourself comfortable at decent prices. Restroom facilities too small for big crowds.

reviews.title: NICE AND COOL
reviews.text: perfect for a family picnic there is plenty of space if you want to play with your children or friends you could spend there all day

reviews.title: A wide width, a great view & a lovely sign :)
reviews.text: At pretty far south along the great stretch of sand for several kilometers right alongside Boulevard Kukulcan running through the Hotel Zone of Cancun (about 9 or 10 kilometers in total, I would say, consisting of beaches with various names) is this part of that great stretch where yes quite likely is "the widest" of all those beaches with one reason being the lack of oceanfront high-rises unlike at the other beaches along the stretch (definitely wider than Playa Chacmool near where I stayed at about 8 kilometers to the north which is an area just cluttered with plenty of high-rises right beside that beach).  And then yes, there are three "enhanced features" of this beach including one on it & two right above: a number of "straw umbrellas", a "viewing deck" for a great panorama of the "deep-blue" sea & wide sky above (where at the time was some long kite flying in the air), and a nice-sized & colorful 'Cancun' sign (for a pretty good photo-op with the sea in the background).  And with no significantly big waves that I could see walking right up to the water's edge, this may be a good beach for a swim (but so it seemed also at Playa Chacmool near my place and only to get pummeled by the waves after entering so that beach not one I would suggest!).And nearby, which is just across Blvd. Kukulcan and a short few-minute walk to the left after coming up from this beach, is the El Rey "ruin site" (with a nice number of structures on a rectangular ground to walk back & forth between its two ends); and not too close to this beach but to get to easily by just taking a short ride of 5 to 10 minutes on a public bus is the big museum Museo Maya de Cancun (with not too many but a fair number of Mayan artifacts and where there's also just adjacent to the museum building is the small site of San Miguelito which is like a mini-forest with a few number of ruin structures).
