And also, as for the 'Cancun' sign (as mentioned above), there are also two more of that sign pretty identical to the one above this beach (one which is a "lakeside sign" right beside the big Nichupte Lake on the opposite side of Blvd. Kukulcan and about 6 or 7 kilometers to the north from this beach which is just a little past La Isla Shopping Village; and one at like the "downtown or centro" area of the Hotel Zone which is actually the one I "highly suggest" with also a great outdoor wall mural nearby depicting a "quaint & colorful" scene of the old Cancun or such).

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Well worth the visit.  Especially if your resort doesn't have a nice beach.  The view is stunning, and the water beautiful.

reviews.title: Good but crowded
reviews.text: I thought of visiting this beach since it is popular, but it was really crowded. Best to do is to get there early so you don't have a lot of people at the time.

reviews.title: Perfect with kids
reviews.text: Worth to visit, we went with kids and they like that sea is very calm. Depends on the wind. Take snacks with you

reviews.title: I like the sea
reviews.text: whenever I arrive in CancunI love getting to this beach I recommend it to everyone A nice place I love

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This beat is absolutely beautiful you won't find many better than this easy to get to so easy to enjoy everyone was friendly and help make my time a wonderful experience

reviews.title: Beatiful Beach
reviews.text: It is a big beach so there is plenty of space for everyone! The waves are usually quite big and that is the only downside. There is a 'Cancun' sign with a nice background for a photo but... the queue to it is usually quite long! It is easily accessible by bus or if you coming by car then there is a car park.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Not very crowded considering it's a public beach.  There are fruit stands,  palapas, and rinsing areas. The sand is very clean and I would highly recommend coming here if you don't feel like paying for a beach club. Grab a cooler with some food and snacks!

reviews.title: Beautiful public  beach but the tides are high
reviews.text: I loved the beach, it was clean and so blue. This is where you find the famous Cancun sign that many tourists stop by and take pictures at. It is a public beach. There was a little hut by a Tiki bar that offered a massage. I had the most amazing massage for an hour and only paid $20 tip included. It was a better massage than a 30 min massage at my 5 star hotel which costed me over $400. I recommend this beach, you'll love the pristine blue waters and the pictures you'll take will be immaculate

reviews.title: Playa Delfines
reviews.text: Huge beach with parking in front. Crystal blue sea, but to many waves. Pay attention on local people, everyone wants to robber you. There is only one very expensive place where you can buy food and drink.

reviews.title: Definitely Most Beautiful Beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Most stunning and widest stretch of the beach in Cancun. Ideal for relaxing after a long day of tourism around the city. It's waters are the bluest ever, perfect temperature, and not too wavy. It's white sand goes as far as the eyes can carry, and it's not too hot as usually you would expect in very sunny places. The beach is very clean, and great for all ages. Saw many people doing kite surf, canoeing, and jet skiing. Swimming is perfect and no need to worry about little ones as the water level barely reaches higher than your (adult's) knees. There are safeguards running up and down the beach throughout all day. I couldn't see vendors of water and food, but there were public toilets available - with showers. It's easier to reach this beach by car, but a very convenient bus stop is right on the sidewalk. It's a perfect spot for photos. Take your camera!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is a nice place to spend the afternoon. The beach is very beautiful and clean. Would definitely go back.

reviews.title: Obligatory Photo shot 😂
reviews.text: Great beach 🏖... Lots of people so you know its excellent. One thing people flock this site is because of the “Cancun” sign by the road. Line quite long but if you get there in the early morning it’s pretty much to yourself. An obligatory visit and to take a photo with the sign when in Cancun.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Nice spot to take pictures.  Go at a off time to take pictures.  Like really early in the morning.  It has the CANCUN sign to take pictures in front of the beach.

reviews.title: You won't see a beach like the anywhere.
reviews.text: This beach will blow your mind. What a way to be introduced to the sea. Just unbelievable. Color that goes on forever.

reviews.title: Beautiful sandy beach - What a view
reviews.text: Went with the kids, and had a great time. We arrived at around 8am, and it was essentially deserted. There are bathrooms (yes you will pay for tp if you need/want any). The waves were awesome that day, and the beach was super clean and free of any debris. There is a little bit of an undertoe, so be careful if you're not a swimmer, and I certainly wouldn't suggest letting the kids swim without supervision. I know it starts to get busy around 11am, so we took off at about that time, and grabbed a shower to clean off before we jumped back in the car.

reviews.title: Very Windy
reviews.text: It was very windy and the sea was too wavey to swim in. It was 250 pesos to hire sunbeds and an umbrella but unfortunately we got scammed, the guy went off to get us change and sent someone else over giving us the wrong amount of change (he pocketed 50 pesos) so we couldn’t even dispute it as he didn’t understand us. The beach was clean but there are much nicer beaches that are less touristy elsewhere.

reviews.title: Beautiful sand and sea - beach, blue waters
reviews.text: This is a great place to spend a few hours, especially if you have a few hours to kill before your flight out.  it is located  just 15 minutes by car from the airport and It is used by locals.Sun bed (2) and umbrella can be had for around 250 paso. A bar for drinks is also right here, although no food.This beach is right by the Hotel Zone and enjoys beautiful soft sand beaches and delightful pure blue waters.

reviews.title: 31st Birthday
reviews.text: Really beautiful sand its white the water is clear that u can see right thru its really awesome i love it never seen a place like this beautiful.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Today we were there but it was quite windy. Some people told us it was absolutely beautiful when the water was flat. It's at the end of the hotel zone way at the end and it was worth the trek. There are a few guys back and  forth  selling coconut, fruit and trying to promote the restaurant. Prices for the restaurant were way overpriced. But there's nothing else out there. Palapas for free. You could rent a lounger if you wanted to pay. We would go back it was a lovely day.

reviews.title: A dream away from building
reviews.text: I counted 5 shades of blue of the water from indigo to shades of turquoise and baby blue. Lovely spot with umbrella (250 pesos all day) Quiet compared to other areas.

reviews.title: Comfy
reviews.text: this beach was nice and comfy. My wife and I spent a good five or six hours there and we met nice people! We really enjoyed our time there and will definitely be going back when we have the chance to plan another and hopefully longer trip to Cancun.

reviews.title: Top world beach
reviews.text: The contrast of white sand and aqua crystal clear waters, make this place unique!Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Stunning Sunrise it’s Just Beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful in all the aspects. We arrived early so we decided to go see the sunrise at this beach, let me tell you it will for everything be an amazing memory.

reviews.title: Simply beautiful
reviews.text: I walked up from the Mayan Museum just so I could get my picture at the Cancun sign. There was not a long wait when I went (about 10 mins but I went about 930am) and everyone waited patiently while others were getting their photo taken. I was a solo traveler and it was not an issue getting someone to take my picture. The area was completely safe and I recommend it if you want to get your photo op at the sign.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: We were there last Saturday and it was a little hard to find a parking spot across the street, so be patient if you're driving. There are public bathrooms. The beach is beautiful and the sea waves are stunning.  The umbrella guys trying to rent you an umbrella are annoying,  but you can put your towels anywhere on the beach without charge, like all the beaches we visited in the Riviera Maya,  even if you're in front of a resort beach. All beaches are public.

reviews.title: Public Beach
reviews.text: One of the few public beaches.At my time of visit (November/December2019) not crowded.Only a few local people want to sell drinks and snacks, but they are friendly and not annoying.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: The draw here for most visitors is the Cancun sign, but the beach itself is absolutely beautiful and extremely clean. Even though it’s a public beach for locals, it’s right in the middle of the hotel zone, but easy to get to by public transportation. We were there on a weekday but the beach was pretty crowded, so I can only imagine what the crowd might look like on the weekends. Nevertheless, it’s a breathtaking setting not to be missed.

reviews.title: Delfines, beautiful and captivating
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the area of Cancun is Delfines (Dolphins), you might even have the chance to see one if you're lucky. White sand, light blue and light green ocean, plenty of space to enjoy and a perfect spot to have a selfie.

reviews.title: great experiences
reviews.text: It is a magical experience, I visit it, it is cheap and they have luxury, the hotels are comfortable

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: This beach is close to the center of Cancun and I went easily by bus to there. It is clean. I walked there a long precursor to visiting closed areas. It was very calm and cool.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: I have visited several beaches in Quintana Roo and Delfines is my favorite. The waves can hit a bit hard for small children. However, it has an incredible view and good food service! Love, love this beach!

reviews.title: Never seen a beach like it
reviews.text: Never been on a beach holiday it wasn't my cup tea but i will say that the beach is beautiful it is a must see. Not too busy was lovely we took a stroll along the beach it was hot so defiantly wear a hat.

reviews.title: Cancun Mexico
reviews.text: This place is amazing. It is definitely a must see. The beaches are heavenly. The locals can get persistent at times, but I guess that's business.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We loved the view. Theres so much to get into and its really relaxing. Great to take pictures for photo shoots and also a wonderful place to SLEEEEEEEP

reviews.title: beautiful and clean beach
reviews.text: Thia vbeach is relaly beautiful and very clean. Its a very good place for family outing . Especially in the evening

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: I think the best part of Playa Delfines is that there are free umbrellas to use. And like any other beach access int he hotel zone it has showers, toilets, and rental of beach chairs, drinks, and food. Make sure to bring your own soft drinks and water since the drinks available are mostly cocktails and beer. I went there several times since I lived in Cancun, and it is the best beach to go for a swim

reviews.title: Beautiful but with plenty of people
reviews.text: This beach is really beautiful, but with a lot of people on it. We came from Oleo hotel, by bus, and had a crazy experience with a stupid driver of R2 27. This guy drove like crazy whike speaking of the phone or searching for music on the phone, so we enjoyed even more to arrive on the beach.

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach, Beautiful White Sand!
reviews.text: We have visited this gorgeous beach on the way to Cancun and really loved it, the water was so clean and blue, sand was so nice and there where only few people on the beach. Be careful of the high surf break, some of the waves looked very strong. Would love to come back there next time.

reviews.title: love it
reviews.text: if you are running out of beach time in your hotel, this is the beach to stay. Bars are quiet expensive therefore a beer or soda can hit 2,50 dollars. However you do have a beach bed or table and umbrella....of course it depends on the time you arrive to find place

reviews.title: Welcome to Cancun!
reviews.text: The most beautiful place to see the sea. Yeah the big sign is there, but that's nothing compared to the view.

reviews.title: Can't relax
reviews.text: Fantastic clean white sand beach but you can't relax because you bombarded by vendors and waiters who are selling stuffs like cold-drinks, palapas, towels, soda, food, etc and feel irritated.

reviews.title: An iconic beach!
reviews.text: The Playa Delfines seems to be located dead in the centre of the spit upon which the almost 'over the top' Zona Hotelera has been constructed. There is also an iconic sign at which so many visitors take their souvenir snapshots. We gave that one a miss, though, and instead concentrated upon the lovely turquoise waters and soft white sands..

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful part of cancun If you have the time go and visit Coastline there is lovely and peaceful. Well worth it

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Fantastic clean white sand beach with very little seaweed present when I visited.  Didn't use them but there were toilet & shower facilities available.  Public bus stop at one of the main entrances to the beach which run to & from Cancun Centro.  I think the cost was 12 peso one way.

reviews.title: I don't understand the buzz...
reviews.text: Perhaps I came in with expectations that were too high, but this beach was described as a 'must-see' on this and many other review sites. The biggest and best in Cancun. We came in as a family of four hoping for a perfect beach day but we left this beach after about two hours. Yes, the beach is massive, the sand is nice like most Yucatan beaches and there are so many places to sit. But we were constantly bombarded by vendadores and waiters selling us coco-drinks, tables, palapas, towels, soda, food, etc. that it was never very comfortable or relaxing. There was some sargassum on the shores and shallow areas although overall the water was still nice and beach was walkable. Snorkeling and swimming were out of the question due to the high and turbulent surf. We did have fun jumping in the waves and were surprised at how far the shallow water extends. This is the beach with the colorful 'Cancun' selfie sign, so there are ALWAYS cars and people in the single row parking lot. They usually have attendants at the street side lot helping to guide you in - of course expecting compensation for their efforts. I just don't understand the 4.5 star rating for this beach. It wasn't nearly as nice as other public beaches. The beach in front of our hotel was so much better than Playa Delfines. If you don't have a hotel beach, there are many, many better public beach options nearby. One note: access to the beach is provided by a very steep stairway.

reviews.title: Amazing Local Beach
reviews.text: Playa Delfines was simply amazing. We rented chairs with umbrellas for about $16 per person for 6 hours. They have a restaurant/bar on the beach which was perfect. The food was so tasty and affordable. I would definitely recommend taking the bus from your hotel (only $1) and hitting up this local beach.

reviews.title: Nice, public beach
reviews.text: There's a beach along the entire 10-mile or so length of the Zona Hotelera, but this is one of the few areas with public access. It's very lively on weekends with lots of families, people selling food and drinks, insane wind surfers, and generally people having a fun afternoon.

reviews.title: Great great great!
reviews.text: Not many beaches without seaweed, and this is one of them. Always a place to find to sit, a lot of palapas if you come early, onl down side are the big tourist numbers, bit hey - that's why you are here, and they are here.Great place for a walk, for a swim and to spend a day.

reviews.title: The beach looks gorgeous
reviews.text: Also here is the famous view in which you will find the "CANCUN" letter sign. I recommend bringing a cool drink if you are planning on staying there!

reviews.title: Very nice colors, what a pity with this seaweed
reviews.text: The beach is very beautiful, a good place for surfing and swimming. What a pity with this seaweed.... the beach it’s very accessible with public bus (R1/R2) cost 12 pesos one way. You can stop the bus everywhere. Take your beverages, or you can order something (cocktails with alcool 150 pesos, without 120 pesos). The mexican authorities are trying to clean this beach, but the waves are powerful and a lot algas are dropped to the seashore.

reviews.title: Cool spot
reviews.text: We spent the better part of the day hanging out on this beach, it was cool.  The water is rough in this area but really beautiful.  There was quite a bit of seaweed the day we went but it was still really nice.  We rented a umbrella and chairs & also purchased some adult beverages right on the beach at a really affordable price.  As a bonus we snapped a few pics with the Cancun sign before we left.

reviews.title: The Cancun selfie sign
reviews.text: This is the place for the selfie.Few iguanas to grab a picture.Beach was clean when we turned up, it was early morning to void waiting in the heat.Took a bus for a dollar each way from the main hotel zone.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: It's an aesthetically pleasing beach with the nice colourful Cancun sign. When we visited the beach there were loads of people lined up to take a pic by it but on passing around 6am, it was basically empty. It is accessible by public transport but we had a rental car. There was a person in the car park who was aggressively demanding a tip and even waited for us when we were leaving. When arriving on the beach, multiple persons tried to sell us various items. We eventually purchased food and drink and some beach chairs. The water was rough, high waves and there was a dip in the sea floor (at least at the location that I was at). There was a lot of sargassum on the shoreline as well as floating in the water. The amazing thing was the toilets. The free toilets are located at three places across the beach, there are maps on the beach that can identify them. Yeh attendant was VERY pleasant and ensured everyone had much of a clean experience as possible.

reviews.title: Sargassum is very bad at the beach.  You can smell it from quite a ways away.
reviews.text: Unfortunately the Sargassum seaweed epidemic is getting worse every year.  The smell is amazingly strong and the seaweed piles and floating mats are huge.  Definitely cuts your visit short.

reviews.title: O.k . amenities
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful, IF YOU HAVE A CAR- we are staying in Cancun centro and were dropped of by our taxi there, thank god the taxi driver told me that it was very difficult to get a return taxi (& it was true I tried getting a return taxi w my app and it did not work), so keep that in mind. We arranged a ride back how ever from Cancun centro to the beach it was only $212 pesos but to come back it was $600. The beach is not worth all that to me.

reviews.title: Best beach with little seaweed!
reviews.text: After being crushed because of the seaweed situation here we found this beach.  Close to the Cancun sign its clean. The seaweed is control and not much in the water.  We were greeted by a beach vendor that got us 2 beach chairs and an umbrella. He came with a menu for drinks and food throughout the day. Very relaxing.  Free food vendors walking around with local treats like fruit and shrimp cocktails. A few guys treated us with music for a tip. ( Spanish rap) my kids stayed in the water for hours and were not ready to go. They even saw iguanas which are the norm in this area. Good spot worth visiting if you want crystal water without the fuss.

reviews.title: Great Local's beach!
reviews.text: At the beginning of the hotel zone. We'd been many years ago, but this time it seemed to be really busy most days. A bit of seaweed right now but a beautiful beach!

reviews.title: What a welcome to cancun.
reviews.text: You really know you're in Cancun when you hit the big cancun sign. People are lined up to have their picture taken with the cancun SAM. But what's really the attraction is the beach in the city itself. Absolutely stunning

reviews.title: Popular Cancun Sign
reviews.text: We went there to take some photos by the Cancun sign. There was a lengthy wait so make sure to wear your sunscreen and a hat. I suggest getting there as early as possible because the later you go in the day, the more people will be there.

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach, we stayed in a hotel about 20 min from here! We took public transportation to the beaches. This one has the colorful Cancun sign. Make sure you wear sunscreen, sunglasses & hat there is a long line. Oh & water bottle. You can seat on a covered umbrella for 20 pesos. We ordered a hamburger meal. The hamburger was the best I've tried not exaggerating! You can order coconut water. Once your done with the water they come & pick it up chop the coconut up for you add lime and hot sauce for you to eat. All while you just sitting at the beautiful beach like a queen 😂

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beautiful beach nice and clean and clear sand. Nice friendly locals so friendly and sea water was warm.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Got there early to get a free palapa - thought we wouldn't need sunscreen if we stayed in the shade - ouch! Use it! Easy free parking!

reviews.title: Beach....love and towel
reviews.text: Amazing views and sunny days...great se and sand for free parking or depens1 your hotel location you can walk nice pictures

reviews.title: Great view
reviews.text: One of the most popular beaches in Cancun.The view is amazing but the beach wasn't like the pictures I have seen, there was seaweed but not too much, the color of the water is crystal blue however it was too windy so we couldn't swim.

reviews.title: PERFECT WAVES and tranquility!
reviews.text: We use to live in Cancun back in the 90s and this beach was our HANG OUT! Its better now since they added bath rooms and palapas! Its beautiful and we go back every year! Please check it out if you are a BEACH DWELLER!! Its one of the best beaches in the world!

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL OMG
reviews.text: I must say this beach is so damn beautiful. wow. so clean so scenic and epic that I took 2 hours just enjoying the moment. the huts that line the beach made it feel so tropical and exotic. very close to hotels and public buses going to and from this beauty. lots of police walking around making you feel safe. one thing I would say is to walk with your own food and drinks. Very windy and the water was very choppy and strong currents so be aware. Could just been the time of the year. but I must say enjoy this beach as much as I did and Thank me later.

reviews.title: Beauriful beach
reviews.text: A really lovely beach with excellent amenities nearby. Free,  toilets 5 pesos, and many shops. Notably surfing coconut

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach very close to our hotel. Water was very choppy today but beautiful anyway. Police around so felt very safe.

reviews.title: Great public beach but bring your own food
reviews.text: I like this beach very accessible to public bus using R1/R2 going in and out of hotel zone. You have to bring your own food though because there are no restaurants nearby or food trucks. There’s a Cancun sign there that always have long lines so be there early.

reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text: The color of the Caribbean Sea in Cancun is simply spectacular, it falls in love with anyone. Arriving, seeing and taking a picture in front of the Caribbean Sea is almost instantaneous. In Playa Delfines is the most requested viewpoint, the place of the photo.

reviews.title: Beautiful Canton!
reviews.text: We just returned from our Anniversary trip to Cancun. We had an Amazing time! Stayed at the Royal Solaris (7 nights) and Panama Jack's ( for one night). We felt VERY safe everywhere we visited, walked and rode the public bus. The beaches had little Sargassum when we arrived, but 4 days in we could see huge patches of it in the water coming in, which made pretty large piles in the sand. All the beach along the Hotel zone was the same. Our week was fantastic! We did swim in the ocean but it was super windy the entire time which made the waves larger than normal and lots of areas with riptides. We are already planning our next trip later this year, after visiting Los Cabos!

reviews.title: top #4
reviews.text: If you are tired of the standard beaches along the Hotel Zone, visit Playa Delfines, a beautiful and very large beach with fine sand and slightly intense waves located near El Rey archaeological zone. Here, you can rent chairs and beach umbrellas as well as bring your own drinks and snacks. You will also find bathrooms, showers, "palapas" and parking lot, all these services totally free. Here you will also find a beautiful wooden lookout with the colorful "Cancún" sign that appears on many of the city´s postcards and brochures.

reviews.title: Seriously lovely public beach
reviews.text: Our AirBnB host recommended Delfines to us - and we visited twice. Jaw dropping ocean colors. We found parking with ease (tipped $4 US). The beach is clean as people care for it and pick up after themselves. We brought our own sun cover, but they are available for rent. Bring pesos on the weekend to buy beach food from fresh fruit to fried items. A big drink is $150 plus tip (come on they are running in the hot sun!) Waves crash right at the shoreline so it can be 'fun' getting in and out of the water, but it is so lovely to wave hop. Great people watching, felt safe as there were so many families. $10 pesos if you need to use facilities. Colors are just amazing and you are away from the hotel zone.  We loved it.

reviews.title: Super
reviews.text: I really enjoy Cancun, day trip , beach, day trip, beach...and I would do again worm water, white sand, turquoise seaGo for it, I am not even beach boy

reviews.title: Very nice public beach (playa)
reviews.text: Long and nice public playa, reachable via public buses from any place in Cancun, possible servis if you want (drink, food), not annoying people, "coconut" umbrella for free.Sea not peaceful therefore not ideal for swimming but waves great enough to enjoy for hours. ;-)

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: As an American in Cancun for an all-inclusive vacation, I'd wondered about this public beach. This trip, I walked down the sand to this beach. It's suprising to me both the size and available amenities.

reviews.title: Best local open beach!
reviews.text: This is one of the local open beaches along the city coast within the hotel zone. The public is welcome to take an ice chest with any beverages as long as they are cans. Safe & secure. Also open to the public 24/7. There is a beach lounge chair & umbrella service available for free as long a you buy drinks from them. Only a few options, about $8/1 liter cocktail.

reviews.title: dolphins were great
reviews.text: Dolphin Discovery was a great experience. used our resort credit from Moon Palace. when we arrived at dolphin discovery they first offered an upgrade to 2 dolphins for $30 usd per person. then we swam with tbe one dolphin. it was very well organized. dolphins were amazing. woyldnt let you take your own pictures tho. their pictures were $40 per person per picture. or $240 for like 20 pictures. they WERE great photos, but we just couldnt add tbat cist after spending $220 already. :( i do wish we had a couple photos. but the experience was great.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Spent an afternoon here on recent trip to Cancun. This is the beach were the CANCUN sign is.  Nice beach with public access.

reviews.title: Worth the stop!
reviews.text: This is the largest of the public beaches in Cancun's Hotel Zone. The parking area/entrance is elevated above the beach itself so the views are amazing! They also have the giant mulit-colored "CANCUN" sign here but be prepared to wait in line as it's the most popular.They have showers and baths, free palapas for shade, handicap accessible and plenty of room. There are not many options for food or drink near this beach. There is usually one small bar/restaurant open down on the beach, just look for the shaded hut. You fill find locals selling water and fruit but don't expect a large selection of places offering food and drink. Best to go prepared with water and snacks. They also offer chairs and umbrellas for rent if you prefer a more comfortable setup.

reviews.title: Nice public Beach!
reviews.text: It is a place which many people visit, not only for the beach, but because if the famous sign of CANCUN, where many people take a picture. So, you might have to wait to take yours

reviews.title: The view was incredible
reviews.text: This was my first time in Cancun and I went with my family. We have fun in the Playa Delfines, the view was incredible and we take a lot of photos on the big letters of Cancun!

reviews.title: Best Cancún beach !
reviews.text: Nice blue water, spacious, not much overcrowded, quiet enough to have siesta in the shadow. Just the only restaurant-bar is a bit pricy. Easy excess by a bus from Zona Hoteliera, free of charge umbrella if you are lucky enough to reserve on time, save enough with police passing by time to time.

reviews.title: One of the world’s most beautiful beaches
reviews.text: Cancun certainly has some of the world’sMost beautiful beaches with its white sand and brilliant water colors!Playa Delfines is Cancun at its most picturesque. It’s worth a special trip to see it if you’re anywhere else n the area!

reviews.title: Public beach
reviews.text: Great public beach with parking, bathrooms and shade. Minimal parking available. Great views. Soft sand. Lookout point and picture opportunity. Large CANCUN sign for pictures.

reviews.title: A great day at the beach!
reviews.text: We had a great day at Playa Delfines this week. The parking is along the street and the attendants work for tips. There was a lot of room on the beach and it was very clean. There are a lot of waiters along the beach, but they are very respectful if you don't order. We did order some tacos and guacamole. Delicious!Also, the waves are rough, but we were able to play in the surf a bit. We would go back!

reviews.title: Beautiful Sandy
reviews.text: I stayed at Club Presidente because I felt I needed to be by the strip.  Don't get me wrong it was beautiful. However was able to experience a all inclusive hotelthey had everything you could imagine 5 pools, games, nightclub, casino, theatre plus more. You don't pay for anything, no hassle carrying cash no where or risks of getting robbed. Everything in located and included in ur stay even your transportation to and from airport.

reviews.title: Just for the view
reviews.text: Visit this beach only for the Cancún sign and that is about it. The waves and sea life at this location makes it dangerous to go for a swim.

reviews.title: Best beach I have ever been to
reviews.text: Before vising Cancun, I searched for best beach for family and most people recommended this beach. When I reached the beach, I was awestruck with the beauty of this beach. Crystal clear turquoise blue water with just the perfect waves...The water was not cold so you can enjoy playing in the beach as much as you want.. It also has good showers and washrooms which you can used by paying very minimum feed of 5 pesos; I am sure you will tip more than that :-)  It also has a kind of observatory deck where you can take photos to make your friends jealous :-) If you go to Cancun, don't miss this beach. Happy traveling

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: White sand and turquoise crystal water is what you’ll find in all the Mexican Caribbean coast. Sometimes you can even surf a little. The beach itself is gorgeous, and if staying at a 5 star hotel, it’s paradise!

reviews.title: Paradise for free
reviews.text: The most beautiful location in Cancun and best of all for free! Just bring your towel and sunscreen and you’re all set! With big hotels and resorts nearby you can see a diverse crowd, and swim in the turquoise blue sea. Free chairs are provided with a valid ID.

reviews.title: Very nice beach and vieuw. But very wavy and undertow so cant go into ocean too far.
reviews.text: Quite busy and big line up in front of Cancun sign !Need to go down hill to get to beach and climb back up to leave.

reviews.title: Great looking beach
reviews.text: We didn't go into the waters but the view of the beach was lovely!      The beach itself was a bit crowded

reviews.title: Best beach in cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful beach in Cancun.  The Cancun sign is no longer there to take a photo by.  The sign corroded away. Really nice beach.  Military police presence there which while it made me safe, makes me think why they need to be there. There were some sketchy people around. Probably safe during the day but not at night.

reviews.title: A must do in Cancun
reviews.text: A nice public beach where you can hang out and enjoy the waves and sun By the way, waves were strong when I was there so don't go too far into the sea

reviews.title: Nice beach and ocean...
reviews.text: Nice beach and ocean. If you are lucky, it’s not windy. It’s like Virginia Beach or Myrtle Beach but 12 months. Drink, party and have fun...

reviews.title: Relaxation in a piece of blue heaven
reviews.text: Classic beautiful beach in Cancun located at a great spot. I would say you can bring your family there or at least it had a friendly ambience during my visit. The view was beautiful and allowed me to take a lot of nice photographs

reviews.title: Playa delphin beach cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. But watch out for these guys. There posted on beach selling jet ski rides. We bought a hour then they shortened it to 30min. Trying to get is to pay more money after 30min. Total rip off.

reviews.title: Need to go there if you're visiting
reviews.text: This is a classic place if you want a nice memory of your visit to CancunWe took a lot of pictures there and also seems like a place for all ages. I wasn't there at night but people told me is even better at the end of the day

reviews.title: Don't bother
reviews.text: This beach was highly recommended but it appeared to be a disappointment. Everyone wanted to sell us something (which of course is nothing new in Cancun) and the sand was full of sharp stones all over the place. Sure, the water is beautiful here but so it is everywhere else in the whole beach along the hotel zone. No need to come here again.

reviews.title: The best views in town
reviews.text: This is the best place to take a nice picture from your trip to Cancun, here you will be able to see all colors related to the Caribbean, and that special turquoise Cancun color

reviews.title: Best free activity to those who do not stay in hotel zone
reviews.text: A rare nice thing local government provides to those who do not stay in hotel zone. You can still enjoy the same beautiful beach without staying in most expensive resort in town. Shower, changing rooms also provided. Limited parking and prepare to wait in a line if you want to take a picture of  the sign “Cancún”. No wait, no line in early morning . This will be equivalent to people waiting in line for similar picture in Key West, FL "Southernmost" sign.

reviews.title: Public Beach area for the Local people  ANYONE
reviews.text: this Public Beach area  rarely has Delfines / Dolphins...  since the entrance to the Beach in this hotel zone is limited to hotel Guest ONLY........  the Public must have access to the Beach.......this photo is NOT this beach area....  there is NO  shade or lounge chairs

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Liz seem very hospitable.  Didn't try her roti but someone close to me bought it and seem to have enjoyed it.

reviews.title: Clean and nice
reviews.text: It looks like it is one of the nicest beaches in Cancun. Many locals you can also meet here.Waves were really high at the time we  visited it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: I went to this beach because everyone said it was a must.  It is a beatiful beach.  It is also really large, which is not the case with many other beaches,  I spent a few hours there and do recommend it.Two downsides - 1) The beach drops off where the water comes in.  Just be aware, because I saw many people fall over, not realizing there was a steep drop off.  2) the water is really rough!  I am an experienced ocean swimmer and a surfer and I found the water difficult.  The waves come in fast, right on top of each other, and it is difficult to get out far enough to not be knocked over.  Make sure you have a swimming partner!Sea weed - this is a problem all over Mexico.  They are making a huge effort to curb it's impact.  Each beach has several men raking up leaves and heavy loader trucks to cart the seaweed away, so it is manageable for tourists, but it is there and does create a foul odor.

reviews.title: Beautiful!!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful public beach in the cancun hotel zone. A easy bus trip from your hotel. and only costs 1 USD to get there.

reviews.title: the place to be
reviews.text: very nice, big and well organised beach. bring your own food and drinks cause there's OXO around. Toilets and shower available and free

reviews.title: Holiday.
reviews.text: Lovely beach with huge waves.A couple of places on the beach to eat.Just check the price of drinks as we were  charged the same price for a virgin pina colada as an alcoholic one as it was expensive.The eating place allowed you to use a sunbed for free if buying drinks etc.I believe this may be the protected beach that the turtles lay their eggs.Saw a number of large iguanas here.There are public toilets and a small shower available.If you walk this beach you cannot get off until you reach another public beach as a number of hotels are on this beach and you are not allowed access.The Cancun sign is also here but you will need to queue for a photo.Worth a visit.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Parking by donation, nice area, beautiful beach, salesmen offer refreshments or you can bring your own lunch and enjoy there,  popular tourist beach

reviews.title: Blue, blue Cancun
reviews.text: All the beaches in Cancun are public, but because of the huge hotels and beachfront development you can't get access to it! The government has remedy this by making 7 entrances to the beaches.  Playa Delfines is one of the best ones!  Great wave action, wide sandy white beach,  bathroom facilities.   Everyone goes here to take a picture with the Cancun colorful sign.  Very popular, limited parking and  congested on the weekends.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The beach was very clean and well kept . However there was not much activities on site and you could not easily get food or drinks.

reviews.title: Nice beach, bad luck
reviews.text: went there and had a problem with visa. take some cash with you... couldn´t get anything to drink and have to ask my friends to pay.  Very good place to relax

reviews.title: Public beach
reviews.text: This is a cute public beach.It also has the cancun sign for your pictures.You can bring your own food and enjoy a day in the sand

reviews.title: Clean, White sand, Blue water, beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is quite clean and beautiful. The small shades are available. It is by the Cancun Sign board. I did not see a lot of crowd during the thanks giving weekend I was visiting the city. It is one of the must go places if you are visiting Cancun.

reviews.title: Cancun Sign
reviews.text: This is one of the things I’ve always wanted to visit but was always too far away from it to make a quick stop but this time round I managed to do it me and my fiancé walked from Crown Paradise Club Cancun which took 5 mins to get there and we got there at sunrise and it was unbelievable sunrise with the Cancun sign in front we got there before any crowds gathered and had lot of time for photo opportunity although we enjoyed the sunrise while sitting on the sign we recommend it to everyone but make sure your early we did speak to a couple that waited over an hour just for a picture and were being charged for some guy to take pictures with there own camera so do be beware of this early is better

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice clean beach beyond the hotel area with public access for free, still you need to pay a parking fee. Includes showers and restrooms as well as sunbeds.

reviews.title: Seaweed
reviews.text: This used to be one of the most beautiful beaches in Quintana Roo, however, the seaweed thing makes the beach look bad, the water is almost brown and there is seaweed in and out the sea so you can swim properly either, my suggestion check the news about this before to visit it so you can pick a different beach up.

reviews.title: Especially good in low season
reviews.text: This beach has a ‘cancun’ sign so lines are up. Even in the low season. But If you walk a little bit further you’ll find small beach bars with fresh nacho’s, cocktails and beers. Loved the white sand and the abandoned crashed down hotel and the iguana’s.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Great beach the views are beautiful the water is incredible. You should stay there for hours. A must see

reviews.title: Great view
reviews.text: It's a must see place, the beaches are clean and there are places to take a shower as well as bathrooms

reviews.title: Excellent white sand shallow beach
reviews.text: Fabulous shallow water for the longest time, very clean safe beach, go to local store to pick up a lunch and drinks, several available along the road across the beach

reviews.title: Great place to be
reviews.text: It’s a really beautiful beach, it has an amazing view and it is so relaxing to be here me and my boyfriend loved this beach !!

reviews.title: Cancun beach from London
reviews.text: What an amazing place this location is - one of the best beaches I have been to.It's a family venue and always a pleasure to visit.

reviews.title: Watch your weather
reviews.text: On most days, this is one of the prettiest beaches in the world.  Clear water, waves to play in, and beach service from the little palapa restaurant.  Most swimmers are Mexican families who take the bus or drive up from Cancun City, which gives the beach a different vibe than the big hotels that flank it.  There are some shelters for the early arrivers, but if it is busy, you'll want to bring an umbrella or rent one -- the sand may be cool but the sun is HOT! Also had issues on one visit with seaweed near the beach that made it less fun to swim.When you arrive, make sure to get a menu and the notice of the beach restaurant, and they will be happy to bring you food and drinks all day long! And don't miss the individual food vendors -- the mango and watermelon are great in the heat, and I loved the fried cheese.

reviews.title: BAD WEATHER
reviews.text: Unfortunately, the beach was full of seaweeds. Red and Yellow flags for 5 days. It was impossible to even touch the water. Something unusual in Cancun for this month of August. Beaches usually are crystal clear.

reviews.title: Best View in Cancun
reviews.text: Wide open public beach, gorgeous views, turquoise color water and white sand. Limited parking, worth the efford!

reviews.title: Caution
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach, but a little bit dangerous if you aren’t a great swimmer. Lots of algea cloud the clean water.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Given the massive amounts of Sargassum we have been having in Quintana Roo, we have been visiting local beaches with hopefully less seaweed. To our delight, Playa Delfines is such a beach. Did it have some the day we visited, yes but the water was awesome. The current and waves seemed to carry it quickly away so it didn’t impact our level of enjoyment. Of course the view from the road was specular.

reviews.title: A nice beach for a "Kodak moments capture"
reviews.text: Playa delfines is a nice beach where you can click very nice photos. I would refer you to visit this beach in start evening time (when you have more light) as you can have very nice shots here. This beach also has a CANCUN capitals for enhanced photo experience. This beach also has some attractive bench and chair options. Also you can find a lot of small SPA and message people (in tents) which can make you relax. For me it was relaxing and I spent a very good time here. Hope you also enjoy!!!

Lovely beach. Although lucky lucky men can be quite pushy but that’s expected anywhere you go abroad.  Lots of sun beds, well there was for the hotel I was staying at anyway, often waiters will come onto the beach for you if you look after them. Sand is lovely and generally clean with barely any litter. Activities to do on the beach, parasailing, jet skis etc.ConsCan often be a lot of seaweed at the start of the sea which can be annoying

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We visited Playa Delfines when my wife and I had stopped to get photo with Cancún sign, we went early in morning around 9:30/10am and with only a few people in front of us we avoided long queues, in mid afternoon can get very busy. The beach itself is stunning, the water is turquoise blue, we found it great especially for photos. Def recommend 👍

reviews.title: Beautiful water
reviews.text: Stopped by this beach on our way out of Cancun. It took forever to get there due to some road work going on but it was worth seeing the gorgeous emerald green water. This water and sand at this beach is magical and almost unbelievable that it’s real.  We didn’t swim but I’d recommend going early as there is hardly any shade.

reviews.title: Great Public Beach
reviews.text: Great, well maintained public beach. We stayed at a nearby resort and visited after a trip to the El Rey ruins. Lots of iguanas to feed, locals selling fruits and drinks, and of course the famous Cancun sign. We didn't take a photo with the sign because the sun was hot and the line was very long, but we enjoyed the beach just the same! We took some nice photos by the water, and also got to watch pelicans dive for fish. I would definitely go back to the beach if I am ever in Cancun again!

reviews.title: Nice beach, good prices.
reviews.text: The beach is nice, there are “palapas” available but you have to get there early to get one, otherwise you can rent an umbrella, two chairs and a table for $200 pesos. Lately there is a seaweed problem so sadly it dampens the experience but the sand is still amazing and we took a nap feeling the amazing breeze and being lulled by the sound of the ocean.There’s people there that offer food, refreshments and they work hard to keep the beach clean.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach for walking, swimming, sand castles
reviews.text: The most popular beach in Cancún is within walking distance of many beach hotels.  It’s popular with tourists and locals alike.

reviews.title: Beautiful sight
reviews.text: We stopped to see the beautiful beach and got an adventure that we hope no one else has to experience!  The view was something else! The beach has some rocky areas and the waves were rougher than average ocean.  We dropped our bags under an unbrella and went to take pictures. We made the mistake of leaving our stuff unattended! It only took a minute! Use precautions and keep our stuff with you!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The colors at the site are unique, services like restrooms anda showers are available. Buses and parking area. One of the iconic beaches in Cancún and is very clean.

reviews.title: the best public beach
reviews.text: one of the must amazing public Beach's of cancun ... you dont need any tour or turistic guide .. just take a bus and say that you go playa delfines they gonna stop there !  the best our is between 6 - 9  early morning!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Water & Beach
reviews.text: We had family photos taken here by Jorge Rodriguez Photography.  Besides the beautiful water & beach, there is a large, brightly colored "CANCUN" sign at the top that makes a wonderful backdrop!

reviews.title: good in  time
reviews.text: very quick and very economical in a way also their are everywhere to find nd easy to get dnt need to rent no cab

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful and clean, but it is difficult to climb back up to where the bathrooms are or where you parked the car

reviews.title: Cancun sign
reviews.text: Nice beach and Cancun sign... you need to queue to take a picture :) the beach was nice but i believe there are better beaches with offers as for this one you should bring your own umbrella and food

reviews.title: I did not find it best for swim but yeah great beach with thatched umbrellas.
reviews.text: I have read on the blog, the further south you go, more turquoise water you 'll see. It’s true. You get here by any R1 bus, the Cancun sign will welcome you, but you have to be in the line sometimes.Note:  you can also see Cancun sign at Playa Langosta beach and it has the better background like a palm tree in the back.Coming to Beach, it has a wide area with the thatched umbrella. I would recommend coming early to get one of these if you 'll come after 11-12 in the noon, you won’t find even space to sit there, it is that crowded.Delfines beach and beach south to this are not recommended for swimming as water can be harsh, aggressive some time but it’s not that bad even if you compare to USA East coast beaches. Beautiful turquoise warm water, soft sand, and sun make it amazing. A bathroom is available here unlike other beaches.Cancun’s north beaches are more known for swimming.

reviews.title: great fun
reviews.text: I enjoyed the Playa Delfines ont the beach.  It was full of activity and great to get some shade and keep my drinks out of the sun.

reviews.title: Nice Beach, it has really gotten a bit too Touristy
reviews.text: Still just as beautiful as ever.  Great fresh fruit and coconut being sold for very cheap.  A bit of hassling at the beach trying to get you to go here or there (Vendors).  Overall a good experience.  It's ridiculous the line to take a picture with the Cancun sign!  The buses will pick you up right there which is handy, although we waited 15 minutes before the bus left waiting for more passengers.

reviews.title: One of the best public beaches in Zona Hotelera
reviews.text: Huge waves because it's not covered by Isla Mujeres but less seaweeds compared to 1-9 km. Rather wide, enough people to not feel abandoned and not crowded at the same time.

reviews.title: Playa Delfines
reviews.text: Delfines Beach (Kilometer 17.7) Getting There By Bus: Blue Line Stop #20, Green Line Stop #17 This one is hard to miss.  Just look for the Cancun sign and the long line of people waiting to get that iconic selfie.  This beach is also called “El Mirador,” the lookout point.  There is a large wooden deck to the right of the Cancun sign where you can grab a great photo of the beach.  There are public bathrooms, public parking, free palapas, and lots of beach area to spread out if beach games are your style.  In case you want to check out a Mayan Ruin, El Rey is located just across the street.-CancunGuy

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: I recently visited this beach and it was beautiful the beach was very clean the sand was nice and white.No seaweed at least not when i went.They have vendors around the area that sell soda and water and little snacks and they also have a Cancun post where you can take photos with your own camera very nice place to visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Its beautiful but it has no structure for staying. There is a long line to take in the lettters with the name Cancun.

reviews.title: Not the best Cancun beach to swim but the official Cancun landmak
reviews.text: Although Playa Delfines is not the best Cancun beach to swim (the ocean in this area has restless waters)  this is the official Cancun landmak, that colourful Cancun signal. Be prepared to stay in line to have a picture :-)At noon the ocean will reach its most beautiful color, a magnificent blue, you want be disappointed.As the most famous public beach in Cancun you will find some infrastructure at the place, like showers, restrooms and even parking.Enjoy it.

reviews.title: perfect beach
reviews.text: we went on a Sunday and it wasn't too crowded. I would recommend brining snacks and drinks. The water was perfect.

reviews.title: Best public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: I've been to other cities in Mexico and their public beaches are not as good as the one here in Cancun. It's easy to get here with bus, and there's this beautiful Cancun sign which you can take picture of/with (if you wait in line cause many people want to take pictures there). Also the beach is clean!

reviews.title: Famous Cancun sign
reviews.text: This is a beautiful public white sandy beach on Boulevard Kukulkan. There are thatched umbrellas. This is a great place to have your picture taken with the famous Cancun sign. There is a line up of tourists to have their pictures taken during the day.  We asked our taxi driver to stop there on our way to our hotel to have our picture taken. It was 6 am. and there was no line up at that time.

reviews.title: Come and take a picture on the CANCUN sign
reviews.text: In playa delfines you can find the famous "CANCUN" big letters sign. Expect some waiting in line, as this is an obligated place for a picture with friends and family.If you decide to stay and enjoy the sun, make sure you stop by OXXO or Chedraui before, buy a foam cooler, a bag of ice and pack it with what you like for a time in the sun (soda, juice, water, etc), also some snacks. Many people offer food and beverages at the beach, but is usually overpriced and service is poor (specially if they detect you are not mexican).If you are a photography afficionado, from 7-9 AM or after 530 PM this becomes a great spot for pictures at the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Beautiful and calm public beach in the hotel area! The CANCUN sign is just right there and it's a must visit for tourists! Get ready for long lines of travelers taking pictures there, but the beach itself is fantastic!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Great beach right on the Atlantic/ Gulf of Mexico, warm waters. Great views, no large waves. Will return again

reviews.title: We Will Be BACK
reviews.text: Best scuba diving trip this year.  The beach is amazing for those who stayed behind. The atmosphere is exactly what you are looking for in a Caribbean get away.

reviews.title: Worlds best kept secret
reviews.text: This is a must visit spot if you’re in Cancun. Take the bus rather than the expensive taxis... the bus was only $12 (pesos). From the street, there’s not much to see but once you walk closer to the sidewalk and see that white sand, torquise water, and sun kissed bodies... your breath will be taken away. This side of the beach is actually pretty calm and was far less crowded than the spots closer to the shopping areas. The legendary CANCUN sign is at this beach as well. No matter the time of the day, expect to see a line for pictures in front of the sign. Don’t fret, just get in line and patiently wait for your turn, it’s worth it. I say this is the worlds best kept secret because most of the tourists skip this beach because there’s nothing around in this part of the strip... it’s perfect for your first or last day in Cancun just to spend the day taking in the beautiful scene.

reviews.title: Best beach in Cancun
reviews.text: This is one of my favourite beaches in Mexico. It’s picturesque, beautiful, no photoshop needed :) and it’s not too crowded either, so you can have your own space. There were also waves, that we loved. Many places have rocks to break huge waves (because of accidents) but here you could swim in the sea, it’s not that dangerous. Absolutely loved it and would recommend it.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: The beach is located on the southern end of the hotel zone. White sand, gentle wave,  great place to relax. You can take R-2 or R-1 bus to get here. I would not suggest walking.  It will take you a long time. Please know that the one side of the beach is the ocean and the other side are the back of resorts and hotels. If you were to walk along the beach , you may find yourself getting 'stuck' (no exit to main road) since the resorts often have guards to make sure no one enter the resort ( even just to cross lobby).

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach.
reviews.text: This was one of our favorite beaches to play in waves with our 9 year old granddaughter.  More waves than some beaches but not too big of waves.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Loved this beach. It was really beautiful and clean...volleyball net and nice comfy chairs to lay out in.

reviews.title: Picturesque
reviews.text: Beautiful white sandy beach free to the public has public bathrooms and the iconic Cancun colorful sign to take a family photo in front

reviews.title: Best beach view in Cancun
reviews.text: When you arrive to Cancun's airport, please say your cab driver to stop at Delfines beach (Km. 19.5 of Boulevard Kukulcan) on your way to Cancun's Zona Hotelera (Hotel Zone).  If you are going to Riviera Maya, the detour is not worth it.  At Playa Delfines there is a wooden balcony beside Boulevard Kukulcan.  from here you can have the most magnificent view of the Caribbean.

reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: Cancun sign was awesome thing to see. Beach is nice and clean with torquiose water. Highly recommended for everyoneIt gets busier at daytime with long lineups at cancun sign so we went early morning and there was only few people for photography.

reviews.title: The best views in Cancun
reviews.text: If you want to experience the majesty of the Caribbean, you have to visit Delfines, you will have the best possible views in the Cancun area. Beach is clean most of the time and have enough space for your tent and beach chairs. Sea is not as calm as it may be farther south (Tulum), but for sure your family will enjoy their time dancing with the waves and having a sunbath.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: This beach would be spectacular with a lot of maintenance. The playground is beat down and grim. The beach had trash and sea weed washed up (There may have been a crew cleaning up one day) but it was kinda ghetto.

reviews.title: Great beach with not that many people
reviews.text: The great thing about this beach is the free hut. You can lay out there with a towel and won't have anyone harassing you for money because you are using the hut. Restrooms were also clean, but bring your own toilet paper!!

reviews.title: Amazing beach and awesome views
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in Cancun. Could see all the locals hang out here since it is a public beach. Lots of places to lounge and play. Lovely water. Very enjoyable.

reviews.title: Beautiful turquoise beach!
reviews.text: The water was soooo pretty in turquoise color. The waves were also strong enough, made it so fun to play around. I didn't see any food stalls around, but it was fine. And on top of that,it's reachable by the public bus!

reviews.title: The amazing blue beach
reviews.text: Is one of the best and beatiful publicado beach un Cancún, the diferents pantones of blue makes you feeling in a dream

reviews.title: peacefull
reviews.text: a beautiful and peacefull beach, very clean, very friendly people all around me. I will totally go again

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: they say its in the top 10 beaches of the world but we say the top 3 for sure ... if you like waves and body surfing !!

reviews.title: Location of the Cancun sign!
reviews.text: Big beautiful beach! A bit farther down the hotel zone but it has the Cancun sign and a big beach. There was quite a bit of seaweed when we were there but I was more interested in the sunbathing. Quite a few people but didn't feel too busy. We waited in line for the Cancun sign pictures but it moved pretty fast. Lots of people selling snacks and drinks so you don't have to pack anything. Almost all the umbrellas were taken but were went there a bit later in the day so if you get there early you would have more luck. Flags showing where to swim and lifeguards were there to make it feel safe. Definitely a very nice beach.

reviews.title: Nice Public Beach
reviews.text: We were driving around and stopped here. Nice expansive beach but with the same problem as most beaches here, seaweed. It was interesting to watch this special truck sucking up seaweed and very hard working men forking it around another truck for transport. The beach has a cute sign on the boardwalk, but it is all pretty understated. Various bars and places that you can walk to but nothing on the beach. There are some little umbrella type structures but I would recommend bring own umbrella, towels, drinks etc, if planning a day at the beach.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: This beach is right in the middle of the hotel zone, right off the main highway,  with a small parking lot right across the street. Nice wide sandy beach with many Palapas bit no lounge chairs. In the middle of the day, when the sun is out,  the water just glows tourqoise.

reviews.title: Playa Delfines visit
reviews.text: This is the beach where the big CANCUN sign is. Go early to avoid big line up to take pictures with the sign. It is a public beach. They have police tower in the street level of the beach. Nice to visit  just to check it out, but why go there if your hotel is a beach front. Public place means lots of unwanted people hanging around, targeting tourist.  Just saying.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Very nice beach, quiet and family. We take many pictures and people are very friendly with tourists, I would have liked the palapas were closer to the sea because we were far away and the sun was terrible.

reviews.title: More beautiful than I imagined!
reviews.text: When we got off the bus and crossed the road to this beach, it literally took my breath away.  The water was impossibly blue and the sand was a beautiful beige.  We headed to the bar area where I ordered a very inexpensive cocktail.  It was huge and delicious!  After chatting with fellow patrons, we headed to some beach lounge chairs to enjoy the view, sun, and music playing at the bar.    These chairs were plentiful and free.  People came by offering to sell us more drinks or an umbrella, but we never felt harrassed.  The big waves were fun to play in, but too strong to swim in safely.  The only downfall was that there was no restroom close to this part of the beach.  Otherwise, it was a perfect place to spend an afternoon!

reviews.title: Great basic beach
reviews.text: The sand bar is very shallow and healthy. There are places to set up near the beach. Really enjoyed my time there even if it made my nose profusely bleed from the mix of climate change and salt water. The beach had quite a few federal officers with machine guns.

reviews.title: the free locals beach
reviews.text: easy to get to, we walked their from our hotel.. very pretty beach, where the locals go.. also behind this beach is the huge cancun sign, if you want a photo spot, although we did not bother as a queue there all the time....also easy to get to as the local buses stop right outside, then approx half a mile away there is the el rey ruins that you could see at the same time...

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: We enjoyed the clear water that this beach has, all clean on the sand and the surfing ppl make it eveb better. It was a trully nice experience.

reviews.title: What's the fuss?
reviews.text: This beach is wide with lots of sand but not in my top 10 at all.  The surf us commonly too rough to swim except for a roped off area with lifeguard.  Slope of beach is steep near water so not good for romantic walks.  There are much better beaches km6-9, behind the hard rock or up near the isla ferry docks.  Playa del Carmen is as good as Cancun and the beach 1000ft south of Telum tops them all !!

reviews.title: Great place, clean beach
reviews.text: Went mid February and not a lot of people come to this place hence we have a lot of space to enjoy. The place is so accessible to public transport and has parking for private transport.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Very safe, convient to get to by bus. A must see. Will come again, tomorrow! Mostly Spanish speaking people.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful water - - navy blue and aqua colouring. Sand is white, but not smooth. One of the best beaches in Cancun area - - bring your own sun umbrella if possible. Vendors selling fruit in beach area and also trying to sell use of huts, but a sign did say they are free.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is such a beautiful beach. I LOVED that they had chairs, drink service,bath room and showers.

reviews.title: Good for quick photoshoots
reviews.text: We had a photoshoot in playa delfines and it was decent .. not great but it had different views for diff kind of pictures

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with big waves
reviews.text: It is a quiet place. There are public restrooms (however, bring your own paper), there are some palapas and you can also rent chairs and parasol. Access by local buses is simple and easy.

reviews.title: Best time
reviews.text: Spent four days in Cancun this past week. One day at las perlas beach.very crowded, shallow, so great for kids. Guys selling you drinks or food from their coolers. Very small area. Kind of dirty.Took the R1 bus. K 2.5Also checked out langosta and Tortuga but the best was yet to come.Last day went to playa delfines, k17 same bus and Best beach on that strip. It was not busy on Sunday morning but was later on that day.We brought our own drinks and snacks,(most Mexicans do,) even   coolers and and bought lunch from a guy on the beach.Yes the waves were huge, but watching the surfers, fun, sand is white, clean, blue, blue water, people watching great and we had a papula for shade, lots of life guards. Stayed all day with just enough time to get a taxi to our evening flight home.

reviews.title: A free location to tour and stroll along
reviews.text: beautiful and clean waters. Our bad experience here was someone trying to steal our items thank goodness we saw them and ran after them to get our stuff back (it was one of the locals). theres not security so just keep an eye out

reviews.title: popular public beach
reviews.text: Many people come here to take their photos standing by the large CANCUN sign. The beach is beautiful, sand is fine and white.

reviews.title: beautiful beach palapas, lounge chairs, bar service
reviews.text: A beautiful beach. Sit beneath a palapas or rent a chair and umbrella. Beach bar with swing seats. Relaxing. clean bathrooms.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: It was beautiful . it wasn't crowded. I got to see the Cancun sign ,relax on the beach and drink. Bus stops directly in front

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A great public beach to spend the day! We stayed at a condo in Cancun and found it super easy to get to and from the beach on the public bus. No restaurants or bars close by aside from the small beach bar so bring cash with you (on the pricey side) or bring your own drinks and snacks. The beach is huge with tons of palapas for shade and umbrellas for rent. There are sunloungers available for free if you’re lucky enough to grab one. Just a heads that if you grab a lounger from the guys by the bar, they’ll say it costs 200 pesos each to rent. The beach is clean and well maintained with washrooms (bring a tip or your own toilet paper) and showers. The water is pretty rough so be careful when swimming! Overall an amazing resort quality beach that’s available for everyone!

reviews.title: VISITED FOR THE ICONIC "SIGN"
reviews.text: Came here during the day from our local hotel to get our picture taken next to the CANCUN sign but seeing the queues we went on the beach, nice and clean and has vendors available for food and drink.we returned in the evening for our photo and no queing.

reviews.title: Public beach to catch sunrise and sunset with iconic CANCUN sign!
reviews.text: Playa Delfines-awesome public beach!  Long stretch of beautiful white sandy beach! Change/wash rooms are available but be cautious when you use them as they are not regularly maintained for cleaning.  Finding parking and palapas may be a little challenge but get there early to grab your spot.  Lounge chairs are also available for rent.  If you intend to stay in the beach for a while, bring your own provisions.  You cannot take Cancun with you when you return home but you can take souvenir photos of views of the sunrise and sunset with the iconic CANCUN sign.

reviews.title: Magnificant beach
reviews.text: Blue water, creamy sand, lots of sky and sunshine. Clean safe public beach. Plan to get there by 8 am and stay all day. Worth the day.

reviews.title: Day at beach
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand.  Clean. Public bathrooms and showers. Lounge chair rentals for 200. PesosThe only draw back was no consessions or stores near by. Make sure to bring your own snacks.

reviews.title: The most beautiful public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful public beach in Cancun even with atraction bonus- Cancun sign.The only pity that the bathrooms are in very bad condition and they even dare to take money from people! How sad!

reviews.title: Our favorite beach
reviews.text: With 7 days in Cancun, we were more than happy and tanned afterward. This beach was perfect, as it was clean and nice for walking next to the ocean. A good place to relax and get the skin brown as chocolate.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Large clean beach. Nice to walk long stretch of beautiful soft sand.Easy to get to on bus or parking available.Many restaurants close by on Kukultan blvdEnjoy!

reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: This place is just unique. I will return with time so i can fully enjoy the area. So many restaurants

reviews.title: One bus ride to Playa Delfines
reviews.text: From downtown Cancun to Playa Delfines one R1 or R2 bus will take you to the nice local public beach. It is an outstanding place.

reviews.title: Best public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Been to many of the public beaches while in Cancun and Playa Delfines is definitely the best. Lots of locals. Beautiful turquiose water. There is a giant Cancun sign for photos, but prepare to wait approximately 30 minutes. Come early if you want one of the built in umbrellas. Only downside is that the bathrooms don't have toilet paper and you have to tip someone outside to have some. However, this can be avoided by just packing your own.

reviews.title: Nicest Beach filled with Locals
reviews.text: This is a very well kept beach filled with mostly Mexican locals and Mexican tourists. The bathrooms are clean but you need to pay for toilet paper. The beach is clean with lots of soft sand. There are nice waves to swim and body surf in. Go down the road from the Hotel Zone and experience the authentic Mexican culture at this beautiful beach.

reviews.title: Stunning view from top
reviews.text: Please make sure to go as early as 8 am if you don't want to wait for an hour to take a picture with the Cancun sign. The beach is beautiful, big waves on windy days, but still overall a great experience.

reviews.title: Great beach, awesome water. Must visit for a fun time
reviews.text: Playa delfines is one of the best beaches in and around Cancun. It's generally very buzzing with activity. The beach is awesome with clear blue water. The CANCUN sign at the entrance of the beach attracts a lot of tourists for getting a pic in front of the sign. I would definitely recommend a visit.

reviews.title: My favorite public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: This is our 3 rd time at this beach in 5 years. We love it because it is huge, beautiful, pretty clean and has shade.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with a long lineup to take a picture with the cancun sign.Waves are bigger here since it's the open ocean. Not recommended on very windy day.

reviews.title: Lovely afternoon on Christmas day!
reviews.text: Lovely beach where to spend an afteroon in paradise! the colour of the water is just amazing! the sea is quite rough though not easy to swim

reviews.title: A real Cancun beach
reviews.text: As its a public beach, it is alot less clean and there is alot more sales guys trying to sell you everything from, drinks to fake glasses. The current is alot stronger, and the beach is very packed. Also there always a huge line at the top of tourists waiting to take a picture with the CANCUN sign.

reviews.title: Nice public beach
reviews.text: This is a public beach with lot of action. lot of local visitors to this beach. well maintained. Next to R1 and R2 bus stop

reviews.title: Amazing views but patience is the key to taking pics here
reviews.text: Beautiful turquoise water with white sand as the back ground for the huge, colourful Cancun signboard makes for a perfect family/couple picture.  Getting there by 8 AM is probably a shorter queue but can't guarantee. Taking buses R1/ R2 from hotel zone is the most convenient and economical way to get to Playa Delfines. Just request the driver to tell you when the stop arrives and you are all set to wait in the queue and take beautiful pics if you have patience.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: A seriously gorgeous public beach, very clean, cheap drinks and activities ,and the water is warm and turquoise - it looks like the front cover of every travel brochure ! Beautiful

reviews.title: A Little Taste Of Paradise
reviews.text: Views are absolutely beautiful, cloudy or sunny the Vista is amazing. Shallow waters, white sands and several shades of turquoise sea.A nesting place for turtles, however not during January, not one in sight. Well worth a visit if you're in the area, just for the view.Bobbyscorp x

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We planned this beach for our last day and then the weather was awful but we went anyway!  It was a beautiful beach and would have been wonderful to spend an entire day there.

reviews.title: Had great time
reviews.text: There are two different part in here Free shade and chair and charged one They require ID for the free one  What a beautiful and nice beach which is affordable.It can’t be luxurious resort beach but I could enjoy half day tripFacility is not that great tho

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, but a little rough
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, as expected for Cancun, however it was a little rough for swimmers. I don't know if it was due to the windy weather, but the sea had a lot of waves and the flag was red all the week. There are some easier places were kids can play at the sea, but in general, it was a little dangerous.

reviews.title: Birthday vaca
reviews.text: Did not waste our time visiting. Saw it while driving by several times. Always unbelievable crowded. Our beach area at Live Aqua was so much prettier. Plus there is also a sign down the beach near the Westin hotel that says Cancun and it wasn't crowded. The extra enjoyment was the mayan ruin we could actually climb nestled between the Westin and another hotel.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Nice beach, there is Cancun tourist sign, where you can take photos. But it was very busy and long lines of people.

reviews.title: It’s a good place to visit!!
reviews.text: In my trip to Cancun I have the opportunity to visit this beautiful beach. There are many things to do there, but the most important is to rest and enjoy all you can. I high recommend this place!!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Oh my, this experience was amazing! The trainer Nina was so nice and patient with my 6 yr old daughter who was nervous. I can not say enough positive this about this experience.

reviews.title: Great Beach!!!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach!!! Rent a beach umbrella and a couple of tanning beds so you can spend all day long. Make sure to arrive no too late so you can get a good spot. You can have food taken to your spot.  The beach is great there is a spot were the water is very shallow.

reviews.title: Go for the Picture!
reviews.text: Delfines beach has the beautiful and iconic Cancun sculpture that everyone takes a picture next to. It's so colorful. Try and get there early morning to avoid the crowds who have the same idea. Don't be shy and try different family poses, as you will probably only get one opportunity to pose by this sign. We didn't really try the public beach, as our hotel offered more amenities by their part of the beach, so we only had one chance to take our picture here. I wish I had not been so shy about trying different  angles etc, since our two shots did not turn out great.

reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: Nice beach area . Went there by bus just to see a different part of Cancun to my family. Was fun but best beach area is at Krystal hotel

reviews.title: Blue as the sky
reviews.text: Perfect beach The white sand,the perfect blue Water, is so beautiful!!!!It is a public beach so you only Need ask for transportation Overall a enjoyable place perfect for kids

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach and water are beautiful but there were a lot of waves and an area with rip tides where you were not allowed to swim.  There are life guards on duty which was reassuring.  There are public restrooms but be prepared that you have to pay for toilet paper (or take your own).

reviews.title: amazing place
reviews.text: This is cancun’s most beautiful beach the view is perfect, the color of the sea let you speechless! perfect and romantic landscape We loved CANCUN

reviews.title: Good visit
reviews.text: Family enjoyed the visit to playa delfines. The beach was nice, the weather beautiful, the sand is fine to walk on. Overall an enjoyable day

reviews.title: La mejor playa en Cancún
reviews.text: Localized at Km. 17. Playa Delfines, is the best window to the ocean we have here in Cancún. Wide beach, a lot of spots to swim, and the best "Mirador", where the famous CANCUN sign is located.Playa Delfines, also known as Playa Mirador, is a place that any visitor can't miss.

reviews.title: Nice landmark
reviews.text: Its nice to stop by to take a picture. it is a public beach, not worth to take a tour. Take a public bus, R1 or R2, with 12 pesos a fixed fare to get anywhere in the island easily. the buses come in less than 5 minutes

reviews.title: Cancun
