reviews.text: What a beautiful place, just make sure you barter with the local as the charge premium.......Stay clear away from the seminars in less you want to genuine buy something as they will just eat int your vacations and time. No is not a option when they get you there and they get so cold on you. When they hear the words NO THANK YOU!we stayed at the Dream sands and that was great.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach but be Smart!
reviews.text: Got to the beach using the R1 or R2 local bus from the downtown area. The beach is absolutely beautiful but the red flags are there for a reason. The lifeguards tell you where it is safe to swim and where not to swim. Some adults decided to act smarter than the rest of us and go in where people were clearly told not to go swim. Soon enough they were not able to swim back to shore and needed to be rescued by the life guards. Listen to them because the rip tides and waves are truly strong. Furthermore, if you do decide to purchase beach chairs, ask for clear prices and make sure to ask them for some type of written recipe that you paid. Had some issues that the people who sold us the beach chairs wanted us to pay more after we already made a “deal” for four chairs. If you want the beach chairs make sure to come early because by around 11 am they are all taken up. The beach also does provide free WiFi for a few hours which is convenient. Overall, amazing beach with absolutely crystal clear water and is a lot of fun!

reviews.title: Busy but nice public beach across from the El Rey ruins
reviews.text: We dropped by after visiting the El Rey ruins and found this beach popular and very nice.  A couple of friendly guys were taking photos of the tourists in front of a "Cancun" sign out on the beach and they offered reasonable deals.  There is a bigger "Cancun" sign up by the parking area, with a long line of people taking photos.  The waves were somewhat treacherous, and red flags were out.  Need to be a bit careful.  I would consider this beach well worth spending a couple of hours when one is in the neighborhood.

reviews.title: Perfect public beach
reviews.text: Best combination of white sand, blue water and wind. You can lie in a shadow here. Entrance is for free. Toilet is for couple of pesos

reviews.title: Great public beach
reviews.text: This is a great public beach. If your hotel does not have private beach, go to playa delfines. It is very well maintained with a great view point deck. Also, this beach is famous for its cancun logo structure.

reviews.title: Really nice beach
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is located on the hotel zone. Visited this beach on a very hot day. The Cancun sign is a really good photo opportunity and there was a long line to do this. The water was a gorgeous turquoise colour and the sand was lovely too. Managed to collect some nice shells. It is easy to get to by car, taxi or bus. I got a taxi there and the bus back to resort. The beach was very clean with no litter.

reviews.title: Great Views but needs some TLC
reviews.text: Views are great and Cancun sign located here but the beach area in general is not looked after very well and in disrepair. Lots of wedding photo shoots here daily.

reviews.title: TraveLizard
reviews.text: The best beach on the strip! My last day in Cancun I “beach hopped” by bus (which only costs about $1 US to get on btw) All of the beaches are awesome but this was the best. Tip... rent a chair & have cocktails brought to you by very nice servers.

reviews.title: Best time ever
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful. Starting from the beautiful color to the sand and the sound of the waves. Just looking at the view makes it unbelievable had so much fun playing the with my kids. I think is the best beach out of cancun and the best view as well. It's my favorite.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: In my opinion this is the most famous beach in Cancun. There is everything for a comfortable rest: sun beds, umbrellas, showers, toilets. Nearby there is a bus stop. But it's a long way from the city center. The best place to meet the sunrise.

reviews.title: So beautiful...
reviews.text: This beach is amazingly beautiful and the area very serene. There were a lot of iguanas along the wall and upper part of the sand. They are interesting to watch and can move very quickly. It was not crowded at all on a Friday afternoon and there were many palapas available to sit under for shade. The water was warm and an unbelieable aqua marine turquoise colour, almost surreal. The sand is fine and soft. There were vendors walking along the beach selling cold drinks and fruit but we didn't see anyone selling the crafts like they do on other beahes in the hotel zone. Some food trucks were on the road closer to the Iberostar hotel. No other food is available and no restaurants. So bring a picnic if you plan on staying a while. But, go and visit and relax!!

reviews.title: nice beach
reviews.text: the water here was a bit rough and cold but the cancun signage is here where lots of tourist take photos

reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text: This is a beautiful, clean and peaceful beach. Great for a picnic filled day. We look forward to many happy returns. Weekdays are not crowded at all. Not commercial, no food places on the beach, loud bands~just quiet, but fun and serene.

reviews.title: CANCUN
reviews.text: Great place to take a pictures with the  Cancun sign,  easy access by buss for around one dollar or 20 pesos.

reviews.title: Very busy...
reviews.text: Very busy, especially with the locals. This seemed to be the case on most days.We did see the turtle egg conservation areas here though, which was lovely! Lots of eggs in the sand waiting to hatch & go in the ocean.Carole : )

reviews.title: Relaxing day
reviews.text: Really enjoyable, 50 pesos will get you a lounge chair. 140 pesos for a large pina colada brought to your chair.Toilets are clean and are upkept by leaving a tip as well as some money for toilet paper.

reviews.title: Cancun sign
reviews.text: We love seeing this Cancun sign, but if it is not convenient for you to get here, there is the exact same one at the other end of the hotel zone, km 3.2, where our Catamaran boat tour was leaving from.  And like this one, you may have to stand in line to get a picture, as it got crowded with all the tourists getting ready to head out for the day.  But arriving back in port at the end of the day, no one was heading to the Cancun sign for a picture.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: It is one of the best  beaches to visit, I  spend a relax day, the water color is incredible. There aren’t restaurants but  some people sell water and food.

reviews.title: A real WOW factor
reviews.text: although we only stopped here briefly on our turibus around Cancun, 10 minutes to be precise.  But I'd definitely have loved to have spent some more time here as it looked like the stuff that dreams are made of.

reviews.title: Scenic public beach
reviews.text: Beautiful scenic public beach, very clean, located right in the hotel zone. Beautiful views and photo opportunities

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Spent some time wading the surf and snapping photos. Was impressed by the lack of tourist traffic and general cleanliness.

reviews.title: Beautiful but not for swimming!
reviews.text: Beautiful but not for swimming! There were a few people swimming, but personally I didn’t my children either. It’s a relaxing place to walk and take pictures.

reviews.title: Love the Beaches!
reviews.text: We walk the beaches everyday when we are there! I would love to live closer to this environment year round!

reviews.title: An amazing Ocean veiw
reviews.text: Went here on my trip to can fun in the rental car nice clean beach. Excellent view with Lots of photo opportunities. Lots of vendors so as tourist just be aware that they will approach you.

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: I didn't know that once you go down on the beach area there are some guys renting out beach beds for no more than 200 pesos, drinks are 1.5 litres of beer and not expensive at all. Great place for locals not to spend much.

reviews.title: Cancun Sign
reviews.text: This beach was so so.Pros: Colorful Cancun sign for pics, cheap massages.Cons: Not so clean needed shoes to walk on sand, people hanging outside bathroom waiting for change, long lines for Cancun sign.Ur resort beach most likely will be nicer and cleaner.  I'd Only recommend to go see and take pics by the Cancun sign

reviews.title: Just perfect
reviews.text: Sheer perfection. It's a free beach, which is hard to find in Cancun but incredible. Beware, there are no shops around, so bring everything you need. Oh and try the Kibbis (I think) sold by a gentleman walking around, they are delish.

reviews.title: Hard to swim lots of sea weed
reviews.text: Not a very special beach. From a distance the view is very beautiful but on the beach self nothing special.The only special thing is that you can spot turtles if your lucky.The beach it self is not special lots of sea weed and a big part is for the surrounding hotels so you're not allowed to walk there.

reviews.title: Beach is Life
reviews.text: From our hotel in downtown cancun , we took a bus R1 to go there, bus driver is friendly he accept USD since we don't have Mex peso. Then he drop us in PLAYA DELFINES. It was 10am already, Im surprise a lot of people are on the line waiting to take picture of the famous BIG SIGN cancun..its not bad at all, well organize after we took few post and selfie, we went to the beach , while walking on the way to the beach side, we saw a couple of iguana. At first I'm scared , but later on, i just ignored it, we continue walk, then swim. The beach is very clean, waves are perfect. It was fun, really have fun.

reviews.title: Shells!
reviews.text: On the Atlantic side, so that ocean waves/currents are stronger.  Shells everywhere, but you are asked not to gather.  Still really interesting beach stuff if you like to take pictures.  Plenty of palapas (pictured), but you've got to get there early.  Vendors come to the beach selling coconut water, etc.

reviews.title: Great blue flag beach
reviews.text: So good to see blue flags around the world promoting respectful management of the local environment and plenty of information for visitors

reviews.title: WHAT A PLACE
reviews.text: Very clean, the water just amazing, great place to go with the family, no vendors at all so no one its going to bother you while enjoying your day.

reviews.title: Nice little beach
reviews.text: This is the beach with the famous writing Cancun! Thats really nice to take a photo with it. The beach is also very nice, we didnt find it very crowdy. It's easily accessible by bus.

reviews.title: The famous and colorful Cancun sign is here!
reviews.text: Nice beach, lots of vendors selling this years designers trinkets, just look out for the "Made in China" at the bottom. Got my hair braided with beads here by a little old lady, so sweet. They even have clean (clean in the am) public bathrooms, not bad till late in the afternoon. bring your own cowboy hats paper girls. Food vendors galore, it's like any other beach in the US. Except you get sand the color and texture of baby powder. You won't burn your feet from walking on it! And a warm, clear aqua color sea, so beautiful! You can rent boats, jetski's and anything else you can think of. Personal time with dolphins too. No fee, all beaches in Mexico are free, goverment (or the people of Mexico) owns them. Sorry boys, girls going topless will get arrested. Go get your picture taken with the Cancun sign!

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: We came here on the local bus. The day was cloudy and wavy so no swimming. On a calm sunny day however the ocean is absolutely stunning and a beautiful unreal blue. A long beach for a lovely walk. If wavy the waves and pictures are amazing. Great photos on the beach and by the famous Cancun sign at the top of the beach. A must when in Cancun.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful public beach in the Hotel Zone. No restaurants but plenty of people out selling drinks and food.

reviews.title: Family Vacatiin
reviews.text: Water is beautiful and dolphin ride is amazing. Great and safe place to vacation with family. Will defineately go back.

reviews.title: Went there for the Cancun sign
reviews.text: Went there only for the Cancun sign, but found a beautiful beach. Free (but very limited) parking. Also, a very long queue to take a picture of the Cancun sign

reviews.title: beautiful beach for public use.
reviews.text: love the blue color of the ocean. beach is clean. It may not be an ideal place for swimming due to waves, but it is great for sun bath.

reviews.title: Lovely beach!
reviews.text: Very withe sand and with a nice playground for children. The colorf CANCUN sign  is a few meters further, you must go very early in the morning if you don't want to make 40-60 minute line to get some nice pictures of it.

reviews.title: Enjoyed swimming here
reviews.text: Beautiful shallow blue water, very calm and relaxing when we went, needs some shade like palm trees and a good clean up by the nearby resorts. We really enjoyed the view and swimming here! Famous Cancun mirador gets crowded as everyone wants a picture taken there... would love to go again!

reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: We just visited this beautiful beach and took our picture with the Cancun sign against a wonderful, unforgettable sight to remember during those cold winter nights back at home. There is a long waiting line to take your picture in high season of course, but it is worth the wait, believe it !  We even saw a nice, young newlyweds taking their picture here! We were glad to have visited it and hope to come back someday again here. Have fun!

reviews.title: A very beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Definitely, the view of the Caribbean sea is amazing! This beach was very beautiful, our kid had a lot of fun.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that you have to go and see when in Cancun!The day we went, the waves were a bit choppy, but it didn't faze us, we did swam in it!!!Tje only downside us that tgere is no shops ir restaurants around.  You do get people walking back and forth to ask if you would like a drink, a snack or fruits.They have palapas that you can use free of charge as the sun really hits you!We took the R1 bus which only cost us  about £3 for 2 adults and 2 kids.  It takes about 30 minutes to get to Playa Delfines. They have the Cancun sign if you want to take a picture  but be prepared to queue!

reviews.title: Strong waves
reviews.text: Pretty beach, really nice guy we rented the umbrella/chairs from. But we had to leave early as the waves were REALLY strong!

reviews.title: Beautiful a must see for sure just swing by its worth it!
reviews.text: Gorgeous stunning water. So beautiful it' s one of those beaches you have to go to just to enjoy the view. It's a public beach be warned it's still really safe though. There lots of police officers there it's a safe public beach. We got some awesome panorama shots of this place! also has a small kids park with swings! I enjoyed this beach its a must see.

reviews.title: This neach has amazing blue colors, pictures do no justice.
reviews.text: This is by far one of the best beaches there is, the different blue colors of the water is espectacular, the waves are not strong just right to get in and enjoy, water is not cold like the pacific just right. The 360 view of this beach will excite you, a must go visit place you will not regret!!.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Nice beach but over rated. Police everywhere, got a feeling that it wasn't too safe to be on your own.

reviews.title: Nice calm beach with view of old pirate tourist ships
reviews.text: If you are looking for a beach with minimal waves compared to other places, then this location is perfect. We stayed until sundown and really enjoyed watching the tourist boats. You can walk out quite a bit before it gets deep. Very relaxing for sure.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: My Family went in July 2017 and this beach was simply breath taking - Ive never seen such an inviting area and the colours of the sea are unreal almost. Would come back here for sure and we highly recommend it!

reviews.title: Cancun sign - customary photo
reviews.text: Lovely beach, with beautiful views though a little crowded.We took the cab here from our hotel but rode the bus back as there was one available every 3 minutes. If you wish to get a picture alongside the Cancun sign, be prepared to wait in line for 15-20 min during high season.

reviews.title: Breathtaking beach with full amenities!
reviews.text: It was so nice to go somewhere in Cancun where there wasn't a cover charge, and even the parking attendant told us just to tip whatever we felt!  The prices for the sunbed and pina colada were much cheaper than compared to the rest of Cancun, and it will be my first port-o-call the next time I'm in Cancun!

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: Not sure if you need to be staying in a resort to access. This beach is beautiful. It's turquoise waters are inviting. Even though it was a bit crowded for my taste, it was high season and for that it isn't bad. Not too loud, just enough activities to have a go at jetskiing or parasailing but not so much it's overwhelming. Young kids love it!

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: A stunning beach located in the main hotel district. Relaxing and a decent place for a quick swim during the day.

reviews.title: Clean and safe
reviews.text: This is an open beach in Hotel zone in Cancun which is really very clean and safe. unlike other beaches, there is a cover charge, here you just have to bring your own food and drinks and you can enjoy the beautiful Caribbean sea.

reviews.title: Cancun Sign
reviews.text: Great place for photo and swim. Be prepared to wait in line to take photo but it was worth it! Can't wait to come back.

reviews.title: Nice public beach
reviews.text: A nice public beach, Very clean. Full of tourists. No bar in the zone .Quite .If you are going early in the morning you cand find free fix beach umbrelas.bring your food and drinks with you.Clean water and save areas. There was a police patrol all day long.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Literally a 5 minute walk from our hotel (GR Solaris) and it was absolutely stunning! It is a free beach, so it can get crowded. Get there early to get an umbrella.

reviews.title: An early arrival is highly recommended
reviews.text: We were very fortunate to catch a redeye from Los Angeles to Cancun and we arrive in the early morning hours. We were very lucky to stumble on this beach when it was nearly isolated and enjoy stunning views. Luckily for us nearby was the con coon sign which had a line of two people ahead of us. As we enjoyed the entire trip and we drove up and down the main highway we would notice off at nine on these lines would be for people to take pictures. We got there early and it was definitely worth it I highly recommend the stop.

reviews.title: Very nice public beach
reviews.text: We went to this beach mostly because it's one of the only ones where you don't have to stay at one of the hotels on the hotel zone. Very clean beach and you can go for a lovely swim! There are a few parasols you can use for free but you have to be lucky to get one. Then you can lease two chairs and a parasol from one of the salesmen on the beach, but it cost 250 pesos (!!!!) which was way too much. We suspects it's more expensive for us because we are tourists (and it shows)...

reviews.title: -Loved the Sign-
reviews.text: This beach looked very busy compared to our resort beach.  The good thing was the Cancun sign and getting to see the lizards.

reviews.title: Gorgeous warm water
reviews.text: By far my favorite beach! Luke warm water and white sand. Not overcrowded at all and the water is crystal clear. I cannot wait to come back!

reviews.title: Picture Perfect!
reviews.text: We didn't go to the beach but we did take a picture at the Cancun sign which was cool. We stayed at dream sands which was a bus ride away ($1 or 12 Pesos each way). It was definitely a good time passer and the pics came out great. There was a queue but it did go down quite quickly.

reviews.title: Over crowded... Or depends what aré you looking
reviews.text: To many people, that you cant enjoy the beach, the will charge you for every thing, there is no shade or chairs, beds, unless u birg yours blue turkish sea water

reviews.title: Cancun .
reviews.text: Lovely beach and the famous cancun sign ...but expect  queues for a picture with it ..the beach is full of locals chilling in the sun and surf ..so it gets a bit crowded at times .

reviews.title: Good beach day but very poor beach restaurants
reviews.text: Nice beach with an amazing pastel blue Colour of the sea. The beach restaurants have very poor quality of  food and really over priced. It is better to get your food with you or to plan your lunch somewhere else.Overall it is a very beautiful place to spend the day at the beach.

reviews.title: Playa delfines
reviews.text: Beautiful just like any place in cancun i have been in different beaches in Mexico but cancun is my favorite i wish i can be the every year thank you people of cancun

reviews.title: Nice Public Beach - must visit if have spare time
reviews.text: Nice Public Beach, it has famous sign with i love Cancun, may have to wait for 10 mins as queue a bit long.

reviews.title: Experiencing the local beach
reviews.text: Stop by the local beach to experience something different. Love the ambiance, Mexican are very friendly and very helpful as well.The water was clear, the sand is amazing, it was very calm when we visited it. Love the view, the Cancun sign for souvenir pictures. A most visit place while in Cancun.

reviews.title: Say Cheese!
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised that the beach wasn't overly crowded!  It wss very clean, had a small playground and I saw a few iguanas.  Most important, it is the beach with the colorful Cancun sign!  Great photo-op, but br prepared to wait in line a few minutes.

reviews.title: Beautiful white sandy beach, turquoise waters
reviews.text: Beautiful white sandy beach, turquoise waters, waters forever changing from so calm you can float and see your toes to very rough with a strong undertow.

reviews.title: Nice and clean
reviews.text: Nice turquoise waters and pretty good sand, behind the CANCUN sign, but be careful as the waves are strong, specially if you have kids.

reviews.title: Most beautitful beach
reviews.text: This is the best beach in Cancun, is at the hotel zone and its for free. The color of the sea is amazing.

reviews.title: Great Day
reviews.text: awsome time at playa Delfines, kids has so much fun playing with the sand más swing, love that was close to cancun sign earlier in the morning its no line at all so we have the Pictures with no rush

reviews.title: Great beach but super crowded by locals on weekends
reviews.text: If you go to this beach during weekdays it is calmed and visited by tourists, if you go on weekends, you will have the tourists plus the locals, can get hectic on weekends, still pretty, safe and recommendable kids friendly.

reviews.title: perfect beach for family
reviews.text: Been there for few good hours. The water is beautiful and easy access to the beach. The packing is free, right above and watched. it's huge and not crowded so you can easily find a quiet place. I do recommended if you don't have a car to move around to much.

reviews.title: Photo Op
reviews.text: Great place to stop for a photo with the block CANCUN letters. Patrons form a line a patiently wait there turn. The public beach was nice and clean. The shower/bathroom area is not the best however, smelled of urine and the shower was more of a slow drip. Buses stop here frequently so travel to and from is fairly easy. Keep your eyes open you may see wildlife in the natural habitat.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: Good waves and and overall nice looking beach. Lot of salesmen on the beach but that's to be expected. Beautiful beach though.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL
reviews.text: It is beautifulIf you take kids be extremely vigilant, waves are very harsh.They have life guards on duty.Restrooms are free and so are the showers. Knocked off a star the showers drip the most minimal amount of water, hard to get clean. Great area to catch a bus It is very cleanCANCUN letter sign is there for selfies

reviews.title: CANCUN sign
reviews.text: We visited here strictly to take picture of the CANCUN sign.  There was live music on the beach the day we were there so that was enjoyable.

reviews.title: Colorful Cancun Sign & Beach
reviews.text: Playa delfines is a public beach with restrooms, lifeguard, and a great clean white sand beach. On this site is located the colorful Cancun sign in front of sea. We had to be in line to wait our turn to take pic, but went fast. Also you can see lots of iguanas! They offer limited parking space. Also across the street are located the El Rey Mayan ruins. Our hotel was a walking distance from this site, but can also take the bus (which it cost  around $1 dls pp). Playa delfines is a family activity and great spot for photos.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: My daughter caught sight of this beach as we were headed to our hotel from the airport. We barely stepped into our room and she wanted to headout to the beach.  So glad we did! We spent an amazing day at this beautiful spot playing in the waves and walking in the sand.  A must if you love the a day in the sun!

reviews.title: Waves Blew Me Away!
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is a very large beach that is easily accessible by the bus from the Hotel Zone. The beach is extremely spacious and is also monitored by a life guard. There are locals nearby that will fetch you a drink or a snack should the need arise.This is also the beach with the famous Cancun sign and many people like to take a photo of this. Personally I'm far more attracted to the waves and the sea but that's just me.I was very happy to be able to branch out and travel to this beach solo this trip and am looking forward to exploring more of this beach in the future.

reviews.title: Best snorkelling  in cancun
reviews.text: This beach is where the locals go and you can see why the sea is crystal clear and there are cheap places to eat and drink on the beach you can hire snorkelling kit form the beach or but your own from Wal-Mart as we did !

reviews.title: Good beach
reviews.text: Pretty good beach I liked it just wished there was less seaweed and more activities at the beach like jet skis, parasailing, and such. I mean this is suppose to be the best beach in Cancun. Overall water was great beach was clean.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: You can get here by the public bus or by taxi, also you can get a nice photo op with the Cancun sign.  The water here is beautiful and its a public beach so anyone can access the beach here.  All of the beaches of Cancun are lovely though.

reviews.title: We spent the day here..:)
reviews.text: We asked our tour guide what was the nicest beach in Cancun...he brought us here! the beach and the water was the nicest I've ever seen!

reviews.title: Nicest beach around
reviews.text: It really is the nicest beach around. The water is so blue and it reminds me of hawaii. I would highly recommend coming here to relax

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: This is the point where you take the obliged picture of the logo is the city and you. You can get there by car or by public transport. It's a must visit!

reviews.title: Good photo op
reviews.text: This is a great place to play on the beach and take a great photo for the scrap book next to the CANCUN sign. Just a 10 peso buss ride away. you have this great public beach with nice white sand palm tree unbella shade and park toys for the kids.  the Elrey Ruins and across the roaD.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: The beach is endless and free to accessThere is free palapasBut some people will offer you chair/bed and umbrella for 200 pesos and they will offer drinks as wellThere is few things to eat to try for 20 to 30 pesos ( beach seller) And

reviews.title: Calm clean and fun
reviews.text: weekend might busy, we liked it during the week, a lot of parking, we even liked the vendors that can bring whatever you like or need to your position

reviews.title: Best Beach in Cancun
reviews.text: This beach is the best in Cancun and has a free parking, Cancun sign is there but the line is busy day and night to take a picture for your self there.

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: This beach was the first one we visited in Cancun.  When we got there by bus (very easy from downtown Cancun) we were greeted by a guy named Eric who asked us if we wanted to rent some chairs and if we wanted to buy some refreshing drinks. We said yes of course and planted ourselves there for 4 hours that day concluding with a meal of fresh fish and salad!  The beach was absolutely gorgeous and the colours were stunning.  The waves though were pretty strong and it got deep a little quickly but would definitely visit this beach again.  Every taxi driver we asked recommended this beach!

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Good place, frequented by lots of people, someplace to go when you don't want to be stuck in the hotel.

reviews.title: Best beach ever!
reviews.text: I've been to the Caribbean multiple times as well as Hawaii but nothing has compared to this beach! I'm used to crystal clear water but this beach isn't clear it's turquoise!!! And you can see different types of blues it's just a must if your in cancun or anywhere in Quinta Roo! Must better then playa de carmen

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Honestly I can't compare with another beaches because this was the only one we've visited there.Beach is very nice clean not much crowded, with showers which can use before you go back to Cancun.... Easily accessible by bus I think it's on 24th km of Kukulkan blvd.

reviews.title: Most Beautiful Beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Visited this beach in April of 2017 while I stayed in Maya Riviera. It was the most beautiful swimmable beach. If you are in Cancun you cannot miss this one!

reviews.title: Public paradise
reviews.text: Clean, safe, beautiful blue waters, only cost a dollar to get there by bus from the hotel zone. I walked back to my hotel and it was the most beautiful walk. So worth it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, golden sand and clear sea
reviews.text: If visiting Cancun, this beach is definitely worth a visit. The sand is beautiful to relax on and there are a number of areas for beach football, volleyball etc and hundreds of loungers and umbrellas with no cost attached. Arrive early to get a photograph with the Cancun sign and bring food and drinks with you if you plan to stay for a while.

reviews.title: The best public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: If you are visiting Cancun very fast, it worths stop here to enjoy the wonderful ocean view, also you can get a beach stretcher and a umbrella to fair cost in order to enjoy the white sand and crystalline water. There is a child playground but is out of service. It'd help if it's repaired soon.

reviews.title: Nice Public beach area not far from many Hotels in the zone. Km 19
reviews.text: Great Cancun sign, play area for kids. Elevated view of the Ocean. Popular with locals and tourist. Please help keep this area clean. there are areas of wildlife and flowers among the sand dunes. Has a parking area , or take the bus from your hotel. Great pic area!

reviews.title: Free beach
reviews.text: Free parking places around the beach. You can take cover from the sand under straw umbrellas. Clean and tidy. Bad thing - sellers constantly patrolling the beach for tourists to sell fruits and drinks. Local folk doing some helping work in the region of the beach asking for tips

reviews.title: Okay Beach
reviews.text: Well first it's great compared to any other beach in the world, great color water wide sand and plenty of room. Compared to other Cancun beaches just okay to me. A little too rough to swim without danger here, and I like a smaller beach which Cancun has a plenty. They do have people selling things although at a high price, just was not my vibe for a 1/2 day with the family.

reviews.title: Breathtaking beach
reviews.text: Quite possibly among the top 5 most beautiful beaches I will ever see.   Even when the surf is rough, swimming is enjoyable.  The sand is white and very soft.  I walked a 4.5 mile stretch.  Most of the beach sits along private resorts.  The public part beach was beautiful but crowded.   It's probably not a great place to snorkel.  But the swimming was wonderful.

reviews.title: Nice public beach
reviews.text: We took the bus from our hotel at the hotel zone to get a souvenir photo of the CANCUN signage.  A lot of tourists fall in line to take pictures but it moves fast and most tourists are helpful and would offer to take your group photo.  Breathtaking views! Don't be afraid to take pictures of iguanas if you see any. We only went here to take pictures and not swim so not sure about the facilities.

reviews.title: Public Beach - Has CANCUN sign
reviews.text: Nice beach located between hotels in the hotel zone.  It was located 1 hotel away from the Crown Paradise, where we stayed so we walked over on the beach. The CANCUN sign that everyone wants to take pictures with is located here.  (there was a line of people 25+ waiting to get pictures) There are little beach hut umbrellas that provide some shade.  There are beach bars set up on the one side of the beach, so if you need a drink or want to chill in a chair, you can. There is a small playground for kids, its kind of beat up but its good.  There are bathrooms and changing areas at the top, but you may have to pay to go in. There were a bunch of iguanas in the shrubs near the top, which my son was all about.  The beach was fairly clean, but I would try to walk in flip flops just in case there is glass or something.

reviews.title: Nice sand and shade. Clear water too!
reviews.text: A lovely large beach that has tons of room even when it's busy. The water itself is beautiful, but the waves are often quite intense so it's not the best if you want a leisurely swim. The R2 bus gets you there from downtown Cancun or anywhere in the hotel zone for really cheap. You can easily find a spot of shade under one of the umbrellas and there are bathrooms/showers available.

reviews.title: Very nice water
reviews.text: It´s a big beach with really nice blue water. Recommend for good swimmers as there are strong waves. You can go parasailing; however, there is no food option.There are free huts/umbrellas to provide shade.It´s in the hotel zone; so, bus R1 and R2 run here.

reviews.title: Best public beach
reviews.text: I think it is the best public beach in this area. The water and sand are clean. Easy acess to bathrooms, options to rent beds and usually there is someone who sells water or snacks. Well, and the view...

reviews.title: Cancun sign
reviews.text: This place is always busy with tourists alike trying to get a picture with the Cancun sign and having the background of the white sand torquiest water beach...it's all worth the 1 hour wait!

reviews.title: Fun in the Surf!
reviews.text: We travelled to this beach via ADO bus from our hotel in central Cancun. The beach was perfect - beautiful blue water,  soft, white sand, waves just the right size! Beach had many small palapas within which you could shelter from sun. Also, there were beach chairs to borrow for a small tip. There are no restaurants or food vendors, so bring snacks or a picnic if planning to stay a while.  There are beverage vendors (water, Coke, beer).

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Well worth the $2 bus ride to visit this beautiful beach, and get a picture with the Cancun sign!  (We were a little surprised at how long the line was to take a picture)

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: We went here a few times, nice big beach with miles to walk down past all the hotels, lots of space and they have a roped off turtle nesting area to protect the turtle eggs.

reviews.title: Nice beach that accessible to the public
reviews.text: With the Hotel zone there are very few places to access the beach area.  This seems to be the largest and nicest public access point.  It has a great beach, very large and picturesque.  It has the classic Cancun sign that everyone wants to take their picture in front of.  It did seem to get busy but was never really packed, there was always lots of space on the beach.  Sure if you want to be near the road and access, with a beach umbrella then more people are there but you can walk a ways down and be with less people.  If you walk up the beach, just be warned that you have to return to the access point as the hotels won't let any non-guests exit out to the street unless they are staying there.  It might have just been the one we tried but they didn't let us go thru even though we didn't even look like we were coming from the beach.  There is bus stops right in front and easy to access.

reviews.title: wonderful experience
reviews.text: despite i am not animal lover, the dolphins are so fun. a recommend this experience to have fun and enjoy time. excellent temperature water and our guides were so good.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Great beach and the water is beautiful. Get there early as it can get busy for finding a place close to the entrance to the beach.

reviews.title: This is a gorgeous public beach, amazing sand and blue waters
reviews.text: This is a well maintained clean public beach with good facilities, bathrooms, and showers.  Nice playgrounds for kids too. The beach is crowded with locals on the weekends. There is parking along the street but you might have to hike a ways from your car. It is very easy to just take the bus.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is the Classic Image of Cancun. The water with its different shades of blue are quite seductive, you can also appreciate often rainbows, when weather is auspicious. Be warned: if you are not a good swimmer, better enjoy in the beach, since currents and waves here can be treacherous. Not a place for Little Kids to swim.

reviews.title: Piece of paradise
reviews.text: Visited this area twice over 2 days. Large sandy beach with plenty of space. Lack of nearby shops, so be prepared and take food & drinks. There is a local consortium which will take you to the sun loungers and will offer drinks but be wary as they charge how they feel on the day. No showers to wash the sand off after you have been in the glorious sea! Sand gets everywhere. Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: This was the longest beach I had ever seen, turquoise blue water,  soft clean white sand really inviting... Except for the waves and undertow. My husband an ex lifeguard didn't mind but I really didn't enjoy it as much. Wish I could have come on a less windy day!

reviews.title: Nice beach, Pay to Use Restroom
reviews.text: There are rocks on the beach that belong to the coral reef. Very neat.  The sand is not sand, it's broken seashells, so the sand does not get hot. The sand sticks to your body. I noticed a fire truck and a municipal police vehicle throughout the day. Made me feel safe! The waves are rough, and the flag hangs red. I am not sure if the flags are permanently red. I used the washroom. A man stopped me at the door and told me I had to pay for toilet paper if I wanted to use the washroom. He said he voluntarily mans the bathroom doors. Four squares is what I got for 5 pesos. Yes, he held the toilet hostage. Not cool. Lots of people take photos of the sign. I took it from the playground below. If you are lucky you can see an iguana too!

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach. There's always a long line to take  pictures at the Cancun colorful sign. Good view point to take awesome pictures.

reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: Sand is perfect, you can ask for drinks & food on the beach. Sun beds are only a few, but is fine. Water has the perfect blue color that you've seen in the pictures. Totally need to go here. Also, while coming here, you can take some pictures with "Cancun" letter that can be found on the main street.

reviews.title: The best bar - they make real cocktails !!!
reviews.text: Tried almost all beach bars in the hotel zone, most of them make light alcohol cocktails. Only on the Playa Delfines the bartenders do not spare the alcohol and make the real cocktails. Friendly waiters even run for the food to the other places. Excellent costumer service. Close to the CANCUN sign - where everybody stops for a picture.The beach is very open therefor very windy, the waves get really high, not safe for swimming even in the shallow water, make you stay on the sand and get burns :-(

reviews.title: Km's of beach and blue-green water!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with pilapas, soft white sand and some local wildlife. Difficult to swim due to crashing waves better for the older stronger crowd.

reviews.title: Beautiful open beach with washroom and shower facilities
reviews.text: Huge beautiful public beach. Very well maintained. Location of the CANCUN sign. Heavy security around.  Chairs and umbrellas available. beautiful location to see both the Sunrise and Sunset!

reviews.title: Wide Public Beach
reviews.text: This is a very large, wide, public beach. It has a small parking lot and also a bus stop. Most tourists stop by to take a photo of the cancun sign, but the beach has easy access. All beaches are public in cancun, but hotels can limit the access to the beach from the street. This one is convenient.Also, there are plenty of vendors. They are not too aggressive. You can buy sun block, sun glasses, food, chairs, etc. Full service. The waives can be a little bit rough, but there are lifeguards.Also, watch out for your belongings when you go in the water, there are so many people and it is easy to "lose" your items.

reviews.title: Public beach, mandatory fast stop for a pic
reviews.text: If you go to cancun this beach is mandatory. You have to take the picture with CANCUN letter. Just 5 minutos if you already have a good beach in your hotel, of not this beach is very good option to enjoy the day

reviews.title: Definitely the most beautiful beach in Cancún!
reviews.text: We loved this beach! The water is the most beautiful turquoise I have ever seen. You can rent an umbrella and chairs for 250 pesos for the entire day and they also offer drinks if you want to buy them. It is one of the most popular beaches so it can get busy, but it is absolutely stunning!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: One of my favorites beaches. Do not miss a visit. The surf is strong throughout the year follows the recommendations of the lifeguards, children only on the shores. . The beach has beautiful views, it´s really clean and  very well maintained. The best public area of Cancun, easy to acces, with parking, lifeguards, palapas. showers and restrooms avaliable. Do not forget to bring your food and beverages becuase the vendors´prices are really high. The beach area is very extensive, the sea is not deep and has a swell that allows any recreational activities.

reviews.title: Very beautyful
reviews.text: Take the bus, coasts 10.5 pesos and the bus will take you directly to the beach. Very nice beach and clean beach

reviews.title: Great public beach
reviews.text: Unfortunately the water was too rough to swim the day we were there but that did not take away from the beauty of this beach.

reviews.title: Great beach... good to visit, but don't wait on the sign
reviews.text: This is a great beach with a wonderful view and great for pictures too!  Well worth the visit, but I'd stay away from waiting for an hour or more to take a few snapshots at the sign.  There are plenty of other Cancun signs around and out of the hot blistering sun and that don't have 5,000 people waiting for you to finish.  We enjoyed very much stopping at the beach but opted not to do the photo for which we were so glad since we found signs down near market 28 that were very accomodating for us and even more festive.

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: Yellow sand for miles. Blue sea. Wow. Stunning! You really must come to see it. The sand is great and you get sun all day!

reviews.title: Very clean public beach for the family
reviews.text: We visited the Playa Delfines to get a nice picture w/ Cancun sign by the beach.  It can be easily accessed by taking the R1 bus that operates within the hotel zone.  We queued for about 30 minutes for a photo w/ Cancun sign and there are nice people willing to take your group photos. The beach is very beautiful, clean and I enjoyed the waves too.  There are kids playground, chairs and shade to relax.  Very nice beach scenery.

reviews.title: Great Public Beach at hotel zone!
reviews.text: Just awesome! it's easy to get there by bus, it has free parking (sometimes can get full), Big CANCUN sign, but there is always people lining up for a picture (If you want to skip the line you need to go early in the morning or just go to Playa Langosta, there's barely a line to take a pic with the CANCUN sign)Beach is clean, BLUE water, smooth sand and you can keep walking most of the hotel zone from here. There is even some kind of observation deck at the entrance, where you can see the beach and take beautiful pictures.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Wonderful centrally located beach. Long line to take photo by the iconic Cancun sign, but well worth it!

reviews.title: Love this public beach.
reviews.text: Always make time when I am in Cancun to take the bus to thesouthern end of the Hotel Zone and spend time at this beautifulpublic beach. Has showers and amenities.Walk down to the  Club Med beach ( a very long walk though ), if you want to see  and swim in the best hotel beach in Cancun ( in my humble opinion. )

reviews.title: Public beach
reviews.text: The beach itself was lovely. The public toilets are manned (by a man!) who you have to tip if you want toilet roll. Luckily I already had some with me! 😂

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Glad we came here. Getting to Playa Delfines was easy and straight forward from downtown and hotel zona, just get R1 or R2 bus. The water was soooo blue and it was just picturesque. We got there early morning and it was much quieter if peaceful is what youre looking for. You'll see people trying to sell cocktails - we ordered some for about 140 pesos each thinking that was a bit too much until we saw how big the glasses were (there's a decent amount of alcohol in there all sitting at the bottom of the glass).

reviews.title: Perfect beach
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is one of the widest beaches I have ever been on, it is perfect for a group of people to go and play beach sports because there's a lot of space and it's not that crowded.The sea is quite aggressive here in comparison to the other beaches in Cancun but you can still go in it for sure.Only thing I disliked was all of the people asking you if you wanted a drink or food, I just wanted to relax but kept getting questioned but I guess that they're just doing their job..

reviews.title: Breath taking
reviews.text: This beach has the most amazing blue colored water, the view is incredible. The sand is white, there are umbrellas you can seat under. There is also the CANCUN sign that you can take pictures with the beach behind it. It's amazing

reviews.title: White sand! Good public beach!
reviews.text: Good public beach. The surf can be very rough so watch your kids. A nice photo ops is there with the CANCUN sign.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: I only spent a short time on the beach but this would be a wonderful place to spend the day relaxing under an umbrella. It was not busy when we were there in July and the crystal blue water was mesmerizing. This is definitely a great beach!

reviews.title: Nice Public Beach
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is a public beach. It's actually a nice breakaway from the crowded resort beaches if you need a break and a little more space. It's a $3 taxi ride from most places.

reviews.title: Cancun signpost is here
reviews.text: This is one of the few public beaches in Cancun. Here is the famous Cancun signpost. The beach is located south of Cancun, after the Iberostar. Facilities includes toilet and an observation deck. But the sea is rough here. Tourists come here mainly for photos.

reviews.title: Must see!
reviews.text: We took a bus from our hotel Riu peninsula and it was $3 for all of us. It's about 9 miles from the hotel and very easy to hop on a bus. It was wiry it! Gorgeous beach. Cute tiki umbrellas. Lots of iguanas. There was a nice line for the sign to take pictures of and some people were obnoxious taking a million pics in a million different poses but it's worth it. Overall I'm glad we stopped! Maybe next time we can hang out for a few hours on the beach.

reviews.title: What a beach
reviews.text: The view is amazing. The water is beautiful. And it's free. It's a local hang out with food venders. It's right on the bus route in the southern part of the hotel zone. You will pass it as you come to the hotel zone from the airport

reviews.title: One of my favourite beaches
reviews.text: I've been to many different Caribbean islands, including Bahamas, Jamaica, D.R., etc, and I have to say that this has been my favourite beach to spend the whole day. I've stayed in a resort about 20 minutes by bus away, and found myself returning to this beach twice. After my first stay, I decided to even buy a cooler and some beers for my second visit. Absolutely worth it... It's not very touristy and there's such a nice vibe going on. Can't wait to return someday...

reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.text: The beach is less touristy and you can rent loungers for free. We were served monster sized margaritas too. Unfortunately, we could only go in up to our knees because the riptide was so strong. It was SO stunning though.

reviews.title: Amazing View!!
reviews.text: Great time with the family I love the fact of ceviche is made there also enjoy micheladas sooo good!

reviews.title: Stunning Caribbean sea
reviews.text: Turquoise warm water and clean white sand. One of the best beaches around! Sunbeds are available for free until 3pm in exchange for a proof of ID but must be collected and returned from a hut. Guys walk up and down the beach offering a food and drink service as well as fresh fruit. Reasonably priced.Cancun sign beside the beach is a busy spot for tourists photo opportunities with queues likely all day.

reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.text: Incredible before noon.  After that LOTS of people!!  Average infrastructure, good idea to take with you food and beverage

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Has one of many 'CANCUN' signs for tourists. Get in line, though! Lots of people stop here to get their pictures taken.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: Beautiful place to visit, you have to see it in person, the pictures don't do it justice. You can spend the day there, taking pictures, hanging out with friends and family.

reviews.title: Looks like a great, family beach spot
reviews.text: Our time share resort is a short walk from this public beach. We were very impressed to see the improvements to the beach when walking by there this year. The beach is on the south side of the hotel zone, with good wave action if that's your preference. If you want calmer waters head for the "top of the 7" shape of the hotel zone. There are great photo spots and picnic and playground areas on the top of the sandy hillside between Avenue Kukulkan and the water, including restrooms. A short walk down to the beach reveals a wide beach with palapas and crystal blue Caribbean waters that those in hotels nearby are paying top dollar to enjoy. A great option for enjoying the best of the Caribbean waves and beach if you are not interested in paying  top dollar for your hotel accommodations. Due to its beauty it is crowded on weekends and parking is limited to plan to visit during the week, arriving early on the weekend or taking the convenient public bus system to get there.

reviews.title: Playa Delfines visit
reviews.text: On February 22nd, 2017, I visited the beach of Playa Delfines. The water is beautiful, the sand is so pretty and white, there was no congestion, the beach was very clean, easy access to and from the beach, public transportation readily available, hut type coverings if people desire to be out of the sun, lifeguards and security on duty. Excellent place to visit individually or with family and friends.

reviews.title: An excellent moment to go to a beach and not to be interested in hotels!!
reviews.text: Was a very pleasant momento on the beach seeing locals and tourists in same beach.Awesome beach.The beach has lifeguards!!

reviews.title: The Best Beach in Cancun
reviews.text: The turquoise waves, fine sand and view of the unspoiled Caribbean sea make this the finest beach in Cancun.

reviews.title: Lovely beach, did not see sealife
reviews.text: This beach is pristine, but don't be disappointed if you don't happen to see the dolphins or turtles you hope for. They will not be around with so many people!

reviews.title: Public Beach, Cancun
reviews.text: After accessing other public beaches in Cancun, we finally arrived at Playa Delfines.  Very to go to by public bus, the drivers, even if they don't understand English, will tell you where to exit the bus.  There is shade provided by the Palapas, the sand is very soft and clean, the water beautiful and there are lifeguards!  A nice feature too is that there are public bathrooms on site.  Altogether a great experience!

reviews.title: " Great place for sunrise"
reviews.text: We took a bus from our hotel . Sunrise was amazing and I had never seen before. The ocean was beautiful blue color.

reviews.title: one of the most beautiful beaches ever?
reviews.text: We live way around the corner and up the road, on the ocean...and we usually take visitors over to show them this beach.  Maybe just from the viewpoint, or maybe down for a walk-along.  Might be too wavy for swimming / wading but sure is pretty!It is a photo-op in itself.  It was my screensaver for a long time after my first visit here with my  then new partner years ago, and I especially, have had friends there several times over the past couple of months.

reviews.title: Nice beach but get there early
reviews.text: Beach/water area is clean and very sandy. Get there early if you want to rent a palapa or chairs.  Parking is limited so another reason to get there early.

reviews.title: CLEAN BEACH
reviews.text: the weather was good, it was a clean beach not to many people selling stuff, so it was to kick back and enjoyrestrooms were fairly nice

reviews.title: super torist but still fun
reviews.text: So we wanted to see the colorful Cancun sign they had on the beach area. We took a taxi there and played about for a bit. We didn't have a lot of time but it was strill fun to head down to the beach and walk in the sand and take some fun pictures. If you are looking for a beach to relax at and your hotel doesn't have one then this is the place to be.

reviews.title: in love
reviews.text: Enjoyed the place twice already. And will be back in couple months again!! Love the beach, ocean and atmosphere

reviews.title: holliday
reviews.text: Great place to go with the family, the weather is always great we loved the food and its always clean.  Lots of places and things to do with the entire family.

reviews.title: Idyllic beach.... but being your own supplies
reviews.text: Wonderful clean beach with golden sands and gentle waves.  Away from hectic 'hotel zone' but beware NO restaurants /bars here so bring your own supplies. R1 bus stops right outside. 'Cancun ' colourful beach sign also here... be prepared to queue for shot!!

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach!!
reviews.text: Crystal clear turquoise water with crashing waves.  Relaxing and safe atmosphere where you are not  harassed by locals trying to sell you stuff.  You can enjoy sun bathing, playing in the waves or walking the beach for miles....don't forget to take a memorable photo with the Cancun sign! Don't bother visiting the other public beaches, does not compare!!

reviews.title: A Lovely Public Beach
reviews.text: We stayed at a hotel downtown which did not have a beach, so while driving around town we just stumbled upon Playa Delphines.  There is free parking which is made  easy because there is an attendant who will direct you to a spot.  The beach has some facilities like a place to wash the sand off, toilets, tables, etc.The beach itself is lovely and a great place to enjoy Cancun if you stay in a hotel that does not have beach access.

reviews.title: Wonderful Pubic beach with restrooms and chair rentals
reviews.text: We stayed here for a few hours enjoying the few lots of shade canopies and even a chair rental service. Great views and a short bus ride away from everywhere!

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: This is a nice beach. Easy access to the water and great place to relax and have a nice chilled day. Views are awesome. Easy access from the #27 City bus ($1/20 pesos per person).

reviews.title: A regular beach for locals
reviews.text: It is a regular beach open to locals.  Nothing special out there.  Was full of people early in the morning on 1st January.

reviews.title: Nice and chill
reviews.text: During our stay in Cancun,  we visited Playa Delfines. It was a nice, chill place to relax, get wet, and walk around. Very beautiful and great for pictures!

reviews.title: Ah-mazing!
reviews.text: Beautiful shades of turquoise, aqua, and indigo as far as the eye can see! Extremely clean beach! Lots of pelicans diving for their food! Five stars!

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: We took the bus (great value) from our hotel down to this beach. The beach at our hotel had very calm water, but Play Delfines had a lot of nice waves for body surfing. Besides, it's just a beautiful spot. We just took towels and sat on the beach, but you could rent chairs if you wanted to.

reviews.title: Great Beach!
reviews.text: We stayed on the lagoon side and came here for a beach day. Very easy to get to via the public bus. Beautiful white sand beach with plenty of palapas, bathrooms and vendors selling food and drink( we loved the fresh fruit for 25 pesos). Free beach chairs available from the storeroom below the stairs, just leave an id for each chair you use. Great mix of tourists and locals all having fun!

reviews.title: This is where the Cancun Sign is
reviews.text: Want to take a picture by the Cancun Sign... this is where you find it... you can also hang out on the beach which seems very local and touristy .

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: If you wanna get beautiful pictures this is the perfect place. Here in Cancún is one of the best and favorite beaches  and it is you can have a good time with your friends and family. Recommendations. -Don't forget your sunscreen -the place is not the best one to go swimming- the beach has the blue flag certification (of you wanna carry your drinks don't take the ones in glass. Is not allowed) - it is very popular between tourist and local people so maybe you will stay with a lot of kids and adults- if you are going to swim take care of your sunglasses  (the waves usually are routh)-have a nice time!

reviews.title: Public Beach- Cancun
reviews.text: This is a GREAT public beach, free parking and more gentle waves than other areas.  Snacks available but bring your own picnic and spend the day.  *****

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: Great uncrowded beach, appeared to be more locals than tourists. There are working bathrooms which we apprciated and many thatched umbrellas for respite from the hot sun. All the ingedients are there for a great day at the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful Cancun
reviews.text: we went to this wonderful pubic beach, from our resort Great Parnussus.  We had our pictures taken on the CANCUN sign and a fantastic drone sky selfie done!  AMAZING.

reviews.title: Beautiful and Free
reviews.text: This is a beautiful public beach - make sure to snap a picture at the colorful CANCUN sign!  The sand is clean and the water is gorgeous!

reviews.title: Nice public beach
reviews.text: This is where the CANCUN sign is at on the southern part of the hotel zone. We were there for over an hour and there was a constant line to take pictures. But it's a nice, fairly clean public beach with good access and parking.

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Biggest beach in Hotel zone with strong undercurrent. Nice white sand and good place for walk. Full of mostally mexican crowd.

reviews.title: Very nice beach, although only for experienced swimmers.
reviews.text: Very nice and clean beach, all free. Watch out for some deep holes and huge waves most of the time. Heed the warning flags when necessary. A real gem in the Hotel Zone.

reviews.title: Underwhelming!
reviews.text: The beach itself is typical to all Mexican beaches; white sand, turquoise seas etc. The famous Cancun sign is located here, blocked by a half a kilometre line of tourists waiting to have their photo taken in front of it. I passed this site at different times of the day and it appears the best time to visit to get a clear photo without standing hours in a queue is at first light dawn and nighttime post sunset. There are informative signs regarding the wildlife and protection of the area, however it seems many have ignored the instructions relating to garbage disposal resulting in the lack of wildlife present in this area. Such a shame this site has been ruined by ignorant tourists.

reviews.title: The Sign
reviews.text: Came here for the view and to get our picture with the Cancun sign. You line up and have your picture taken with the sign. Worth a visit. There is limited free parking and there are police keeping us all safe. Be aware of tip collectors to keep an on your parked car for you even though there was enough police around.

reviews.title: Cancun sign
reviews.text: Great place to get a nice family picture of the cancun sign.  Made a quick visit for picture but the beach looked nice and had playground for kids.

reviews.title: Amazing beach, and great fun too
reviews.text: It was clean and had bathrooms and showers, all free. The beach itself is fantastic and beautiful, and the waves although a bit tall and strong, provide great fun to be had while swimming. I loved every second of it.

reviews.title: Sand, views, & crowds
reviews.text: Sweeping views, a sandy, clean beach, and a colorful iconic sign mark this public beach.  On the upside bathrooms are available, but the area can be crowded, especially around the sign.  However, the price is right -- free.

reviews.title: Must take a pic with the Cancun sign!
reviews.text: The beach is really pristine! The Cancun sign is the main attraction here. The tourists are so organized, there is a line to take pictures with the Cancun sign and everyone is patient about all the groups taking their time to pose and click pictures. We went there on a sunday noon, took the R1 bus from our hotel- Omni Cancun, which was a short 5 minute ride. Once we got down, we went to the Cancun sign and waited around 20 minutes for our turn. While we waited, we sat on the benches at the curb side. There was also ample parking and cops keeping a watch at the people.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Love this beach! It's wide enough so that you can do pretty much any activity you want. The only thing about this beach is that there are usually big waves, there's a strong current, which means there's a lot of undertow. I'd recommend perhaps not going alone, just to be safe. There are usually people there, but it's better to be safe than sorry. Of course, avoid going to deep into the ocean. Overall, it's one of my favorite beaches in the city.

reviews.title: Great beach!  And free!
reviews.text: The water is so clear.  It makes for a great experience.  We lucked out with 'red flag' wave action.  It was invigorating and fun!It is accessible from downtown on the R1 and R2 buses.  I did not see any lockers ... so single travelers should think ahead how to secure their belongings.

reviews.title: Wide Beach..
reviews.text: What a great place to get a tan...the beach is wide enough so you're not on top each other like sardines ..and the water is not so bad...all in all a very good public beach with all that you need.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Self explanatory. I went snorkeling  with turtles it was amazing. The water was amazing and my instructor was the best.

reviews.title: Excellent public beach !!!
reviews.text: very nice place and its a must visit place while in cancun. Nice location to take pictures. The waves are high so you have to be carefull in water. There is CANCUN symbol where you will find long queue for taking pictures.

reviews.title: Excellent beach !
reviews.text: The rough tumbling waves make a magnificent sight. Don't worry there are life guards around to warn you not to go any further. Moreover, they always put up flags (red for no swimming and yellow for swimming). The beach is clean and white ! No cheap food available here.

reviews.title: Really Beautiful!
reviews.text: Great beach. Always a breeze. We had plenty of shaded places to sit and read during the day. If you're into just sun, there's plenty of that as well! The flags on the beach indicate whether swimming is advised and our hotel had a lifeguard on watch all the time. Lots of people walking on the beach, enjoying the surf. All ages from kids to grandparents were enjoying the sun and the water. The water is a beautiful blue and we couldn't get enough of the sound of the waves.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach!
reviews.text: I have never seen a beach more beautiful. We were able to find a quiet-almost private area of the beach every day of the week. Local vendors serve huge, strong drinks for  ~$5-7USD each. Public chairs and umbrellas available - never had trouble finding any if you are willing to walk around. TIP: bring your own TP and sanitizer - public washrooms were clean but lacking.

reviews.title: Bring our own TP!
reviews.text: My family and I were staying a short walk from this beach  this past Novemember. We walked down to this portion of the beach one day and disovered a childrens playground, exercise equipment and a small public washroom.  My children , husband and I played around on it all for a bit. When one of my children needed to use the facilities, I took her up to the ladies washroom which was being attended to by a lady. It was clean and smelled clean BUT there was no toilet paper in the stalls. I tried in my broken Spanish to negotiate with the lady that I needed some TP for my child and she indicated $$ was required. It was that day that made me remember to always carry some wet wipes or TP with me whenever I venture away from the hotel. The beach is beautiful and the view is beautiful. There are palapas available, and new ones were being installed the day we were there. Some were even marked as handicapped. The lineups for the CANCUN sign were beyond ridiculous and so we did not go back to take our picture there.I

reviews.title: Nice beach ..early is the best
reviews.text: This is the best beach in Cancún .. if you want to enjoy go early at 8am .. free parking area or whatever public bus bring you here for 1usd ... remember to take with you water beers and something for eat .. don't have shops close !!

reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.text: 100% must see when in Cancun, such a beautiful view and charming atmosphere with white sandy beaches and blue waves 🌊

reviews.title: Best view ever
reviews.text: Lovely view, nice ambiance, nice place to have a Cancun pic to remember the trip.Locals very friendly but needs to improve parking spaces.

reviews.title: Amazing View.
reviews.text: This is one of the few beaches where is locals can visit. The hotels don't let locals have access to the beaches.The view is amazing. The water is a little dangerous to swim in due to currents. This beach is used mostly by locals.

reviews.title: Strong waves
reviews.text: I was there in March and there were danger flags. You couldn't swim and lifeguards were all over whistling to those who were swimming.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Picture perfect beach and sea, great place for walk/sunbath.Nice view of Cancuns hotels in background.It was quite breezy during our stay so sea was bit rough and no one was swimming. Couple of small car parks besides main road if you coming by car. To take picture with Cancun sign and avoid queues will need to come early before 10 am.

reviews.title: Beautiful view
reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous beach! Blue waters, blue skies, white sand & the water is warm it was a little windy but the view was all worth it. I can't get enough of this place, they have people walking around asking if you want to buy alcoholic beverages as well, here you can drink right on the beach.

reviews.title: Best public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Absolutely the best public in Cancun - nice beds and umbrellas that work with "tips" You don't pay a price - you leave your id and when you get back with the beach bed you pay "tips". Sanitary is very clean and you can by big drinks but no food or snack so bring your own.

reviews.title: What a View
reviews.text: Great view from the road of the beach and ocean below. A bit of a walk to get on the beach but worth it. White sand and beautiful water. Be careful in the water, it can get very rough. Great beach to people watch. There is parking by the road but get there early. There are great sunrises here from the road or the beach.

reviews.title: Relaxing View!
reviews.text: If you go to Cancun, you need to visit this. The area have facilities, parking, and security.  Also they had rental chairs.

reviews.title: Beautiful beaches, beautiful place.
reviews.text: Just gorgeous and picturesque beach, not sure about swimming as life guards would not let people beyond certain point.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: Worth visiting , just for the view ! This is where people queue to get their photos taken with the famous cancun sign

reviews.title: Beautiful beach !! Must visit for tourists
reviews.text: This is a very beautiful, perfectly located in between the airport and hotel zone. Parking is available. You may have to walk a bit if you dont get a space at the nearby parking though. This place has a colorful CANCUN board which is pretty neat and a must for all the tourists :)

reviews.title: Serene, with plenty of space
reviews.text: This is a pretty beach with plenty of restrooms. It's also free, but has limited parking. The restrooms close at around dusk fyi. So if you're swimming past dusk and really need to go, a number 1 in the ocean would be your only option.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: I went on a day trip to this beach - really lovely beach and really easy to get a bus to and from down town.

reviews.title: Beautiful and public!
reviews.text: Beautiful public beach with free palapas (umbrellas) and beach chairs!! We were so excited to find a beach where they don't charge a fortune to use the beach chairs and umbrellas- in fact, they are free! Just bring an ID to leave with the chair people and you can use them until 3 pm! Get there early to get a spot under one of the permanent umbrellas and enjoy your day! The beach has lifeguards who are strict about where it is safe to swim (there can be some waves but not bad)- the water is perfect and crystal clear! There aren't any stores around so bring food and there are guys walking up and down the beach selling overpriced drinks. There is a public bathroom and showers. If you aren't staying in a hotel on the beach this is a great beach to spend the day at! And the buses pass by frequently all day long!

reviews.title: Over your selfie or family picture here
reviews.text: Go here to get your picture with the Cancun sign.  I'd recommend doing it at sunset for the best lighting.

reviews.title: Shark
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach however the day we went there was a shark siting which later I was told is very unusual. We weren't allowed in the water after that.

reviews.title: Local beach
reviews.text: Nice getaway from the beach at the resort. You are able to take the $1 bus to this location. Take a beautiful picture with the Cancun sign

reviews.title: Beautiful blue beach
reviews.text: We took a bus from the condo where we were staying (beside Barcelo hotel) to Playa Delfines in the afternoon. The ocean was such a fusion of many beautiful shades of blue. I never saw anything like that before and the best part is that it's a public beach and access is free. As we went later in the afternoon, the beach was very crowded we were unable to find an umbrella. We ended up renting an umbrella, a table and chairs from a group of men serving food and drinks for the rest of the afternoon. We noticed that some stretches of the beach were off limits as the water was deeper there and the currents were strong. It was fun playing in the water where there were a lot of other people as well. The beach had many lifeguards on duty and we saw them rescue quite a few people who got dragged into the ocean by the rip currents in the 3 hours we spent there. I would recommend visitors to follow the warnings and instructions of the life guards at all times while here. I would love to go back to this beach on our next visit to Cancun.

reviews.title: Nice sunrise
reviews.text: The place is awesom,great beach, for the family and kids, bunch of seagulls. i do not know hat else to write.

reviews.title: Best beach in Cancun
reviews.text: finding umbrellas can be a challenge. Always ask for the price before renting. There are people selling drinks on the beach, but they are not as strong as you would expect them to be for the price you pay. The waves can be treacherous at places, but there are a lot of life guards alerting people of such spots.

reviews.title: Beautiful fist stop!
reviews.text: At this beach you will find the famous Cancun word to take the "has to" first picture at Cancun. It is a beautiful public beach, it is child friendly and the ruins "El Rey" are on a walking distance from the beach.

reviews.title: Public Beach
reviews.text: We walked over there from KM 19'5 on a cloudy Day; The Beach looked nice ; there is a Playground for Kids; Restrooms - for Disabilities too- they were closed - but I think you must have a Key ; in the Front are 2 Guys and checking the entree Peoples. They have a little Bar on the Beach - but we didn;t enjoy it - it was starting raining .

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Clear water and sand. Had a lovely time here. Waves can be a bit strong, wouldn't bring kids to swim here.

reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC
reviews.text: Went to Playa Delfines on the bus, travelling on a bus is an experience !!  We told the bus driver where we wanted to go and he told us when we got there, good job as we were enjoying the views and would have missed our stop. We joined the queue to have our photos taken with the CANCUN sign and then went on the beach for a couple of hours before catching the bus back to our hotel.  The beach is gorgeous, very clean with white sand. The sea was quite rough but safe. Definitely recommend a trip here.

reviews.title: Clear water, public beach
reviews.text: Very beautiful public beach in Hotel Zone. No boats to obstruct view of ocean. There were lifeguards on duty at certain points of beach and colored flags to indicate swimming safety. Beach also had shower stations and bathrooms.

reviews.title: Another breathtaking beach in the Yucatan
reviews.text: I would have never known of the Dolphin Beach or Playa del Delfines, had our guide not suggested we stop by on our way out of town.  We got to spend about 45 minutes here and it was perfect.  The sand is pure white, the waves are crashing (a red flag day!) and there was plenty of room to spread out.  I used the time to relax and listen to the sea coming in contact with the shore, then receding again.  We were told that Dolphin Beach is the prettiest one in all of Cancun, and I believe it!  If you are interested, it's just beyond the big, colorful Cancun sign.

reviews.title: Free lounge chairs!
reviews.text: This is the best beach I've been to out of the 4 that I've already been to in Cancun. There are ample straw umbrellas to sit under. They offer free lounge chairs (we tipped the guy who worked there). There are also vendors walking around selling fresh fruit, food, and drinks of all kinds. We had the fresh fruit and later got a taco dinner plate (3 tacos w/ rice, salad and salsa). Everything was delicious. He beach was clean and we were able to lay out in our chairs without anyone bothering us. Plus the famous Cancun sign is located here. There is always a super long line though. So be prepared! Would definitely come back to this beach!!

reviews.title: its a decent beach and CANCUN symbol for photo
reviews.text: its a decent beach and CANCUN symbol for photo. If you are at a hotel without beach, go here. But hotel beaches are kept more clean. SO we just went here to take CANCUN symbol photo. Long queue, so go probably early in morning. we should have just stayed happy with CANCUN symbol in hotel itself. combine with El-Rey trip.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: We stayed at the Riu Cancun, which had very little beach in front of the hotel.  However, for 10.5 pesos, we took the bus a few miles to Playa Delfines.  It is a very wide beach with big waves.  This is a public beach location and so there were many locals enjoying the beach with us.

reviews.title: Great public beach
reviews.text: They have a Cancun sign where you can take awesome pictures here. Some wonderful memories come to mind when I think of this place.

reviews.title: One of the good Public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: One of the best Public beach in Cancun, easily accessible via Public transport or by Taxi, located at the Zona Hotalaria at 18 KM.It Public beach so be cautious, keep a good eye on your belongings, try to get the picture with CANCUN sign there.

reviews.title: Cool and enjoyable
reviews.text: What do I say about this beautiful place,.. When ever I see beach I just sway in cool vibe's direction and you know there every facility is available like sun bathing, dining or lunching and basketball court.. We enjoyed all and sunset can be seen here in a gorgeous way.. Beach lovers must see this also and have great time doing your activities...

reviews.title: Nice locals beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Family and local oriented. Free palapa covers and some seating. Great place to bring a picnic and enjoy the Caribbean water.

reviews.title: Walk by the sea !!
reviews.text: This place has the famous CANCUN colorful sign, where you need to wait in the line to click pictures !! It's free of cost and a nice memory. It's a open public beach.
