Nice to walk around and it's kids friendly too. Enjoyyyyy.. watch out for live Iguana's they are not wild nor harmful. Just there and living... So live and let live !!!

reviews.title: the best view of cancun
reviews.text: this is the best view  of cancun, unless you are staying in a big hotel , its a must to stop here for your pictures, as many tourist cities you can get one picture with the Word cancun behind you and the turqoise colors of cancun waters.

reviews.title: Lovely Public Beach with Parasailing
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach with facilities and easy access to parasailing at either end.   Recommend Skyrider Parasailing close to the Iberostar Hotel

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: Some spots leading to the beach smelled like  urine. The beach itself has lots of little rocks so you can't barefoot it here. It seems more like a local beach. There are far better beaches in Cancun. Not worth the trip that we made to get here.

reviews.title: Simply beautiful
reviews.text: Most incredible and beautiful beach ever seen!  The sand is almost white and the water is a turquoise blue water.  Beautiful for pictures.  Did not go in, did not have my suit on :(. Recommend

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Great beach. I thought it would be calmer but the current was stronger than I thought it would be.I loved the little guys walking around offering beers - margaritas and food. Nice place for a day. A must visit if you are in cancun. I hated how in the hotel area you have no beach access unless u are staying at one of the big hotels it is hard to get to the beach.

reviews.title: Great beach with plenty of things to watch and do
reviews.text: The beach features many restaurants where you can use their loungers and umbrellas for the cost of a drink. Bathrooms are clean and free with a wristband from the restaurant. Many locals with children spending a Sunday afternoon at the beach along with us tourists. Small shops, a convenience store, ATM, close by. Live music played. We watched bungee jumping over the ocean from the pier nearby. Very nice outing.

reviews.title: Public nice Beach
reviews.text: Public beach almost at the end of Cancun's hotel zone. You can find the CANCUN picture sign here if that's what you're after in your traveling. There's a couple of spots you're not allowed to go into the water, but the Lifeguards will let you know in case. There are a few palapas if you don't mind being far from the actual shore. It can get crowded, but the beach is quite long so it shouldn't be a problem.

reviews.title: Cancun city sign
reviews.text: great place for pictures, nice walk from hotel along beach, this beach is not crowded and very large, locals selling excellent fruit cups in afternoon which is very refreshing, even when theres a line to take pictures it goes fast

reviews.title: Unlucky with the weather
reviews.text: I only had one day in Zona Hotelera, and was told this was the best beach to visit. The water was very choppy, with a stronger-than-expected rip, probably due to the recent hurricane south of here. Therefore the total experience was disappointing. However, the white sand beach was nice, and not crowded in November.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Very lovely, clean beach. Only problem it rained both times we were on it! Would love to go again once it's sunny!!

reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: Amazing beach with many locals to interact with. The water was wavy but swim-able. The beach service was great and the litre beer was definitely worth the money. I'd for sure go back!

reviews.title: nice swimming place
reviews.text: Whitw sand and blue blue water.you can swimm and get a sun all day long.Very nice place but a lot of people.

reviews.title: Breathtaking Views!
reviews.text: We stopped at Playas Delfines before making our way to our hotel. Our driver was right, is a must to stop there. The turquoise waters were to die for and the water magnificent. I would definitely recommend this beach to anyone visiting the Cancun area.

reviews.title: Best public access beach in the Hotel Zone
reviews.text: Best public access beach on the Hotel Zone strip. Went there for a quick stop one a sunny afternoon to take pictures against the azul waters of the Caribbean. The colorful  CANCUN letter are a great spot for a picture. Overall nice for a picninc/ evening stroll.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This was a really beautiful beach but with very rough waters. Don't recommend this one if you have kids, we went there and didn't go in the water, it was very dangerous.

reviews.title: Beautiful though popular
reviews.text: Many people come to this beach despite having beaches in front of their own hotel as it is nice.   Free changing rooms, bathroom, palm beach umbrellas.  Many people flock to have their picture taken in front of the Cancun sign which turns into a long slow moving line.  Recommend going early to get this picture to avoid the longer line.  Good beach but I would rather be on the hotel beach with the open bar.  Nothing else special here.  Can be wavy.

reviews.title: MOST AMAZING VIEW
reviews.text: The best view! And Beach! GORGEOUSThe cancun sign is here and it's only 30 pesos to catch the bus here. Take the R1 or R2.  Definitely worth the visit if your staying at a resort that's further down and lacks the best beach.

reviews.title: Ok Beach
reviews.text: This is one of the few locations with access to the beach that doesn't go through a hotel. The beach is nice but nothing that we would recommend a special trip for if you already have a hotel with beach access.

reviews.title: Weekend vacation
reviews.text: Relaxation at its best! Beautiful weather warm water and friendly people makes me want to visit cancún more often.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, but one thing to have in mind
reviews.text: The beach is breathtaking, although the sea is usually pretty wavy!However, have in mind there are no restaurants (only one, as I noticed, and VERY priceeey!), so make sure to bring what you need if you're staying for the whole day.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: This beach is very clean and scenic. The water was cool and refreshing. However, come early if you would like to take a photo in front of that CANCUN sign because people will stand in line taking turns to snap their pictures.

reviews.title: Lovely beach.
reviews.text: I visited this beach as an alternative to the one that was at the hotel and I'm so glad I did.The sand was amazing, the water was nice and warm, if a little too rough to swim in. But I loved the fact that there were free parasols to use on the beach.I spent an enjoyable 4 hours here.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Really beautiful beach, deap blue and azure sea, well worth a visit.Jump on the bus from anywhere in the Hotel Zone, bargain at only $1 pp, and head for Playa Delfines (Dolphin beach). The beach is beautiful, loads of turtle nests and iguana's lying in the sun. Definately worth a visit it is lovely. (Kept clean by the hard working guys picking up litter, bottles and stray coconuts).Walked back along the main road to our hotel (about 2mikes), lots of wildlife spotting on either side. Tip - try to walk on the side so you face oncoming traffic, you will avoid beeps from the busses and taxis.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Amazing azure waters and a white sand beach. The waves can be big and rough for swimming, but the view is astounding. Conveniently located along the main bus route in the Zona Hotelera and near the El Rey archeological site and Museo Maya, it is easily accessible and definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: delightful beach
reviews.text: happened upon this beach it was very nice spacious good waves changing rooms just a delightful day.i would recommend it to one and all

reviews.title: beautiful beach!!
reviews.text: Great beach for all , beautiful place for pictures , walk with your umbrella for the heat.Just hope on the bus and let it take you there.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great relaxation and snorkeling. Highly recommended and nice beach. Can't wait to visit again and enjoy

reviews.title: Well kept beach.
reviews.text: This beach is well kept. If you have a rental, heads up, parking is very limited. It is best if you take the bus to this place. There is a bus stop right in front. Also, this has a famous land mark. There is a large sign that says "Cancun". People line up to take their photo with this sign. Again, get their early. The lines can get fairly long. We saw a family having their photo taken with their nationality flag.

reviews.title: Great beach, big waves..
reviews.text: Beach is amazing. Sun is shining, sand is white Some surfers around. People are chilling there. Nobody disturbs you. When i was there waves are big and there was red flad means forbidden to swim cuz dangerous. Unfortuanete.

reviews.title: Beach time!
reviews.text: This is the common beach which is good to interact with locals or with the mexican tourism, only but is they don't have stores near by.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Nice free beach, with great sand. It is the most popular beach in Cancun. The sunsets are beautiful. Many stores and restaurants along it

reviews.title: Most beautiful, clear, clean, FREE public beach I've seen
reviews.text: This is a 15-minute, 12 peso bus ride from downtown Cancun. In stark contrast to the "upscale" tourist-trap hotels along the Hotel Strip, this is an oasis of simple beauty and enjoyment.Pack a cooler; there are no bars and restaurants on this pristine public beach, but there ARE police officers present for your security, washrooms and fresh water rinse-off stations, and perhaps a mile of unending white sand and crystal clear, swimming-safe water.It is very well-maintained by the state, and one of the highlights of Cancun.

reviews.title: Very nice walk
reviews.text: Nice walking area.Nice planted, well paved walkways. You could actually walk quite a way on Kukulkan. There are also a number of views of the beach and many stores and eateries

reviews.title: Great spot even on a rainy day
reviews.text: Must spot is staying anywhere near the hotel area in Cancun, lots of restaurants and interest spots for tourists in close proximity, great public transport

reviews.title: this view..
reviews.text: I have never seen something what I saw on this beach.. Incredible view and this water, so hot. I'm in love and this is my number 1 of the views in the world.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL PUBLIC BEACH WITH NO HOTEL!
reviews.text: Love this beach! They have added palapas for shade. Nobody selling you stuff for the most part. Guy comes around offering drinks, or fresh fruit. Peaceful, not so many tourists because it is at the end of the Hotel Zone.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Had a nice walk along the beach.  Windy day, lots of room. Bathrooms were alright. Rusty gym equipment available.

reviews.title: Beautiful picture location
reviews.text: Its always nice to come here and take picture with sign and they have bathrooms. Its a perfect meet up location for this staying in different locations. The water is just as beautiful as the resorts a bit down. Just a bit  more seaweed.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviews.text: Picturesque beach with white, soft sand and turquoise waters! We had a beautiful day here, sunbathing and swimming in the sea! People are walking around selling drinks and some parasols are available, although not many! Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: best beach in Cancun
reviews.text: This is the best beach in Cancun by far.  Its right on the bus route. Its very clean well maintained.  You gotta visit there!

reviews.title: What a gem!
reviews.text: I live this beach it does have everything to offer, clear, clean turquoise water, clean white sand beach and beautiful weather complements this all every day! You must visit this beach if you are in cancun! I am still dreaming of going back there one day!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a very very nice beach specially if you like pictures... it has the tradicional Cancun sign so it is really nice to take a picture for your memories!!!

reviews.title: Best beach in Cancún
reviews.text: There are no many options without access restrictions from big Hotels so this is, in my opinion, the best and biggest free beach in Cancún. With white sand and clear turquoise water. There is also local vendors were you can get a nice Margarita.

reviews.title: I live in Clearwater FL and this beach beats Clearwater beach.
reviews.text: This is a "pubic" beach where you can get an umbrella to sit under at no charge.  If you just leave your ID (eg. driver's license) with the attendants there is free use of lounge chairs they provide.  Take a small cooler with you and spend the day.  I rode the R1 bus from my downtown Centro Cancun hotel and it dropped me off in "Nirvana".

reviews.title: What a beach... What a view
reviews.text: For sure,  the best beach in Cancun. And the view is stunning... So beautiful. Great photo opportunities.  Don't miss this if in Cancun.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Awesome "CANCUN" sign there to take pictures with the backdrop of the beach. Gets crowded in the evening, especially on the weekend.

reviews.title: Beautiful Calmer Beach on Hotel Zone
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach, that beach is way more calmer than most of the beaches in the main hotel zone,  while still being located in the vicinity and you being able to take the public transit to get there.   It's a public beach but it so much more awesome bc the waves are so much calmer that it almost appears like you were are in a different area of Cancun completely.   I would definitely recommend it after visiting Island of Mujeres if you have time as a chill day in between a mall day.... :)

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: Wanted to see what all the hype was about so took the local bus down. The beach is stunning and the sand lovely and soft. The beach is rough as it faces the open waters of the Carribean Sea. I didnt allow the family to swim in it however it would be great fun for older children who won't get bowled over. It is worth a visit as there are multiple photo opportunities as well as the must do tacky tourist picture with the colourful Cancun sign.

reviews.title: Endless looking paradise
reviews.text: Amazing clean water, white beautiful sands. You can enjoy the silence and the beauty sunbathing, reading a book, and such. Just a little thing, the sea is a bit wavy so pay attention if you have kids with you and you might wanna bring some snacks and beverages cause there are not any place you can buy. Only every once in a while, some guys walking around selling water and other beverages.

reviews.title: Great public beach
reviews.text: Great public beach on the Hotel Zone strip in Cancun. Lots of locals on the weekend. It's clean and safe and there are covered spots as well for shade. Change rooms and bus stop all right there.  Great for families and kids as there are life guards available too.

reviews.title: Day out of the Hotel.
reviews.text: Came here with my Partner as it was recommended to us by our Thomson holiday rep. Very big and not very busy. I was asleep and mmy partner was in the sea and noticed two men hanging around where we were sitting and from then they wouldnt leave and they kept looking at us. As we were out of the hotel and not many people were around at the time we didnt feel very safe so didnt stay for very long. The CANCUN sign is there though and good to get a quick picture with :) No dolphins were spotted :(

reviews.title: photo spot
reviews.text: Beautiful site for photo shots. Should have a guide on site for group photos and perhaps sharing historical information.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Spent a whole day here by taking bus from downtown Cancun and loved it. Lots of Palapa's for shade and showers an change rooms. We loved to play in the waves but were a little scared at first. They would throw you around and it was a lot of fun. Had a cooler with beer an sandwiches an water. Great way to spend the day and this beach is great. Watch the kids if you have them as the waves are big. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Loved it. White sand and blue water. Nice place to go and take a few pictures. Take drinks with you since stuff sold around is very expensive.

reviews.title: Got a boat tour to see the coral reef!
reviews.text: The beach was clean and the sand was soft. Got to ride on a boat and snorkel in the 2nd largest coral reef in the world. The staff was very helpful.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is a free public beach with restrooms, a little outdoor gym area, and palapas.  You do have to bring your own chairs.  It's right next to the Iberostar hotel and the best part is the Cancun sign is right in front of it!

reviews.title: Blue flag beach
reviews.text: Very clean beach which is great for tourists and locals alike the multi coloured Cancun sign is a tourist trap and people queue day and night to have their picture taken here,no hassle and friendly faced locals take your own drink food and make the day of it

reviews.title: Beautiful and relaxing
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever been. Cristal clear water, wonderful white sand, good facilities, parking and location.Great for families.

reviews.title: Playa Delfines to explore is worth a short look
reviews.text: Beach is beautiful but Swimming is not allowed most of the time, not sure why but I guess is because they are sharks around. The beach is beautiful and has character. Ist a public beach and accessible to the public. There is a watch Tower with a guy in it. He speaks only spanish so if you only speak english like us just say hi and smile! The waves are quite choppy and there is not much shelter from the blistering heat. So the few thatch umbrellas are mostly occupied or under repair. We just went down there out of curiosity but didn't stay very Long. It is worth a short visit to check it out and take a Picture with the Cancun rainbow sign.We didn't do it because People by the bus load stop by just to take a photo there.

reviews.title: Best beach in Cancun, but don't waste your time
reviews.text: I've been here twice in different months and both times were meh. The beaches south of PdC are much better. This beach us easy to get to on the bus (bus R1) and it has showers- that's great. But the water is sticky and cloudy. The sand is too deep and hard to walk on. The boulders are difficult to navigate on. I didn't have a problem finding a shady umbrella both times, but it would have been nice if there were a drink vendor nearby- it's too crowded to be a relaxing beach, so a little more fun or music or anything would do it well. Just go to Akumal, Xpu Ha, or Tulum instead. You will never waste another day in Cancun once you do.

reviews.title: Awesome public beach with a view
reviews.text: While you're in Cancun, make sure that you visit Playa Delfines beach. Take a photo of the colorful Cancun sign, and enjoy the awesome view and clear blue waters. It's a clean public beach, and you are allowed to bring drinks (beer...etc) with you.TIP : take the public bus, it's only 10 pesos, and they will drop you off right there.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: This beach is amazing. Its the classic "Caribbean" beach. Super blue oceans, nice waves, swimmable water. Everything about this beach is amazing. The sand is perfect. I brought some home too for my collection. If you are in Cancun you need to come here.

reviews.title: Paradise found!
reviews.text: This was our first beach we came to in our 2 week Mexico holiday and we were stoked!!It's a bummer you have to travel so far down the hotel zone to get to it, this is what makes me not like Cancun so much, but once you get there all is forgotten. It's such a nice beach, plenty of space on the sand for chilling out and we managed to get under one of the permanent grass umbrellas which was awesome. We took some food and beers as we were told there are no food places around and this made it a really enjoyable day, as we didn't have to move from our spot - maximum relaxation!!

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: This is where you go to take a picture with Cancun itself. Beer drinking is allowed on the beach. Easy walk from the sidewalk to the water.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: If you are staying on Zona Hotelera, you must go, beautiful beach with nice sand, and the water is just perfect.

reviews.title: Quiet but strong waves
reviews.text: We arrived in the afternoon at it was quiet, it wasn't crowded and you can enjoy a free 'palapa' or the umbrellas (if available). There are facilities close to the main road, here is where the sign CANCUN is located and there is always a line up of people taking pictures... be patient.

reviews.title: Nice Beach!
reviews.text: Great beach. Lots of seaweed. There is a bar and fresh water showers and clean restrooms. Beautiful scenery.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach Location for the Large Cancun Sign!
reviews.text: Be prepared to wait in line if there is a big tour bus stopping by... or just stop off on the bus.  It's just south of the Westin hotel.  Nice rest room facilities for a public beach, but not much public parking.  If you are just stopping for a glamour shot with the Cancun sign, then the parking monitors will watch your vehicle!  Unblocked photo of the beautiful beach from atop the signage area.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: This  public beach has beautiful view and clean white sands and people swimming as well as surfing. You can find brids even bodyguard around too. This is the place where the colorful CANCUN sign is located too.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH! Very clean
reviews.text: Clear water, Very clean, Cancun sign is right at the beach,  but parking is limited. People even go at night to walk on the shore.

reviews.title: Wonderful sunny days...
reviews.text: Great day, good view, you can take pictures with Cancun big letters, this is near from most of hotels.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: This is a great public beach right off the bus route. Beautiful view and clean white sands.  If you to Cancun you MUST STOP HERE.  This is the place where the colorful CACUN  sign is located. You have to have a picture taken here. There are showers and restrooms. And lots of security .

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with beautiful white sand.  Waves keep you from swimming, but perfect location for boogie/knee boarding.  Nice place to just lay back and enjoy the scenery.  Also, Iguana's are abundant in this area.  As soon as you arrive at this beach you realise why it is the most popular beach in Cancun and the best one! The view on the Caribbean is outstanding, not to mention the vast territory of the beach which allows you to enjoy the silence and the sounds of the waves at any time of the day.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach, but the sand is mainly shells. It isn't very soft to walk on. If you want to ake a picture in front of the "Cancun" sign, get there super early because there will be a line.

reviews.title: must visit
reviews.text: My last day before I flight, I went to Playa delfines! Very nice beach! I only though this places exists only in movies, till I visit Cancun!!

reviews.title: Excellent beach for almost everything
reviews.text: The main beach in Cancun, This beach is absolutely beautiful, pristine and clean. The Waves are particularly very strong so one can go must inside the water but everything else - cleaniness, water sports, lifegaurds, tourquise water etc make it lifeline of Cancun. Best part is it is accessible by public although most of the remaining strip has all the resorts attached to it.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: beautiful beach. open to the public. very clean. nice cancun sign for pictures that also lights up at night

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: - The beach was very clean, didn't reallly see any trash- The sand is a bit more coarse than our hotels- They have umbrellas(?) that are first come first serve- The line for the Cancun sign is always long- Wish they had more shower areas- There are people walking around selling refreshments and fruits- The waves are very very constant and big (lol.. for a lack of better description). This was the total opposite of our hotel beach where the water was calm

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, very powerful waves, Cancun sign lights up at night here.
reviews.text: The beach is very clean and very beautiful, the sands are golden and the water is turquoise. There are signs warning about sharks,jellyfish and rays but we went a few times and we saw none. The water is very rough so I would say be very careful its easy to get swept away with such powerful waves. The beach is not suitable for swimming but you can jump along with the waves on swim under them. There are little huts dotted around on the beach so its nice to get some shade from the sun on these and most are usually free. There is a small children's park and an exercise park next to the beach. This beach is where the Cancun sign resides but there is a long queue all most always! the only time I saw it without a queue was 7am in the morning. We decided to go at night and the sign lights up and we waited for 30 minutes for a picture.

reviews.title: The classic beach in Cancun
reviews.text: It is a nice and clean beach in Cancún. The waves are higher than in other areas.  It's fun to play with them. Beach was clean and we did not experienced vendors. We arrived relatively late at 5pm and enjoyed two hours with the kids. Parking can be done up front. There is someone helping you to park out since it is the main Avenue.

reviews.title: The sign "CANCUN"!
reviews.text: You have to take you picture at the "CANCUN" sign get there early so you don't have to stand in line.

reviews.title: 5star Beach
reviews.text: It is considered of the best and propably the best playa in Cancun and it lives up to its name. Enjoy your time there walking on the cool sand, swiming in the clear waters, chatting with the friendly locals who want to help have a Mojito or bring you fruits.

reviews.title: Beautiful and exciting beach
reviews.text: Beautiful and exciting beach, few people in the beach..  it's a great place to relax and play, enjoy in couple, friends or family

reviews.title: Superrrrr!!!!!
reviews.text: I was with my friend Miguel walking just on the side of sea los delfines!!! Blue sea and clean sand. I went inside the sea for few minutes.the water were so hot😀😀😀😀😀!!! Too much woman taked sun in bikini

reviews.title: Nice public beach
reviews.text: I didn't stay long there, but it's a nice beach. Easy to go by public transportation, has free washrooms if you want to get change there. Free parasols availiable. Nice overall experience.

reviews.title: Amazing touristy beach
reviews.text: Cancun definetely has spectacular beaches! The sea is unique... BUT (and a BIG BUT) it is supeeeeer oferrated! Everything is expensive : food, party, hotels... I was staying close to the bus station and it was pretty far from the beach (there are just "super luxurious" hotels by the beach).Delfines is the best public beach that I visited in Cancun (the only one that u have free shadow).

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Incredible water, surprisingly not overcrowded and very clean. You can easily take an R1 or R2 local bus to this destination.

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: Colorful horizons & smooth breeze; be sure to bring sunscreen and sunglasses. This is all you need to spend one of the most peaceful mornings in your life!

reviews.title: Beach day!
reviews.text: Beautiful blue seas and picture perfect. We took a drive to explore Cancun and heard many good things about Playa Delfines, definitely worth a visit. Tip, they have public wash area just make sure you have change to tip the ladies for toilet paper.

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: We only wanted to get a picture in front of the Cancun sign, had to wait in line about 20 minutes. The beach is nice for those who don't have beach access from their hotel. Easy access from the bus.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: The beach is clean, the water is so blue and is a good place for relax, I would go there again......

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful!
reviews.text: We read ahead of time that parking was bad. We were prepared so we took a Taxi from Secrets The Vine and that was so easy! The beach is amazing and well worth the visit even if only for pictures!!

reviews.title: GORGEOUS!
reviews.text: This is a spot worth seeing, even if only for the incredible colors of the water. Parking can be a little tight.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with easy public access
reviews.text: The beach at our hotel was awesome, we loved it. However we decided to take an early morning walk from our hotel and was able to walk to this beach. Loved that its easily accessible by the public so if you are not staying at hotel on the strip that's on the beach, with the bus you can easily come here. Its a gorgeous beach and having the "famous" Cancun sign there is a plus.

reviews.title: Really enjoyable day out
reviews.text: We booked this trip through our Thomson rep and it was brilliant. We were taken by catamaran to swim with dolphins and then feed and touch manatees.  We had food and drink there and then we got on a bigger catamaran to go to Isla Mujeres where we went on zip wires, snorkeling and kayaking we also had a beautiful buffet there and all the drink you needed was included, plus the setting is absolutely beautiful. Would highly recommend this trip

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: Most amazing beach i have ever seen. Water is crystal clear and bright blue! Only thing about this beach was the waves were very strong other than that amazing.

reviews.title: One of the 14  excellent restaurants at moon palace resort
reviews.text: All the restaurants at moon place are excellent. The waiters are excellent. This is near the pool in the sunrise section. We usually go there for lunch. Although we have been there for dinner also. I haven't been there since Nov 2014 but I've been to moon place 14 times. All there restaurants are excellant.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: All day excursion  had a fantastic day amazing experience definitely a must do food was included  again not the best we didn't go to eat x

reviews.title: Easy to reach by public bus
reviews.text: This beach is very nice, but pretty far out - but easy to reach by bus.  Not many opportunities for shade, so bring an umbrella or look for one to rent if sun is an issue.

reviews.title: You need to know how to swim
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful but the waves are aggressive at times, is very important to know how to swim and keep the eye on the little ones .

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: This beach was very nice and it had the famous Cancun sign where many people stopped to take a picture. My 7 year old daughter was not able to enjoy the beach because the waves were too strong and there was a huge dip.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This is a public beach. It was fool of people the water its clear blue. I love the big giant colorful cancun sign.

reviews.title: Great Public Beach
reviews.text: This was a great public beach to go to if you are staying on the lagoon side of Cancun.  It has a great Cancun sign for pictures and is easily accessible by the public bus.

reviews.title: Fantastic view, great Cancun Sign
reviews.text: We also spent half a day at this very nice public beach. Its clean, with lifeguards and a very nice Cancun sign where you can take pictures. I really recommend it.

reviews.title: Excellent public beach
reviews.text: This beach is at the end of the hotel zone.  The No 1 and 2 buses take you there.  There are free sun loungers (until 3pm) but tip the workers.  Lots of food and drinks brought to you on the beach with reasonable prices.  Great waves. Public toilets available.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I was there with my teenage. We had a great time the sand is perfect and the water is just amazing. I love the view. While we were there two weddings took place it was fun to watch.

reviews.title: Public beach
reviews.text: This beach is good to visit and it is public !! You have safe guards, clean beach... Public access. Free use of bathrooms. Free parking

reviews.title: What a beach!
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful colors!   This spot is a great photo op and center of attention place.  Here you will find the "mirador" or Lookout balcony for that perfect picture.  There's also a platform with the letters CANCUN where you can take some pics.  There's also free parking and changing stations.The only reason I don't give it a 5 star rating is because the water is very choppy and the waves present somewhat of a danger especially for children.  So make sure the lifeguard is around and don't venture too far into the water.

reviews.title: Great beach for pics and sunsets
reviews.text: Nice beach to look at and watch the sunset.  Water and sand no different from your hotel beach if you stay on the lower/mid part of the 7.  Great photo opt to get a pic with the famous Cancun sign.  There's usually a line for the sign.  Still makes for a great memory.  And its free!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We walked to this beach from our resort crown paradise to take the pictures with the iconic 'CANCUN' sign. It is a very beautiful beach. We spotted many iguanas too.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely beautiful! Great for a day out in the beach. I would recommend coming early to get a shaded are for free or make sure to bring a beach umbrella. They have several people out selling mixed drinks/food/fresh fruit all for a very reasonable price. Only down side is that the showers were not working when we were ready to leave. They only had a bucket with water lol..

reviews.title: Day at Playa Delfines
reviews.text: Great local beach. Friendly and clean. A "must visit" while in Cancun. Busses run frequently and are inexpensive.

reviews.title: wow what a beautiful beach
reviews.text: I went to this beach from my hotel on the bus, which cost 10.50pesos, this is a beach you have to visit and the Cancun sign for the great pictures. I went in June and the beach wasn't crowded at all.. white soft sand clear blue sea, amazing you have to visit this place at least once while in Mexico :)

reviews.title: Beautiful and not crowded in June
reviews.text: I took the bus from the hotel zone to check this beach out.  Gorgeous beach with lots of spots to relax in the shade. Not crowded at all on a Saturday in June. Entertaining to watch bridal pictures being taken and to people watch in general.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Perfect to spend the day, and tan! The ocean is beautiful and really refreshing, there are palapas for the people to have some shadow. It's beautiful

reviews.title: Nicest beach I've ever been on but beware of rip tides
reviews.text: Lots of lifeguards but if you're not a really strong swimmer stay close to shore in shallow water. Lots of palapas on a week day for shadeGreat sand, a lot of it will leave with you. Beautiful water and very warm. No obtrusive vendors but drink waiters abound. Great spot for a day at the beach.

reviews.title: Strong Surf.
reviews.text: Strongest surf I experienced in my whole life. It was wild but fun and different.Dangerous for young children.

reviews.title: Beautiful and relaxing 🙌🏼
reviews.text: I went there with my friends because it's a public beach and we were not staying in a hotel with a private one. It's breathtaking, beautiful beach, crystalline water, calm waves and some fishes dancing around. Looked like a gathering point for locals (of course I might be wrong). The coastguard was really friendly and helpful about an incident we had with an older guy who was taking pictures of us... We were redirected with an officer and the problem was solved, pictures erased, etc. Although we were freaked out by the whole situation we really enjoyed de beach. So we went back there some days after. Do visit Playa Delfines, you won't regret it!

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Nice beach, in the zona hotelera.  Very crowded. There are signs alerting tourist about possibly contaminated water with E.coli.  Public restrooms available.

reviews.title: June vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with blue waters and white sand.  Great tourist sign saying CANCUN for a picture.  Small line to stand in front of sign for that picture.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Gteat beach for water sports etc use Cancun Sailing we had a great day snorkelling the reef with them

reviews.title: Playa Delfines
reviews.text: Great open to the public beach. Has the Cancun spot sign to take great selfies. Has slides and swings for kids. Clean atmosphere.

reviews.title: Welcome to Cancun
reviews.text: As we approach The hotel zone from the airport this is first view of the ocean and it takes our breath away. In 30 years of coming to Cancun this is our stop. I am amazed of the crowds standing in line to capture the perfect photo. Oh yes, the beach is indeed beautiful.

reviews.title: Famous sign
reviews.text: The reason to go here is to take a picture of the famous cancun colorful sign. The beach is a really nice spot too if you want to swim there. The line to take the picture with the sign was really long. You have to wait awhile.

reviews.title: Iconic Cancun sign
reviews.text: Stop by Playa Delphines for a picture with the iconic Cancun letters. Great photo spot. Beautiful backdrop and a nice clean beach.

reviews.title: Photo taking opportunity
reviews.text: There you have the chance to get in Line to take a picture with the sign Of CANCUN in the background

reviews.title: Absolutely Delicious restaurant at Moon Palace
reviews.text: Moon Palace has many great restaurants.  However, this beach front grill in the Nizuc area is really outstanding and quite unexpected. This is the area that has tables beach side and also serves food under your palapa right on the beach.  Their quesadillas are probably the best I've ever had.  The Special Nachos are also excellent as well as their tacos.  It is a very clean, non-greasy approach to Mexican food.  You've got to try it.  You won't be disappointed!  I didn't write down our waiter's name, but think it was Xavier.....he left no stone un-turned to provide a perfect meal.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: The beach is gorgeous!  The condo we rented was along the quieter part of the beach, which was toward the southern end of the hotel zone.  The waves are definitely bigger than other beaches, but we thought it was fine.  Go for the turquoise blue water!

reviews.title: Great public beach
reviews.text: Tourists flock this beach, without the traditional timeshare pitch. very laid back. Most people bring their cooler and snacks

reviews.title: Great for the Cancun Picture!
reviews.text: Visited this beach just for the picture in front of the CANCUN sign. Other than that if you are staying in the hotel zone it is just the same beach. If you are staying outside the hotel zone than this is the place you want to go to see that turquoise water we see in the pictures of Cancun.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean, pristine beach.  Beware of big waves and heat - not many places to get shade and no where to buy drinks.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, limited parking if not there early it's tough. We were there around 10.30 am and parking  was fine, beach huts/shades were full by 10.45 so would suggest to be there early and the under current was really strong by 11.30.

reviews.title: Gorgeous view
reviews.text: The waves here are large compared to those at playa tortugas and other beaches a little more inlet. The water is crystal blue and there is a lot of space to lay out on the sand and free hits to sit under on super sunny days. The beach is more of a locals beach so it's rather empty during the week. There are public restrooms and showers at the top by the side walk for rinsing off before returning to your day. There is a,so a large Cancun sign great for taking photos in front of but beware there tends to be a line for it.

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: We called in here on our way back from the marina as it’s such a lovely beach. There is the famous Cancun sign where there is always a queue of people waiting for a good photo opportunity. We didn't stay long as it started raining but we did enjoy playing in the park above the beach before dashing out of the rain.

reviews.title: Must check this out!
reviews.text: A Must see when visiting Cancun! Pictures will be Epic. Had a great time! Very Cool. There is a playground for kids.

reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text: We stopped by this famous playa during our stay in Cancun. Nice waves, the water is very clear. Walked on the beach with my love, loved it! A must-do when you visit Cancun!

reviews.title: Great public beach.
reviews.text: View is outstanding. Good waves for body/boogie/board surfing. (Watch the flags). Showers and rest rooms. Bring your cooler. ( no services)

reviews.title: The beach was beautiful.
reviews.text: We had fun at the beach plenty of beach for everyone to enjoy, close to other activities. Different food. Places and museum,  and big mall with very many stores ,food venues

reviews.title: Lovely beach that has red flags
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, worth visiting when staying in Cancun BUT, like most of the beaches on the hotel strip it was red flagged when I visited i.e. dangerous to swim. It is such a pity that these beautiful Cancun beaches are so often too dangerous to swim in. You might swim out against a red flag but I won't. Under one of the few yellow (caution flags) I found the sea entry was sharply shelving, difficult to get in and out of unless you are quite young and very fit. Delfines is beautiful, has plenty of shade cover and facilities, but like much of Cancun, not a good safe place to swim.

reviews.title: If you're not in a all inclusive hotel
reviews.text: Worth visiting if you're not in one of the beach front hotels.There is no infrastructure around, no food, no drinks except for some locals selling overpriced soft drinks.

reviews.title: Playa Delfines
reviews.text: The beach at Playa Delfines was about an easy 15 minute walk from our hotel.  It is an absolutely beautiful beach and is a good place to take pictures to capture the color of the Caribbean.  We also had fun taking pictures with the Cancun sighn.

reviews.title: Quiet clean public beach
reviews.text: If you just want to enjoy a sound of waves (not loud music blasting all day long) and clean white sandy beach with minimum facility, this is your place. I would recommend to bring your own drinks and snacks since there are no restaurants or shops near by. Waves and currents are very strong here so this is not a swimming beach. There are dedicated lifeguards on duty and keep their eyes on people who go too far out from the shore. I am a strong swimmer but I did not even try to swim here. Very refreshing to have a beach like this in Cancun. I hope this public beach stays public for long time.

reviews.title: Beautiful Public Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful public beach at the edge of hotel zone. Free public parking. No rocks . Nice vendors... Bus stops right in front. Great bathrooms with showers. Also has best photo op in Cancun with the GIANT CANCUN sign that over looks the beach. But be advised on a busy day it will take you some time (20-30 mins.) to get that photo op.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: Lots of umbrellas and chairs along the beach, people coming by with drinks and food if you get hungry/thirsty.  You can even rent surf boards!

reviews.title: Picturesque beach
reviews.text: Just on the edge of the hotel zone, Playa Delphines is a gorgeous public beach. Caught a bus from the Riu Cancun, takes around ten minutes and costs 10.5 pesos. Free chairs and thatched umbrellas, and vendors come round with drinks which are more than reasonably priced! Warm water, no rocks (unlike the beach by our hotel). Also home to the Cancun sign - don't forget to stop and take a picture! :)

reviews.title: Most beautiful Public Beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Most of the beach in Hotel Zone is taken over by resorts.This beach is available to public! And it is fabulous! Beautiful views and a lot of space! There are bathrooms, showers, palapas for shade and play structures for kids of different ages...

reviews.title: great clean beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful. it offers free parking. you can tip the parking attendant if you would like. We stumbled upon this beach driving through hotel zone. it is a short walk from el ray ruins. the beach is very clean.

reviews.title: Such a beautiful landscape!
reviews.text: This is one of my favourites beaches I've ever visited!!!! Everything is beautiful, the different colours on the beach combine with the sky and the sun is a dreamy view! I've gone 4 times and each time I feel very happy being there!

reviews.title: Big waves!
reviews.text: I love Playa Delfines. It's such a beautiful beach. My jaw literally dropped at the first glimpse of of the gorgeous Caribbean turquoise. The waves are not too big and they are a lot of fun to jump in, for people young and old. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Amazing beach to spend the day
reviews.text: Amazing beach, with free chairs (between 9am and 3pm), some shadow, and a sea with impressive color. With places to shower, bathroom, and people selling great and unexpensive margaritas and piña coladas. Strongly recommend!

reviews.title: That view!
reviews.text: This beach called the mirador, has gorgeous views of the caribbean sea, is worth a visit, is the biggest public beach in Cancún, has bathrooms, and "palapas", is also certified by the blue flag.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Public beach in Cancun Hotel zone. Very  breathtakingly beautiful! The Cancun sign is located there too so make sure to snap a picture 😃

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: Clean, tidy and just beautifulWe came to visit the Cancun sign as this is our favourite destination in the world that we have visited. Highly worth going.

reviews.title: Post card looking beach
reviews.text: We got here by taxi from Royalton hotelA slight queue for a picture with Cancun sign but not too long and happy to see police presence The beach is straight off a Caribbean beach post card and makes great photos, however there were red flags flying on the beach and the sea did look as though that section had currents so didn't swim, but a beautiful area to visit

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: One of the public beaches in the Cancun Hotel Zone. Great location, you can surf a bit. Lots of space, and easily accessible from the R1 Bus route.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Great beach to expend the entire day. The color of the water is something amazing, crystal clear....

reviews.title: BEACH
reviews.text: Not much shade, can be rough with waves. Overall nice Beach. Parking available. Drinks are also available by roaming "waiters". They did have some small huts for some shade, but located higher up the beach  has some rocks that can be a pain.

reviews.title: Stunning blue sea and soft sand
reviews.text: This place is just breathtaking stunning and an absolute must when visiting Cancun and the pic by the Cancun sign is perfect for the fiery pic in your holiday album We saw a very chilled pelican and fish swimming around your feet This place is picture perfect I've never ever been in a sea with water was warm as this

reviews.title: So beautiful...
reviews.text: This beach is unbelievable beautiful! The shades of blue will leave you speechless. They offer chairs and there is a public restroom both for a very small fee. Also, in this beach you will find the "Cancun" sign - which is quite small that I thought and usually is pretty crowded. We didn't want to wait in a line just to take a picture, so we just went by the side of the sign and took a bunch while people were taking their ones... It turned out just fine! I definitely recommend this place!

reviews.title: Very clean beach with white soft sand.
reviews.text: Rested in November 2014. Very clean beach with white soft sand. The water even in cloudy weather and a bright turquoise color. The sea off the coast is not deep, it's nice to lie in the water and jump on the waves. Constantly blowing wind on the mare always wave height of 1 meter. After the storm, in the morning there is a lot of seaweed. But they were immediately removed to 8 o'clock in the morning.

reviews.title: What a view!
reviews.text: Best spot on the hotel zone to view & take pictures of the ocean. The bus can take you there...only 10.50 pesos each way.

reviews.title: 7th wonder of the world
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful stunning beach I've ever seen it's absolutely gorgeousclear water beautiful soft whit sand..

reviews.title: Doesn't Get Much Better
reviews.text: Simply gorgeous beach, although often crowded at peak times. White sand & azure tones will lull you into a state of bliss.

reviews.title: Just an amazing beach
reviews.text: You must go and see this beach truly awesome. Surfers paradise,wildlife plenty.no shops bars restaurants in this area so if you go take water  food towel

reviews.title: beautiful!
reviews.text: so peaceful and calm. easy to get to. free palapas. clean bathrooms. a vendor sells excellent margaritas and other drinks.

reviews.title: Public beach that active blocks cell phones
reviews.text: There is wifi here that they charge for, and all cellphone service is blocked. you walk a 100 meters to the north or south on the beach and there is 5 bars of LTE service.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We visited playa defines in April, oh what a lovely beach, very beautiful, big waves perfect for surfers!! Not much there, but definitely worth a visit

reviews.title: Amazing view!
reviews.text: This beach had an amazing view, breathtaking! Any city bus could drop you off at this location, so you can take beautiful pictures and refresh your eyes with such a beautiful picturesque view! Truly some sight to see.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Very nice public beach in the middle of the hotel zone. The view is beautiful, and the sea is calm enough.It's a bit difficult to park the rental car.

reviews.title: A beautiful public beach
reviews.text: A beautiful public beach in the center of the hotel area of Cancun. Very clean and spacious. Excellent to enjoy the beautiful colorful Caribbean beaches, has an area of showers and bathrooms very practical and clean

reviews.title: Gorgeous Caribbean Beach
reviews.text: I absolutely love Playa Delfines which translates into Dolphin Beach in English. It is rated as a Blue Flag Beach, which means it is extremely clean and safe and has very low e-coli bacteria counts which are monitored regularly. There is a very steep incline up from the beach, which results in a strong current and big waves crashing into the scoreline, much to the delight of swimmers of all ages, who can be seen frolicking in the waves. There are lots of seashells to be found in the sand along the high tide line. It is located approximately 30 minutes from downtown Cancun and is easily accessed the local buses which charge a nominal 10 pesos or $1 for a one way trip. The Caribbean turquoise blue is absolutely stunning, breathtaking and jaw dropping! This is by far one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited. An absolutely must see!

reviews.title: free public beach
reviews.text: this beach has a great view, one side to the ocean and on the other the lagoon, just be carefull with you car, the park place is hard to find after 9:00 am, but any citie bus  can take you there.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, although the waves were rough. We were staying outside the royal resorts, so the sand was nice and clean! And the beautiful palapa was a big plus! You can get massage on the beach,although its a bit expensive. The occean was of course LOVELY!

reviews.title: Isla Mujeres Gem
reviews.text: If visiting Isla Mujeres you must visit this beach!  White powder sand and beautiful crystal clear water....wide beaches with plenty of chair rentals and refreshments.  This is a MUST do when on Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Love the beaches
reviews.text: The first few days of our trip the wind and wave action was pretty rough; Red flags for rough waves and rip tide possibility. That didn't deter my enjoyment of the Playa Defines. The beach sand is not as fine or white as Florida's gulf coast but is is not that course but just as beautiful. Is easy to walk on without any pain to the feet. At our resort the sand was raked and cleaned up every morning by the resort staff and all the loungers were carefully rearranged. The water is so beautiful and changes shades from an aquamarine to deeper royal blues. The pictures taken do not do justice (even with a high end digital camera). The resort staff would bring drinks and food if requested. Every day "vendors" would walk up and down the beach selling their wares. It was typically guys selling Oakley knockoffs, cuban cigars, beach bags, jewelry, lady's beach covers and dresses. If you decide to buy NEGOTIATE, just as you should down at the market. NEVER pay full price and don't be afraid to walk away. They will come back to you and try again. HOLD YOUR GROUND, but realize these people make their living doing this so leave a little meat on it for them.

reviews.title: This beach is so close to everything and clean
reviews.text: This is beach to accessible for everyone and really prestine. The sand so soft that you cannot believe it. It is really like a paradise. The waves are high here compared with other beaches around Cancun. Don't forget to pose in front CANCUN landmark at the beach entrance near car parking/BusStop.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Very nice Beach,love the cancun sign and fresh fruit vendors. Also nice to see some fish come in with the waves and the pelicans catch them.

reviews.title: Good view
reviews.text: Good view of the sea - the water is very blue. Sand is a bit coarse but seaweed is minimal. Visited Saturday in the AM. Not crowded at all!

reviews.title: Huge beach with facilities
reviews.text: We loved this beach, it has a lot free umbrellas , play ground for kids, shower , toilets, there are a lot of option to buy soft drinks and beer from the beach sellers .The water sport activities are available 300 m away, they are next to to the hotel area.There is a beautiful panorama plato, from where you can take an amazing picture.

reviews.title: Great public beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and ocean view. The undertow here can be dangerous and red flags were flying continuously the times we visited. Busy with locals and tourists alike.

reviews.title: Great for picture...not much else
reviews.text: If you want to take a picture with the Cancun sign,  stop quickly and head back to your resort. The beach isn't great, tons of rock and sharp objects and the playgrounds aren't safe enough to let your kids play on them. Lots of locals hanging around drinking....but they aren't a bother. Safety is a real concern if you have little ones.

reviews.title: HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP
reviews.text: Stayed in playa del carmen this past week. The beaches were just not that fun. After reading reviews we took the collectivo from Playa to Cancun and hopped on the bus R1 and took us directly to Playa Delfines.  The sand was soo white and the water was the most amazing I have every seen.  We wanted to go were the waves were good.  This place was perfect.  After reading reviews, I knew there was no food or drink provided. We bought a small cooler and brought some beer and sandwiches. However there were staffers that worked with the hotel on the right not sure which one blue one and they took our orders and brought us back huge margaritas and food right to us. We did not even have to move!  We speak spanish so we asked as they were passing by maybe that is why customers think there is no food possibly?   There was also locals selling fruit , water and soda.  Next time we are skipping playa and heading straight to this beach.

reviews.title: Such a beautiful public beach.  Slept like a baby
reviews.text: Cool water, great waves, lots of huts to sleep under.I liked that it was secure, you could go for a swim and leave your towel behind and no one would take it.  Great place to take pictures.  Bathrooms right there to change and shower.

reviews.title: Beach was good but no amenities
reviews.text: Beach was quite beautiful, although far away. The problem was that there was no way you can buy food or drinks. I mean we were dying in thirst. No water nothing. We tried to go to the hotel nearby to buy an access to restaurant but they did not let us.

reviews.title: Busy place!
reviews.text: My daughter and I stayed at the great Parnassus resort, and walked down to see the beautiful "Cancun" sign. There were many others visiting also. We felt safe, and walked the beach back. Worth a visit!

reviews.title: Rough Surf
reviews.text: Very Rough surf at this beach when we were in Cancun the last week of March.  Young kids could easily get knocked over by the waves even if only in knee deep.  You can get a nice photo by the Cancun sign in front of the beach.  Go to the El Ray ruins across the street for only $4 US dollars a person.  Takes about 30 minutes to walk through.

reviews.title: Impressive View
reviews.text: Even if you can't stay on the beach for too long like us, it's worth the short bus ride to the end of the line to see the view, especially with the iconic Cancun multi-coloured sign.

reviews.title: Amazing White Sand Beach!
reviews.text: most incredible water!  Warm, gentle waves, great sun, volleyball on the beach and easy access from the hotel!

reviews.title: Beautiful. Absolutely beautiful
reviews.text: Secluded from the resorts with a restroom on site and busses running very often. It's interesting to see the three layers of water colour. The sand is amazing. Just wonderful.Also has the famous Cancun sign to take pictures with. If you want to chill out at a beach without being bothered by the frat boys, this is the place to go

reviews.title: Very good beach
reviews.text: The waves were high that day, but still great fun. Public access with showers and public outdoor gym overlooking the beach. Only thing missing is lack of shade, there are few umbrellas but not enough for this large beach. Also, I didn't see any food stores around (luckily I wasn't hungry). Still... color of the water and sand neglect all those minor minuses. Overall great place to be.

reviews.title: Great to get away from the tourists! Awesome local beach
reviews.text: Very nice public beach , watch for parking spots to open up . On the south end of the strip but a short ride from anywhere. Good thing is no big hotels on this section and lots of nice locals!  The view deck from the street is awesome for photos!  must see views CANCUN sign near too for photos. Surf can be rough..

reviews.title: BREATH-TAKING
reviews.text: From the "CANCUN" lettering - to the color of the water.  Just BREATH TAKING.A definite place to go with the family.  If you don't pack up the food and snacks - you will have to go back and get them.  Here there is not one selling food (as least from what we seen).A MUST on the TO DO list for beaches.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beach accessible by car or bus. Bus was 6 or 11 pessos from Downtown Cancún but we could not figure out why it was cheaper or more expensive. The beach was quite clean with enough places to hide from sun. Toilets and shower are there but no drinking water (at least we did not find it). Locals offering fruits and refreshments.

reviews.title: Beautiful, public beach
reviews.text: Conveniently located in the middle of the hotel zone.  It's a huge, beautiful beach with an iconic CANCUN sign by the road.

reviews.title: Dolphins Beach
reviews.text: this beach is the biggest public beach in town..if your looking for and experience where you want to run into local people this might be your spot.. as well if you looking for a beach with waves you get the most in this beach good for buggy boarding and or surfing!

reviews.title: Public Beach
reviews.text: Nice beach! It is public. No cost at all.You can enjoy the green and transparent ocean.Nice picture with Cancun letters.

reviews.title: Picturesque
reviews.text: This is a public beach.  Lovely area of beach with lovely, soft, clean sand.  Large waves and just so picturesque.  The R1 or R2 bus pass there all the time.  As our Resort was pretty close to the Playa Defines, we did not actually get off of the bus and visit the beach itself.

reviews.title: Cancun Sign
reviews.text: I just went there to get a picture of the Cancun sign which is located at the beach but then spent a while to just take in the beauty of it. It's really nice down there, it seemed to have a lot of sanitary units and lounge chairs which is great.  I'd definitely recommend checking it out while you're in Cancun.

reviews.title: A must. Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: If you are in the area yoi have to visit. Nearby is the sculpture with the word CANCUN so you can take pictures

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach of Cancun
reviews.text: It's the most beautiful beach of Cancun and has a public entrance, in other parts of the beach you just got the beaches trough the hotels. We really enjoyed playa delfines.

reviews.title: MUST SEE THIS BEACH
reviews.text: Very easy to get to. Any r1 or r2 bus will drop you off or pick you up at the beach. It has sowers and wash rooms. View from up top lookouts  are amazing. Very clean public beach for locals and travellers alike. Very safe. Great sand. Nice natural umbrellas to escape the sun when needed. As it is a little further down the strip it does see more wind. Waves can be larger. Watch the parasailers floating around.  All round great beach for the day or just a few hous. You do have to walk down a ways to the beach and coming up is a little steep   Quite a few stairs to the top.  May not be the greatest in the heat for those with mobility issues or health concerns. No impossible but would want to take your time.

reviews.title: Pretty sunsets!
reviews.text: We walked here from our hotel for a sunset picture. Well worth the small walk for such a pretty setting

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH
reviews.text: When you go to cancun and want to see white beaches and blue water, this is the place, this place is astonish, and the best thing is that is free (public) and has very clean and safe bathrooms to change your clothes and get into the water.

reviews.title: Beautiful Public Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful Public beach. . Great to stroll down the beach , snap pictures , saying Hola to the locals and families,  lots going on all the time and yes there are lifeguards that are on duty . Just becareful as the Ocean is a powerful thing.

reviews.title: Beautiful touristy beach
reviews.text: I thought it was beautiful being able to see the beach and ocean from up above. It was filled with people enjoying the public beach. I confess I like the beach front in front of my villa better because it was further from the crowds and the spring breakers.

reviews.title: Was a Must See
reviews.text: While visiting Cancun for the first time, we took the family by bus from our hotel to see the CANCUN sign.  It's bright colors and quiet location made for a lovely visit and photo opportunities with the kids.On another tour on the way back to the hotel it was already dark outside and the CANCUN sign was all lit up with floodlights glowing on the colored letters.  Very pretty, either daylight or dark.

reviews.title: Great public beach in the hotel area!
reviews.text: Beautiful public beach with a long stretch of sand and of course the beautiful ocean! Sand is quite clean. We walked for 2hours!It has swings and a playground for children. Make sure to go when it's sunny!

reviews.title: Just Beautiful
reviews.text: This place is magical, full of culture and a wonderful view.. Here is pretty much your first stop when you arrive to Cancun, a must!! We enjoyed this location to the fullest, lots of people and you just want to get lost in the view!!!!!

reviews.title: Private beach with a long stretch to choose from
reviews.text: Private beach with a long stretch to choose from.It has swings for kids and a playground and loungers to rent. Worth a visit as the sand is pretty white here.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: We rent a condo on the beach yet we often walk to this park, it is so lovely there and family friendly, nice to see all the local families who come on weekends. We also like the outdoor gym eqipment available for everyone to use. There are lineups to take pictures with the colourful CANCUN sign, I'm sure there are pictures of it around the world - come and enjoy!

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach with lots of parking!
reviews.text: A good choice if you have a car and are staying in central Cancun.  Get there kinda early and bring food - nothing for sale.  Beach loungers are available on a tip basis.

reviews.title: just great
reviews.text: great public beach - one of the best free places to go in the Zona Hotelera. If you like sun, send, see - a t least a view of the ocean, this is the place to be! Easy to get to by public bus.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: Clean beach. Swings for kids to play. Don't forget to get a picture by the cancun sign. Nice beach to just relax. Sometimes it gets crowded

reviews.title: Best beach ever!
reviews.text: The place is very clean and well kept. Every minute there are food vendors available.nice place to reat and be with friends or family!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Awesome public beach with lots of playground equipment for kids.  Immaculately kept with wonderful modern amenities.  Get there early if you want to spend some time there.  Parking and sitting spots fill up.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviews.text: We have visited this beach many times...it is gorgeous.  However very strong waves so not good for swimming.  We stay in downtown Cancun but always make several trips down here by taking an R 1 bus which costs 10.5 pesos. The beach is clean and has several palapas......the famous colored  CANCUN  sign is here also for photos.  I highly recommend seeing this beach!

reviews.title: Great day
reviews.text: Great day!  The beach wasn't overcrowded at all.  It was mostly locals and nobody trying to sell you stuff.

reviews.title: Exquisite Beach!
reviews.text: Stunning white sand large Public beach with beautiful warm turquoise water to frolic in! Lounge chairs free in exchange for ID. Nice palm umbrellas. $1 R1 bus ride. Located in the very high $$$$$$ end of Cancun. Stay in a reasonable $$ hotel in downtown Cancun. Take the pleasant public bus. Bring your drinks (no glass) and lunch for the perfect relaxing day! It's heavenly at Playa Delfines!

reviews.title: One of the nicest beaches in CUN
reviews.text: Not the beach for you if you are looking for tranquil waters. I would not recommend this beach for families with small children.  Big waves, undercurrent and not much swimming... ( red flag is up most of the time at this particular beach) However: Great view. Not overcrowded. Free palapas. Peaceful , beautiful and amazing. This is exactly the beach you imagine when you think of the Mexican Caribbean- turqouise waters, white sands, and a great view of Cancun beach length extending some 25 kilometers...I recommend it for friends ( bring a cooler and some snacks, some beach games and make it a day)  , for couples, families with young adults, for solo travellers ..  Just breathe and soak it all in. Enjoy.

reviews.title: A wonderful public beach
reviews.text: One of several Blue Flag beaches in Cancún, Playa Defines is a great public beach with very good facilities. Safe swimming under the watchful eyes of the life guards and the Tourist Police.

reviews.title: Total Relaxation!
reviews.text: If you're looking for a great beach with excellent sun and this is the place to go! Very close to the hotel zone in Cancun as well...

reviews.title: Free Beach - where the locals hang out
reviews.text: Free Playa not associated with any hotel - where the locals hang out.  A lot of the time there are red flags & no swimming allowed due to surf and an undertow from the beach but there is often an area with a yellow flag if you want to play around a bit in the surf - the life guards are serious about their job and very competent and will whistle people to keep them in safe bounds outside of any undertow.  The sand is lovely and you can grab a palapa for free if you are there before noon or even rent a beach chaise lounge for inexpensive price from the little kiosk just under the viewing deck by the tourist police booth.  Lots of young local guys will come around to take your orders for drinks and snacks and bring them to you.  Also some fresh fruit vendors and a couple craft vendors and trained massage therapists are on hand close by.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: On the weekends, it's packed with locals, but on the weekdays you can have the place to yourself.  Soft white sands with a few  palupa-roofed tables/umbrellas available.Lifeguard(s) on duty.  Bathrooms (but you have to pay for toilet paper!)  No nearby bars/restaurants, but locals will come by selling water and drinks.

reviews.title: Day at the beach
reviews.text: We took the bus for $1 to this beach, and were so glad we did. The view is absolutely beautiful, we got there around 830am and had the entire beach to ourselves until about 11 when people started rolling in. The water is an incredible shade of blue-green and the sand is white as can be. We spent an hour just collecting a pile of the tiniest, most perfect little shells and then just sat and watched the waves crash on the shore and felt the wind on our faces. It was a really wonderful day.

reviews.title: A BEAUTIFUL PUBLIC BEACH
reviews.text: This is one of the public beaches on the Hotel Zone, at around 11 KM. If you are staying On the Zone, the beach will be right in front of your hotel or condo so there is no need to visit this beach as the entire Hotel Zone is one long, beautiful beach. However, if you are not staying on the Zone, this is way to enjoy the beach. There are the palm shade 'umbrellas' if you get there early, washrooms and vendors for snacks although I would suggest packing a lunch and drinks. The busses stop in front and just steps from the beach. If you get bored the Reyes ruins are just across the road.

reviews.title: best beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Great beach , white sand , lovely view of the caribbean sea for  there, ,batrooms are not the best , but they have it , take your food with you if you are planning to be there long  , or else you will have to eat mangos only.

reviews.title: Popular Cancun sign
reviews.text: You can't pass up a photo op with this sign with playa delfines in the background to make people back home hate you with jealousy. The wind was whipping that day so waves looked crazy dangerous, but beautiful from the high vantage point and the flying sand and pebbles were stinging our skin. Keep an eye on your flip flops otherwise you might see them again at the flea market as we found out the hard way, lol! Although it was not fun having to carry my barefoot daughter onto the bus back to the hotel just to fetch her other shoes.

reviews.title: Afternoon Enjoyed
reviews.text: A nice short getaway from the hotel beach, lots of locals so great to meet and chat with them. Food and drink available, great photo opportunities, especially the Cancun sign, lit up in evening and even if crowded if you wait and assist someone with their photo, they most likely will return the favor.

reviews.title: No hotel party
reviews.text: It is one of the beaches in cancun with no hotel controlling and it is real safe and good to stay there. Bein one of the most popular beaches in Cancun, has also the Name of Cancun in the parking lot and with the beach ocean view for taking pics.

reviews.title: top Beach in the area / surt spot
reviews.text: If you like to surf this is the spot or if you like to spend a day at the beach this will be the right place is a quiet and large beach, good for jogging too ! ;)

reviews.title: Nice area for kids to play.
reviews.text: Great beach with bathrooms.  Lots of playground equipment for the kids and some workout equipment there also.  There is a nice Cancun sign for picture taking as well by the road.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I went just to see and click the pictures of CANCUN sign, and it is just beautiful. I saw some kids activities over there, it is a good place if you have kids too. if you are staying in hotel zone just take the R1 bus from your hotel and visit this picture perfect place.

reviews.title: Best beach in Cancun -- free
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with amazing clear green/blue water. Windy day and some waves made the temperature bearable. Worth a visit. Take bus R1 from the center and pay only 10,5 pesos one way.

reviews.title: Beautiful place to spend some time.
reviews.text: If you go there early in the morning, you will find the great Cancun sign area empty and have great photo opportunity. Why not take the advantage of swimming in the blue waters of Gulf of Mexico in quiet morning environment? The sands here are white and small. There are beach cots to hire along with umbrella, changing room, restaurants etc. Great to spent two or three hours time!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach; great location
reviews.text: The iconic CANCUN sign is up near the road, and there is a huge area for anyone to enjoy this beach.  White sand, life guards, restrooms

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: I loved the beach but it was way too cowded, depending on the weather. I prefer chac mool, although this one is beautiful as well. You must go if you want the picture with the "cancun" sign... you might have to queue for a few minutes though

reviews.title: Not a pretty beach at all.
reviews.text: There was nothing attractive about this Cancun Beach, when I saw it  this past May 2015. Tired and dirty!

reviews.title: Lovely beach with famous Cancun sign
reviews.text: We stopped by Playa Delfines on our way back from a day excursion to Tulum/Xel-Ha.  Lovely public beach with palapas. No place to buy anything nearby, so if you're visiting the beach be sure to bring your own water and snacks.  The Del Rey ruins are literally across the street so could easily visit both. Of course we took the requisite photos in front of the famous Cancun sign, which will make for the perfect postcard pictures!

reviews.title: Cancun Hotel Zone public beach
reviews.text: Situated near the end of the Hotel Zone, Playa Delphinas is a popular spot for locals. The expansive beach is easily reached by the R-1 or R-2 bus, with the stop right at the beach. There are no vendors or restaurants, so bring your own snacks and water.

reviews.title: good for people not staying beach front
reviews.text: if you are staying downtown with friends or in an unexpensive hotel with no beach this is a good option to enjoy , make sure to bring plenty of drinks and snacks because there is no store nearby

reviews.title: Wonderful sea and beach
reviews.text: The caribbean sea is one of the most beautiful and precious places for sun and sea lovers ! This is really an amazing beach...very long and large shore and soft sand ! It's also free of charge ! The water has amazing colours and is very clear ! Surf beginners may find their place to start ! Next time i'll be in Mexico for sure it will be on my schedule :)

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.  Not crowded when we visited end of January.  Highly recommended if your resort does not have a good beech.  You can take the bus to get there.  Fare is 10.5 Pesos, about 60 Cents or one US Dollar.

reviews.title: Very nice!!
reviews.text: Very nice beach that's easy to get to. It's right on the bus route. It's very clean and HUGE! The only negative was you had to pay to use the restroom.

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: This is really an amazing beach, very clean. I really had a nice day there!!Definitely, I will go to it again

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: One of the best public beaches in Cancun. You can get there using a public bus, no entry fee. There are rest rooms available, umbrellas to rent and drinks/snacks to buy from the local vendors. Wonderful place to relax!

reviews.title: An Amazing Beach - Totally Free!
reviews.text: Playa Delfines is an excellent way to spend a half day while staying in Cancun.  This public beach is very well maintained with clean sand, lots of room and a great surf to swim in.  Getting there is easy by taking any R-1 or R-2 bus for $10 MXN.  You don't need to waste your money on a taxi.FACILITIESWhether you are going from a resort or from the downtown district of Cancun, the only thing you need are regular beach items (towel, sunscreen, small cooler, etc).  There are free lounge chairs and umbrellas to borrow from the supply hut as you enter the beach.  The very friendly staff there will even deliver them to the front of the beach for free!  Saying that, a small tip will be appreciated.  There are clean washrooms and open showers to rinse-off after you have had a great swim.  While relaxing, it is not uncommon to be approached by people selling beer and other bar items.  When I was there a beer cost $45 MXN.  While it is a little pricey for a can of beer, the poor fellow fetching it from the bar has quite a hike to fill your order and return.  Payment is cash but not due until the delivery is complete.SECURITYLike any other public beach, you should keep an eye on your things, but there are many other tourists with their own things on their chairs as well.  The local police patrol the beach often as well.The undertow can be strong.  The condition red flag was up when we where there, but this did not prevent many from swimming.  Just be careful with smaller children and weaker swimmers.  Common sense needs to prevail like any other beach anywhere else.I recommend this beach as a great activity while in Cancun.

reviews.title: Public beach
reviews.text: Public beach with restrooms, on the bus line. Locals use it often. The beach is surrounded by hotels on one side and some type of fenced "nature zone" on the other side, then more hotels. No life guard.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach!
reviews.text: So, this beach is very close to where we stayed which was crown paradise.  I would recommend a visit here if you are at a hotel with a sucky beach.  This public beach is well maintained, has shady palapas, a kids playground, washrooms and very clean.  They have a huge cancun sign for photo ops too!  Easy to get to by bus.
