The part of the ocean that you can enjoy the waves, body surf, it's all good.  Lots of weddings come here for just the pictures, it's beautiful.

reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.text: I went to almost all the beaches, one is nicer than the other. I simply loved Cancun. The beaches are clean, it is safe to go there and leave your things even whne you are in the water fir longer periods of time.

reviews.title: Must see and free
reviews.text: It should be on ur to do list if you go to Cancun!! The best part is that it's free and a beautiful beach. The day we went the waves were a lil bit out of control but we had fun. Too bad we went there on our last day in Cancun

reviews.title: Nice public beach
reviews.text: This is a nice and quiet public beach.  However, there are no bars or restaurants along this stretch of beach.

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: While it's a nice beach, it seems to be most popular with those whose hotels don't have a beach.  It's across the street from El Rey ruins so it makes it a convenient way to hit both!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Soft, beautiful sand and water - everywhere is picture perfect.  Loved the colors of the water and simply walking along the beach through the water was fun.

reviews.title: Best public beach in all of Central America!
reviews.text: Though I haven't been to EVERY public beach in Central America, I now feel like I don't have try any others now - Playa Delfines amazed our group!  We traveled as two couples, rented a car in Cancun and navigated easily to this beach.  There was ample parking, attendants to assist with parking (and presumably watch for petty theft - tip them a couple bucks!)  The public toilets were clean enough, showers worked well, play area for kids looked fun (we had none with us but at that moment, wish we did!)  There were also many anchored umbrellas free to use, and the sand quality was PERFECT.  Parking to water's edge was not hard to walk, and when we walked down the beach to a hotel-owned portion of land, we found Playa Delfines to be much better!  Will definitely be back, and send my picky family.

reviews.title: Good public beach
reviews.text: Lots of room and sun shades.  It is kept very clean and patrolled by security.  Easy to get to by taxi or bus.

reviews.title: Clean, Not Crowded, Safe, and Free!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I recently traveled to Cancun and we saw that Playa Delfines was the top rated beach on TripAdvisor so we knew we had to check it out! Our experience at Playa Delfines completely impressed us! We read that it was a free public beach, so we were concerned that it would be crowded and dirty. This was not the case at all! Also, we visited in January and it was 87 degrees with a heat index of 91! It was such a joy to be able to experience that sunshine when back home in the US it was in the 30s.We visited the beach on a Saturday morning from 11:00 am - 4:00 pm and it was completely clean and not crowded at all! They have a bunch of little palm tree umbrellas for shade and when we arrived at 11:00 am, over half were empty so we claimed on of the shady spots and laid out our towel. By 2:00 all the umbrellas had been claimed, but the beach was still not very crowded at all. Plenty of privacy to be able to enjoy the sand and the water without invading anyone else's personal space.I've been to several beaches in Florida and South Carolina and Playa Delfines puts those beaches to shame when it comes to cleanliness and crowds.Another thing we loved about the beach was that it was just a 15 minute taxi ride to the airport and their are always taxis driving by so that you get get a ride anywhere in the city. Also, this area has lots of tourists, so we felt safe because we felt like we weren't outsiders. Another thing we liked was that there are vendors walkign around the beach selling drinks and snack to tourists. We ordered a couple Coca-Colas and fruit cups for about $1 USD each. Great deal. Gotta love that exchange rate. Fortunately my girlfriend speaks Spanish, but I wouldn't worry about the language barrier too much. All the taxi drivers and food vendors know enough to get you what you need.All in all, it was a great trip and I can't wait to come back.

reviews.title: Excellent free beach you must visit!
reviews.text: This is an excellent free public beach with great amenities. I was so impressed after my first visit I rearranged my plans in order to come back the following day. The R-1 and R-2 buses in the Hotel Zone stop here, right by the famous CANCUN sign where people line up for a photo op. This beach has free rest rooms and outdoor showers and a variety of free-to-use stationary umbrellas (palapas).  There are also a few benches and handicapped-reserved lounges beneath palapas. It's a clean beach surrounded by the turquoise waters of the Caribbean. Perhaps because it is the southern-most free beach on the hotel zone peninsula it wasn't too crowded (except for the photo op line at the CANCUN sign).  I suspect the other free beaches which are in the thick of the hotel zone might be more crowded. If you only have a short time in Cancun I'd suggest that you put Playa Delfines on your must see list!

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: Nice and quiet place in Cancun . Big waves in the sea . Sea without animals . You can buy small refreshment on the beach. Changing rooms , showers and toilets are near the beach . Entrance and parking are free .

reviews.title: Decent beach
reviews.text: The two big draws to the this beach: photo by the "Cancun" sign and that it is free of cost. It was very easy to get to by the hotel zone bus. Although it was a little busy, that is expected for a public beach. It is very very clean and had basic amenities.

reviews.title: Photo opportunity!!!
reviews.text: This is where you find the Classic Cancun Sign and from what I understood this is the only free beach in this area, any other beach is located throughout your hotel access. Nothing here but the beach, bathrooms and the sign no food or activities so just drop by take a picture and go!!!!

reviews.title: Good to be a public beach, but not good enough
reviews.text: There are other beaches that offer better views and service than this one. It is worth to pay a couple of pesos and get a nice clean beach with beds and umbrellas. We also had bad luck because of the weather, but it was ok to stay for 10 minutes (lol).

reviews.title: Space to lay out with all the perks of the hotel one beaches
reviews.text: This is a fun beach!! First, the beach offers showers and bathrooms right at the entrance. Second, descend a few steps and see the playground or the workout area for the members in your party that aren't excited about laying out all day long.. There are palapas all around, but you have to get there early in the day to claim one. The water is gorgeous and refreshing. Don't worry about going hungry, the locals walk the beach offering you food and drinks for a couple pesos.

reviews.title: Make sure you stop for a photo!
reviews.text: Not only is this an amazingly beautiful beach, it's got a super big "Cancun" sign that's the perfect backdrop for a touristy photo. It was our first glimpse of the ocean front after arriving at the airport. We didn't walk the beach or swim there but it looked awesome.

reviews.title: Good beach, but not any better than hotel beaches
reviews.text: I guess this beach is good if you don't have access to a beach through your hotel, but nothing about this beach was any better than what we had access to at the Emporio Hotel.  Has some showers, bathrooms, etc.  Also a small playground for kids, and a "Cancun" sign that had a huge line waiting for a photo op.

reviews.title: Beautiful and breath taking
reviews.text: He hopped a bus to this place and it was worth it ! The waves are of course too strong for little ones, but it's a must see in Cancun.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach,  the famous Cancun sign.
reviews.text: I went here because of the reviews I read on TripAdvisor.  We took the bus here from our hotel and got our picture taken by the sign.  We didn't swim here but it was a gorgeous beach.  There were lots of cool iguanas on the grounds nearby.  It was a nice little stop on our public bus adventure along the Blvd. Kukulkan.

reviews.title: Great beach, awesome waves!
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in zona hotelera! Showers, restrooms available. Also some sun shadows free of charge. When you already plan to go there, then visit also El Rey ruins that is in 2-minute walking distance. The ruins are nothing special, but lots of cool iguanas there for sure!

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: BEAUTIFUL clean beach with gorgeous water! Conveniently located next to the famous "CANCUN" sign! lots of tourists in the area.

reviews.title: Playa delfines - free beach
reviews.text: Our hostel recommended this beach since we were not staying in the hotel zone this was a lovely alternative. We just got the bus R1 which you can get straight from AV. TULUM to playa delfines. The single fare is 10.5 pesos. It's a lovely beach and it was never too crowded. Bring your own drinks and snacks though as there are no shops within walkable distance.

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean
reviews.text: Beautiful clean white sands and stunning turquoise sea, perfect for children.  Shower facilities and park area as well

reviews.title: Para fugir  das prais particulares ,otima praia
reviews.text: If you are staying in a all inclusive hotel try to walk there and join and enjoy the Mexicans. It's a beautiful beach.The Mexicans are very open and nice with the tourists.

reviews.title: MUST for Tourists and locals!!
reviews.text: This beach is a must for those visiting Cancun. This is where the colorful CANCUN letters are for pictures. This beach is great for the day. I recommend arriving early (9-10) since it gets very busy by noon and it's harder to find parking spots...

reviews.title: Free Beach
reviews.text: I asked in the hosted where I could go for a free beach. Since I wasn't staying in the Zona Hotelera and I didn't have access to a beach and I didn't want to spend money. I took a bus from Cancun to the Zona Hotelera. The beach is beautiful with white sand and free places for shade and free showers to clean after the day at the beach. Prepare to be in the company of some big lizards. At the end of your stay you can take a picture with the famous Cancun sign

reviews.title: Breath Taking
reviews.text: If your going to a beach jump on the R1 or R2 I am sure.. and head to the "Dolphin Beach" the place is beautiful picture perfect sand and sea.  The beach is even nicer by moonlight.

reviews.title: The best beach
reviews.text: In my opinion, this is the best beach in Cancun, is a little far away from the other beaches but is so quiet and have more space.This beach have showers and bathrooms too and have the famous letters of "CANCUN"

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: This is the best beach hands down in Cancun! The ONLY "must see" here. Bring water and snacks. But free shade and showers can't believe that. Super safe with life guards.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: This beach had nice clean sand, it was windy and cloudy when I went skin not many vendors were out. The massage places here can be brought down in prices, my girlfriend and I received a 30 minutes massage for $15 each. Bathrooms are at the end of the beach as well, small but will work.

reviews.title: Nice public beach
reviews.text: Nice public beach with public parking, and facilities.  The white sand and blue ocean is simply breathtaking.  If you are staying in the hotel zone,  your hotel probably has easier beach access.  If not you can definitely come here for swim or sun.

reviews.title: Good beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Good beach for in Cancun. Look south for less wavey beaches if you like that. Water was fun with the waves. Not a place For snorkeling but you could try to surf! Beginner surfing.

reviews.title: Nice beach for relaxing
reviews.text: There were not many tourists mostly locals. There were lots of palaps that you can sit under and the beach is great. Water is not shallow so not best beach for kids to swim. Has restrooms and playarea for kids.

reviews.title: Awesome public beach
reviews.text: We have been coming to cancun since the early 90s and love the turquoise water! This beach is safe and perfect for a day picnic - they have recently added bath rooms and pavilions. Its easily accessible from any public bus system. and ITS FREE!!!! Take your camera and enjoy!

reviews.title: Nice beach!!
reviews.text: Was a very nice place! Due to the clear water and sand! Very recomendable to visit it when you go to Cancun !!

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: I liked playa Tortuga better water was more calmer not so many high waves or seaweed they also have the ferry to go to isla mujeres And And The bungee jumping

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Clean n nice place. We took a picture on a cancun sign. Worth to visit, the water is clear n the public restroom also clean. Recommended

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach - great place for pictures!
reviews.text: This is a famous beach in Cancun and worth a visit. It's beautiful, an easy walk down to the water, with beautiful sand and blue water. You can take the bus there (or drive, there is parking). Public bathrooms are available if you need them. A must-visit while in Cancun!

reviews.title: Great amenities, pretty beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and great grounds! I loved how they had a free playground for kids to play on. As I recall, anyone can use the palapas. There is also the option of getting drinks delivered to you.

reviews.title: heaven
reviews.text: very nice beach just inside the hotel zone. if i am not wrong this is the only public beach in the hotel zone.it also have a clean restroom

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!!!!
reviews.text: Pictures do not represent the beauty of this beach! It is GORGEOUS! This is where the infamous Cancun sign is located. Therefore, if you plan on taking pictures, be ready for a line.

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach equipped with straw umbrellas
reviews.text: Gorgeous turquoise colored water. There's limited free parking. We got a spot without any problem. There's a play ground for kids.

reviews.title: Nice and not crowded
reviews.text: Went there 2 times and found it nice. White sand, moderate waves, free spaces under shades.  At the entrance there are toilets and showers.

reviews.title: Stunning view
reviews.text: Hands down the most beautiful beach in Cancun. The view from the street level is absolutely amazing, wide, long, white sandy beach. You can gaze for a long time at it, simply stunning. Careful if you want to take a picture with the " Cancun " sign on the street level, there is a line-up at all times and you have to hassle with people (we did) to be able to take pics.

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: The beach is amazing, but unfortunately the rain didn't help us. It should be unbelievable in a sunny day, for the place is beautiful

reviews.title: The softest sand!
reviews.text: This beach is spectacular with white soft sand and crystal clear waters. The service here is great & you will soak up some amazing sun!

reviews.title: A nice stretch of beach
reviews.text: We were staying at the north end of the hotel zone and took the bus down to this beach to check it out.  It's a nice stretch of beach but pretty packed out with all the resorts facing it.  It goes pretty steeply down into lots of waves.  Fun for a walk and to see what was going on at the party resorts, but we liked the peaceful beach at the InterContinental better, the beach was flatter and the water was calm.

reviews.title: A Great Public Beach Access
reviews.text: This beach is near the south end of the Hotel Zone, next to the Hilton hotel. It has a spectacular vista of the big beach, wide white shell sand that is always cool to the touch and lots of parking access. Worth a visit and see the El Rey ruins right next door, well worth it!

reviews.title: Blue flag beach
reviews.text: Beautiful wide sandy beach with palapas for shade, clean bathrooms and showers. Blue flag meaning one of the best beaches in Mexico, in all there are 6 blue flag beaches in Cancun! Just one problem, there are very strong rip tides on this beach so watch yourself and the kids when swimming out!

reviews.title: Very Pretty Beach
reviews.text: Where the "Cancun" sign is located.  Easily accessible by bus.  Very pretty beach, but I understand the waves can be very strong.  We didn't go in, just took pictures :)

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: Beautiful public beach at the south end of Hotel Zone. Wide beach area with very fine sand. Beachside kids activities are available. There is also a big colorful CANCUN sign for your photos!

reviews.title: Not sure what else you could want
reviews.text: I liked that the beach had a parking assistant help direct to park our car without sticking around for a tip.  He was there to help backing out onto the main drag.  There are thatched shelters available and we got there late and still got one no problem.  Free shower.  Restrooms available,  There were people walking the beach offering beverages but they were not intrusive.  If we did not come prepared it would be nice to have that.  I am surprised that someone saw a van get broken into because there are so many people around a thief would have to be very bold.  Cost me nothing, the sand went out far and the water was cleaner than nearer Playa del Carmen.  There were few parking spots available but we parked twice there but maybe on a busier day it will be difficult to get a spot.  Although far from Cancun proper and many of the hotels, it is one of the first beaches coming from the south (eg, Playa del Carmen).

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: It was a Sunday morning, beautiful beach! Turquoise waters and white sand.  We didn't get to go in the water because we were flying out that noon so we had to head back to the airport.  I wish we had gone there earlier in the week.  We will be back, definitely

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Great facilities. This seems to be a locals favorite spot. This is where they have that famous multi color "Cancun" sculpture.

reviews.title: Cancun signboard, crowded beach
reviews.text: We visited this beach mainly because of the Cancun signboard. There is always a crowd and many people dont have any etiquette. So you may be humble and stand in line for minutes while others just barge in take pics and go!!! gReat pic of the ocean behindd you!. The beach also has iguanas so look out for them! The beach has small shacks that look great in pictures. We didnt spend much time here as it was crowded! El Rey is just opposite so you can visit it as well. Buses stop here frequently.

reviews.title: good  stay close  and it look great
reviews.text: all good  only problem it rain evey day we were there,  but clime was great BECOUSE TEMPERUTE WAS NICE AND WAR

reviews.title: Peaceful paradise
reviews.text: We have visited several beaches in Cancun, but Playa Delfines is definitely the one that stood out. We had to ride the bus for 15 minutes to get here (while other beaches were a 5 minute walk), and it was worth it.The beach was very quite when we were there, and it is the perfect place to relax. The pollution is also less than with other beaches. If you don't want to go here every day, then combine it with a visit to the El Rey ruins that are very close.

reviews.title: Lovely beach, great to take pics with Cancun sign
reviews.text: Nice beach, but all the beaches along Cancun's hotel strip are nice! It's nothing different from the rest, other than this is where the huge Cancun sign is located. So that makes it a must!

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach- a bit rough for kids
reviews.text: This is an absolutely gorgeous beach, clean and with looots of sand space for the kids to play and a nice playground. However the waves are a bit rough for the kids.

reviews.title: Inviting white sands of the Caribbean
reviews.text: Our hotel (Iberostar Cancun) was situated on Playa Delfines and the beach stretches far and wide (but it changes name/ shape as you from North to South).The beach was white and fairly even, easily accessible and hosted the hotel sun beds, wooden umbrellas and beach games. There was a tractor to remove excess seaweed and keep the sand clear.The locals use it to sell souvenirs to tourists but they don't hassle you. The beach is safe, clean and most hotels have lifeguards. The sea was fairly unsettled post hurricane Patricia but clearly marked by flags. We were able to paddle even though they had red flags flying. On other days we jumped waves and enjoyed the the warm, green and inviting waters.There were two weddings and  a low key fashion shoot.

reviews.title: THE BEACH TO GO WHEN IN CANCUN
reviews.text: We have tried a few beaches and unfortunately most of them are full of "herbs" in the water. This one was the best we found. The sand is pure white and the water has a great color. You can take pictures near the beach in front of the letters CANCUN

reviews.title: what a great beach!!!
reviews.text: This place is beautiful and perfect for families and couples. white sand and blue water ... awesome breezes and dolphins too ..that's why its called Dolphin Beach..Its a great spot for playing or even getting married!!!! Recommended by the Mayor of Cancun

reviews.title: Do not miss this little gem
reviews.text: Safe to swim, beach clean and the restroom facilities very good. Very popular with locals soit must be good. Right next to the Cancun sign for photographs

reviews.title: sweet
reviews.text: Nice beach. You can find locals relaxing here. The Cancun sign is beautiful so prepare to take awesome pics.

reviews.title: Oh So Beautiful
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach, although the water is not safe to swim in.  It is also where the Cancun sign is making it great for photo ops.

reviews.title: Beautiful and Clean!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach for locals and tourists alike! Amidst all the overly glamourized tourist hotels that exist up and down the zona hotelera, is this gem of a beach. Free to the public, with spotless restrooms and outdoor shower area, this is a great place to hang out and swim for a few hours. Tipping is appreciated by the wait staff at the restrooms, but not necessary.The beach is cleaned daily, and the water is that Caribbean blue everyone loves. It is really the best and only reason to venture into this overly priced neighborhood!

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: The most popular beach in Cancun. We went there in the morning so there was not many people. Great view!

reviews.title: Where You Should Go In Cancun
reviews.text: Once in Cancun and you want to take a photo with that beautiful and colorful CANCUN signage, you should come here. The locals call this place by "El MIrador", located along Zona Hotelera.Views here are amazing for taking your pics, there are also bathrooms/change rooms you can use -  there were no water though when we were there. The place is located at the end of the hotels strip so there are fewer people here than at the middle of the hotel zone. I'm not even talking about how beautiful the color of the water as Cancun is well-known of it's Turquoise water.

reviews.title: Go.
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning. The water is so clear, the sand clean. Loved our time there. Busy yes, but not unbearable.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: beautiful beach, large waves, very clean ,but watch out for birds l stealing your snacks!! lol xxxxxx

reviews.title: This is a paradise you have to see to believe
reviews.text: This beach is clean with public access, workout station, palapas, and life guards on duty.  The colors of the ocean from the top of the beach are some that you truly have to see to believe.  Public restrooms are available and this is a great spot for tourist to take their perfect Cancun vacation picture in front of the giant "Cancun" sign.

reviews.title: Please use OFF
reviews.text: Bugs are pretty intense, so be sure to wear OFF or any other bug repelent product.You will surely enjoy visiting the beach and the picture at the Cancun sign is a MUST

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: This beach is gorgeous.  Beautiful white sand and clear blue waters for swimming.  Has clean bathroom facilities, outdoor showers, shaded areas, a playground, and an outdoor gym free of charge.  Also a great photo op at the light up Cancun sign.  Great place to spend the day.

reviews.title: A beautiful public beach...
reviews.text: This is a public beach with a few areas to lounge in the sun. There are restrooms and showers near the famous Cancun sign that everyone takes pictures at. This is on Kukulkan street a few blocks north of the Crown Paradise resort. I would recommend visiting this beach after you see the Mayan museum just north of the beach.

reviews.title: Nice!
reviews.text: During summer 2015 the beach was lovely but there was way too much seaweed to enjoy it. However we made the best of it and took some nice pictures with the "Cancun" sign behind us :)

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: We were there on a sunny day. The water was calm. There are nice playgrounds. This is a beautiful place and a must see in Cancun.  Gorgeous!

reviews.title: Quick stop
reviews.text: Its reaaaally nice beach and people are stopping over there near the CANCUN sign to take some pictures!

reviews.title: Linda playa!
reviews.text: Very nice public beach. Public toilet and showers. Not busy at all. Water colour is amazing. Check for "zargaso" some sort of algee which can sometimes be found floating on the shore and can be a bit of a pain.

reviews.title: Quick stop,  beautiful beach
reviews.text: Nice,  clean beach.  The Cancun sign is there to take pictures.  It is a nice place by the El Rey ruins are close by

reviews.title: Mesmerizing!
reviews.text: The moment you see the view of the ocean your jaw drops and can't take your eyes away from it. The vivid color of the water is the bluest and super Aqua you'll see.  Pretty popular so there's a lot of visitors.  Enjoyed or time!

reviews.title: Hermosa la playa
reviews.text: Great place, changing rooms, sanitarios,  attendant. Great white sand, azure la mar, no beach attendant or vendors, good or bad is a point of view!

reviews.title: Beach day
reviews.text: Great view with white sand and blue water!!! Spend a few hours here before returning back home just to enjoy our last moments

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: A beautiful public beach with white grains of sand and clear turquoise water, picture perfect. The gentle waves here make swimming in the sea a pleasant experience and there is parking available just off the road. Don't forget to take a photo of the famous multi coloured Cancun sign while you are there!

reviews.title: Amazing beach a definite must see
reviews.text: It was the nicest beach I've been to there was clear water with lots of waves , I wish I had thought to bring a board ! Had a great day jumping in waves and overall I would recommend this to every traveler its can be very hot but there are shelters there and there are washrooms and showers available a definite plus , make sure you bring lots to drink and as with most places no glass containers ,

reviews.title: Wonder
reviews.text: Beautiful,this is a dreamplace for me..Color of the water is amazing.I would like to go back,piece and quiet.

reviews.title: Great walking beach
reviews.text: This beach is at the far end of the hotel zone. Lots of Mexican families enjoy this beach. You can walk for miles on this beach. Buses stop here and there are washrooms. There are no restaurants so bring your own food and beverages.

reviews.title: Excellente
reviews.text: Xcellente handlers, emotional heart warming experience. Very informative information provided about the dolphins I am a dolphin advocate so i was hesitant but must say i left educated about the facilty and the dolphins care

reviews.title: Best white sand beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Very nice white sand beaches. you can spend a pleasant day at the beach by renting one of the chairs with umbrellas. Absolutely no disturbance. you can see all the parasailing activities and water sport activities performed in this beach.

reviews.title: Azure seas
reviews.text: What blue, azure seas!  White sandy beaches and a cool wind makes for a great day to sit outside and enjoy God's creation!  We felt so relaxed and did not want the day to end!

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely, clean beach, which was within walking distance of our hotel (Sun Palace).  The views were amazing, and the beach is quite wide compared to some parts of Cancun.  The Cancun sign is here as well, so you can have your picture taken, however there are quite big queues to do this.  We got there early in the morning, so there wasn't a big queue.  We got the bus back as it was so hot. The bus stops right outside the beach, and goes to all hotels along the strip.

reviews.title: Nice beach, great photo opportunities
reviews.text: This beach was clean.  I saw workers cleaning up the seaweed at the shore.  There are Coke bottle statues for great picture opportunities,  Also, there lies the famous Cancun sign right outside the beach.  Get there early otherwise you will be waiting forever to pose for pictures in front of it.

reviews.title: Great beach can't wait to get back!!!
reviews.text: What a great beach - had plenty to offer, the beach seems to go on for days the locals are nice and plenty of shade!!!

reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text: Clear water with soft white sand. Visit at around 9 in the morning and you will have the beach to yourself. No seaweeds here. Maybe because of the large number of the hotels I suspect they clean them regularly. Iconic CANCUN sign for your memories too.

reviews.title: Ta Chido
reviews.text: Public beach with clean white sand and clear waters. Iguanas can be found in the wild and there are sometimes people walking up and down the beach selling food and drinks. It has everything you need to enjoy a sunny day in Cancun.

reviews.title: Faboulos sea
reviews.text: Great turqoise water, nice large beach with white sand. If your hotel is not near(ours was 20 min by car) take a cab. If you order it from the concierge, the price will be double. We paid 350 pesos with the cab the hotel ordered (The Courtyard Marriot) and on the way back we paid 200 pesos. We just stoped a cab near the beach, as it is very safe (the police station is right there) and the driver was very very nice and he also did a little guiding information. We called him again the next morning, at 5 am he was there and he took us to see the sunrise. FABULOUS!!!!

reviews.title: Great picture location
reviews.text: Gorgeous Beach. We didn't spend much time here, just passing through but definitely worth the stop. Lots of a great picture opportunities and clean bathrooms (nice for being pubic).

reviews.title: Where the Cancun sign stands...
reviews.text: An amazing photo op. This beach is family,  friend,  couple oriented beach is beautiful a must see and visit.

reviews.title: Very Nice beach
reviews.text: Very Nice beach , i think is one of the best of cancun ,there is a panoramic area , ( you can make good pics of the blue ocean) ,restrooms ( not very clean)   , good place to hang out for a while

reviews.title: Best public beach in the Hotel Zone
reviews.text: Best public beach in Cancun. There are palapas available for shade (if you get there early enough) or you can take your own umbrella. Its clean and big enough to not feel packed

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: The kids and I had a fabulous time at Playa Delfines! There was still a lot of seaweeds on the shore but it cleared out after a couple of days. The kids stay by the sands as they were scared of the waves but we all had fun.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Got the local bus up to go get a photo by the world famous cancun sign. Go early as its very very popular and I had to queue. It's very very hot so be prepared to wait and be patient. Beautiful place worth visiting

reviews.title: playa delfines
reviews.text: lovely beach, although with a lot of floating algae near the shore. DO NOT STAY AFTER DARK. THE MOSQUITOS WILL EAT YOU ALIVE

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice clean beach you can access if you don't have one with your hotel. This is where the CANCUN sign is located! Great photo opportunity!

reviews.title: Nice beach within Cancun´s hotel zone
reviews.text: One of the nicest beaches we found in Cancún.  Either bus route 1 or 2 can take you there within the hotel area.  The beach is clean and there were waves but even for non-swimmers, it was calm enough to enjoy.  Cancun has had a surge of weed, so people who are prone to allergies should just be careful not to touch the "sargazo" weed in the beaches

reviews.title: Nice Cancun sign
reviews.text: The beach has a nice Cancun sign in the front. The place also had little cabanas that you can rent if you plan on making a day out of it. I just went to take a picture with the colorful sign.

reviews.title: lovely place ,crystal waters
reviews.text: lovely place ,crystal waters and white sand, ,only be aware of the sea current , could be a little bit dangerous for kids , with strong winds

reviews.title: Exellent beach
reviews.text: Good beach for chill out with friends and grab some XX , my sweet dream is grab a grill with me my cooler with beers and do a really tex mex parrillada

reviews.title: Just go there to take a memorable picture with CANCUN sign.
reviews.text: Liked the CANCUN sign - good landmark to take a memorable photograph. There is a free public beach, but we didn't care much since we were staying a close by resort. You need about 30 minutes or so because some times there are buses stop there with tourists and it becomes a long line to take a picture.

reviews.title: Great sign that's well lit-up at night.
reviews.text: I visited at night because I wanted a picture of the very beautiful Cancun sign - it's two years old.  This was my fourth time flying into  Cancun and I never saw it.  It does look like  it gets really crowded during the day.

reviews.title: Another beautiful beach in the Riviera Maya
reviews.text: Any of the shores from Cancun to Playa del Carmen, to the islands of Isla Mujeres or Cozumel, have incredibly white sand and beautiful blue tonalities in the water, which is one of the main reasons our family enjoys vacationing in the Riviera Maya. Playa Delfines is one of these spots in the paradise that is Cancun, easy to access by public transportation and in a more secluded area away from the crowded hotel zone. This summer there was more seaweed in all beaches than any other time we have visited, which takes away from the pristine look we are used to, but it was still an enjoyable time. If visiting Cancun, don't miss it.

reviews.title: free/big
reviews.text: take the bus to playa dolphin////if you  get there at day break there are dolphins in this area///nothing like seeing them in clear blue water ,,,it located by the crown paradise club / across from  el-reye  ruins

reviews.title: Nice place to visit
reviews.text: If you looking for quite, peaceful, breath taking beach this is the spot. Apart from having the big CANCÚN sign the place is safe, not crowded,  clean & fee parking...

reviews.title: The best public beach in Cancun
reviews.text: By far the cleanest, safe and biggest public beach around the area. It is blue flag certified Although it was also affected by the seaweed of the season.You better bring your ice chest and your food since there is nothing around to buy stuff.The restrooms are free and clean. They also have showers and they have the famous Cancun sign to take pictures.

reviews.title: nice beach.. but there is nothing to do here
reviews.text: We went to this beach, thinking it was a normal beach with the possibility to rent umbrellas and sun beds, but that is not possible on this beach. Nor is there any kiosks or bars.all sunbeds around the beach are owned by hotels with no possibility to rent.

reviews.title: great trip
reviews.text: must visit, close to crown paradise and gr solaris. great view and great place to take pictures.go at sunrise if you can, at about 5:30 am

reviews.title: Cancun sign great for pictures.
reviews.text: Not sure why this is highly rated. Smelly on the road side like garbage, currently invaded by seaweed, and there's nothing special. Pay the ferry fee and get to Isla Mujeres beaches. Only cool thing is the CANCUN sign, great for pictures.

reviews.title: Best beach of Cancun!
reviews.text: This is by far the best beach that Cancun has to offer. Blue waters and free kiosks to spend the day far from the crowded electronic party spots.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We took the bus there on Friday, 8/7/15. Very limited parking in front of the beach. Not sure if there were other parking areas so make sure you research that beforehand if you plan on driving there yourself. The beach was clean and the sand was fine with very few rocks. The slope of the sand underwater was gradual allowing you to walk out quite a ways. The water temperature was on the warm side but cool enough to get relief from the blazing sun. They had red flags out that day which meant "no swimming", however, most did not seem to pay any attention to them. Having been to many beaches, the waves and the undertow didn't seem to warrant the flags on that day. This was the perfect beach for sunbathing and bodysurfing. My only complaint was the 30 minute wait to take a picture with the famous "Cancun" sign. I think many wouldn't mind if they made a duplicate sign.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach at sundown
reviews.text: Granted, we don't get the sunset over the ocean in Cancun but the water temperature, breeze and views are stunning. It was a bit crowded as you can expect in a public beach on a Sunday afternoon but it was very clean and pleasant. Having free shade, and miles of beach you can find a good spot. The atmosphere was friendly with lots of families and children and overall was a great experience. We left a little late which probably explains that the showers were closed so we had a bit of extra sand on our feet when we got into our rented car. No snorkelling but the ocean was simply perfect.

reviews.title: THE place to have a photo with the CANCUN sign!
reviews.text: This public beach has been improved so much in the last year (2014).  It is now THE destination on the coast so that you can have a photo in front of the CANCUN sign (either day or night!).  The beach has planted new palm trees, added swings, etc., for the kids, and added more amenities for beach goers.  Very impressed!

reviews.title: too many other nice beaches in the world
reviews.text: was recommended to me to go there but I am spoiled by bahamatude in eleuthera and all the beaches where there are no footprints but your own!!!  This whole beach is crowded and I wished I had time to go to a more secluded spot

reviews.title: Great Beach & Cancun Sign
reviews.text: We took the bus to Playa Delfines to take photos of the Cancun sign. The beach is great too - we took our photos with the sign (had to wait for other people to get their photos) and had a quick swim. Not a lot else in the area just a few more resorts.

reviews.title: great beach
reviews.text: great free beachsurfing school there! no shops around so batter to take water with youwell there are some people selling water on the beach for 20 pesoshower and toilet provided

reviews.title: CANCUN Sign
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, we walked over from our hotel just to go and take pictures with the Cancun Sign.  Other than that there's nothing really special that you wouldn't have at your hotel.  Plenty of locals were there being that it's a public beach, and the water was beautiful!

reviews.title: Super awesome
reviews.text: Took the kids here.  They loved it!  I highly rexcommend if you have never done the dolpin thing.  THey are super safe and a really good experience.

reviews.title: WOW beautiful!
reviews.text: When I was working in the hotel as a concierge  I was alwayssending my guests to see that heaven and all of them as me fell in love with that gorgeous place!White sand, beautiful people, agua turquesa ..all wrapped into one ) Must see in Cancun!

reviews.title: Best beach in Cancun
reviews.text: My favorite beach in the hotel zone of Cancun. Huge beach with places everywhere.More3over it’s also a landmark with the famous CANCUN sign where you should do the queue before taking a picture

reviews.title: Delfinesb
reviews.text: We arrived by bus to this clean and so well kept beach near the end of the hotel zone. It took us about 15 well entertained minutes to get and it was worth it. The palapas made this beach enjoyable and are also geared towards disabled visitors. Here you can really appreciate the white sandy beach and stronger waves. You'll love this place.

reviews.title: Beach gem a few steps from the big hotels
reviews.text: Rented a car for a day from Playa del Carmen and i was looking for a nice beach to enjoy with my wife and daughter.Wow!!!4 tint turquoise ocean color... beautiful white sand... large (extra large) beach with free palapas to get a bit of shade... what can you ask more?Yeap... true little beach gem. :)))

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Nice beach...clean...not too crowded...not to far from the center of Cancun... If you visit you must take a picture with colorful sign CANCUN:) For ancient history lovers - the Mayan ruins El Rey is located across the street

reviews.title: The sea is my queen
reviews.text: This beach area will blow you away.  It is so beautiful and clean.  I love watching the tourists having their pictures taken in front of the Cancun Sign..

reviews.title: One day
reviews.text: Views are absolutely beautiful! Loved taking pictures in front of the Cancun sign. Sandy white beach. Super clean. Must see!

reviews.title: Turquoise ocean  color
reviews.text: Beautiful beach , amazing sight , turquoise ocean color , a nice place for a great portrait, swimming or hanging out ,  , A place to visit in cancun
